/* ============================================================
   ZeroPlay — restrained premium streaming interface
   Palette & components ported from brett0x0/debrid-stream
   (public/style.css): GitHub-dark surfaces + violet primary.
   Streaming UI (rails, posters, player) built in the same language.
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --bg:#101214; --surface:#171a1d; --surface2:#1d2125; --surface-border:#292e33;
  --primary:#7c3aed; --primary-hover:#6d2ee0;
  --text:#d5d9dc; --text-heading:#f7f7f5; --text-muted:#9aa1a6;
  --accent:#d8b36a; --success:#3da66a; --success-text:#63c48a; --error:#f06a5e;
  --violet-soft:#b794f6; --radius:8px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:"Avenir Next","Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);line-height:1.55;min-height:100vh;letter-spacing:-.005em}
a{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none}
a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
button{font-family:inherit}
.hidden{display:none!important}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px;height:8px}::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#30363d;border-radius:8px}::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent}

/* ---------- Top bar ---------- */
.topbar{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--surface-border)}
.topbar-inner{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:.7rem 1rem;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.logo-badge{display:inline-block;background:transparent;color:var(--text-heading);border:0;padding:.25rem 0;border-radius:0;font-size:1rem;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:-.02em;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}
.logo-badge:hover{text-decoration:none;color:#fff}
.nav{display:flex;gap:.35rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.nav button{background:transparent;border:1px solid transparent;color:var(--text);padding:.45rem .8rem;border-radius:6px;cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem;transition:all .2s}
.nav button:hover{background:#21262d;color:var(--text-heading)}
.nav button.active{background:var(--surface2);border-color:transparent;color:#fff;box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 var(--primary)}
.topbar-search{flex:1;min-width:200px;display:flex;gap:.5rem}
.catalog-state{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.8rem;white-space:nowrap}


/* ---------- DebridStream components (ported) ---------- */
.container{max-width:720px;margin:0 auto;padding:2rem 1rem}
.header{text-align:center;margin-bottom:2rem}
.header h1{color:var(--text-heading);font-size:2rem;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.subtitle{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:1rem}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:0;border-radius:var(--radius);padding:2rem;box-shadow:none}
.section{margin-bottom:2rem;padding-bottom:1.5rem;border-bottom:1px solid var(--surface-border)}
.section:last-of-type{border-bottom:none}
.section-header-flex{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:.5rem;gap:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn-group{display:flex;gap:.5rem}
.section h2{color:var(--text-heading);font-size:1.2rem}
.category-heading{color:var(--violet-soft);font-size:.85rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-top:1.25rem;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.section-desc{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.9rem;margin-bottom:.75rem}
.form-group{margin-bottom:1.25rem}
.form-row{display:flex;gap:1rem}
.form-row .form-group{flex:1}
label{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-heading);margin-bottom:.4rem;font-size:.9rem}
.required{color:var(--error)}
input[type="text"],input[type="password"],input[type="number"],input[type="search"],select,textarea{width:100%;padding:.65rem .85rem;background:#111417;border:1px solid var(--surface-border);border-radius:6px;color:var(--text-heading);font-size:.95rem;transition:border-color .2s;font-family:inherit}
input:focus,select:focus,textarea:focus{outline:2px solid rgba(124,58,237,.35);outline-offset:1px;border-color:var(--primary);box-shadow:none}
.input-with-action{display:flex;gap:.5rem}
.input-with-action input{flex:1}
.help-text{display:block;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.8rem;margin-top:.4rem}
.help-text a{color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none}
.help-text a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.status-box{margin-top:.75rem;padding:.75rem;border-radius:6px;font-size:.85rem}
.status-box.success{background:rgba(46,160,67,.15);border:1px solid rgba(46,160,67,.4);color:var(--success-text)}
.status-box.error{background:rgba(248,81,73,.15);border:1px solid rgba(248,81,73,.4);color:var(--error)}
.status-box.info{background:rgba(88,166,255,.12);border:1px solid rgba(88,166,255,.4);color:var(--accent)}
.checkbox-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(135px,1fr));gap:.65rem}
.checkbox-card{position:relative;display:flex;background:#0d1117;border:1px solid var(--surface-border);border-radius:8px;padding:.65rem .75rem;cursor:pointer;user-select:none;transition:all .2s ease;margin:0}
.checkbox-card:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
.checkbox-card input{position:absolute;opacity:0}
.checkbox-card input:checked+.card-content{color:var(--violet-soft)}
.checkbox-card input:checked~.card-content .title{color:var(--text-heading)}
.checkbox-card:has(input:checked){border-color:var(--primary);background:rgba(138,43,226,.1)}
.card-content{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.card-content .title{font-weight:600;font-size:.9rem}
.card-content .sub{font-size:.75rem;color:var(--text-muted)}
.actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.75rem;margin-top:1.5rem}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.45rem;font-weight:600;padding:.65rem 1.25rem;border-radius:6px;border:none;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--text-heading);background:#21262d}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:wait}
.btn-xs{padding:.25rem .65rem;font-size:.75rem;border-radius:4px}
.btn-primary{background:var(--primary);color:#fff}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--primary-hover)}
.btn-secondary{background:var(--surface2);color:var(--text-heading);border:1px solid transparent}
.btn-secondary:hover{background:#30363d}
.btn-outline{background:transparent;color:var(--text-heading);border:1px solid var(--surface-border)}
.btn-outline:hover{background:#21262d}
.btn-large{padding:.9rem 1.5rem;font-size:1.05rem}
.btn-danger{background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(248,81,73,.5);color:var(--error)}
.btn-danger:hover{background:rgba(248,81,73,.12)}
.install-notice{margin-top:1.5rem;background:#0d1117;border:1px solid var(--surface-border);border-radius:8px;padding:1rem}
.install-notice p{font-size:.85rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:.5rem}
.install-notice input{font-family:monospace;font-size:.85rem}
.toggle-group .switch-label{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;cursor:pointer}
.switch-label input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:0;height:0}
.slider{position:relative;flex:none;width:46px;height:24px;background:#21262d;border:1px solid var(--surface-border);border-radius:9999px;transition:all .2s}
.slider::after{content:"";position:absolute;top:2px;left:2px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#8b949e;transition:all .2s}
.switch-label input:checked+.slider{background:var(--primary);border-color:var(--primary)}
.switch-label input:checked+.slider::after{transform:translateX(22px);background:#fff}
.footer{text-align:center;margin-top:2rem;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.8rem;padding:0 1rem 2.5rem}

/* ---------- Streaming UI (DebridStream language) ---------- */
.page{max-width:1400px;margin:0 auto;padding:1.25rem 1rem 2rem}
.page h1{color:var(--text-heading);font-size:1.6rem;margin-bottom:.25rem}
.page .lede{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.92rem;margin-bottom:1.25rem}
.demo-banner{max-width:1400px;margin:1rem auto 0;padding:0 1rem}
.demo-banner .status-box{display:flex;gap:.75rem;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between}
.hero{position:relative;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius);overflow:hidden;background:var(--surface);min-height:360px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;box-shadow:none;margin-bottom:2rem}
.hero-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;opacity:.55}
.hero-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(13,17,23,.95) 8%,rgba(13,17,23,.55) 55%,rgba(13,17,23,.15)),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(13,17,23,.95),transparent 55%)}
.hero-body{position:relative;padding:2rem;max-width:640px}
.hero-body .logo-badge{margin-bottom:.9rem}
.hero-body h1{font-size:2.2rem;line-height:1.15;color:var(--text-heading);margin-bottom:.5rem}
.hero-meta{display:flex;gap:.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--text-muted);margin-bottom:.6rem}
.hero-body p{font-size:.95rem;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:3;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:1.1rem}
.hero-actions{display:flex;gap:.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.3rem;background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--text-muted);border-radius:0;padding:0;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:600}
.chip.rd{color:var(--success-text)}
.chip.violet{color:var(--violet-soft)}
.chip.star{color:#e3b341}
.rail{margin-bottom:1.9rem}
.rail-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:.7rem}
.rail-head h2{color:var(--text-heading);font-size:1.15rem}
.rail-head h2 .rd-plus{color:var(--success-text);font-size:.8rem;vertical-align:middle}
.rail-arrows{display:flex;gap:.4rem}
.icon-btn{width:32px;height:32px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#21262d;border:1px solid var(--surface-border);border-radius:6px;color:var(--text-heading);cursor:pointer;font-size:1rem;transition:all .2s}
.icon-btn:hover{background:#30363d;border-color:var(--accent)}
.rail-track{display:flex;gap:.8rem;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:.5rem;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:thin}
.rail-track .poster-card{flex:0 0 154px;scroll-snap-align:start}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(154px,1fr));gap:1rem}
.poster-card{background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:0;overflow:visible;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .18s ease;position:relative}
.poster-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:none}
.poster-wrap{position:relative;aspect-ratio:2/3;background:#111417;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}
.poster-wrap img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.poster-badges{position:absolute;top:.45rem;left:.45rem;display:flex;gap:.3rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.poster-rate{position:absolute;top:.45rem;right:.45rem;background:rgba(10,11,12,.82);border:0;color:#f0c66b;border-radius:4px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:700;padding:.15rem .45rem}
.hover-actions{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(13,17,23,.92) 20%,rgba(13,17,23,.25));display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;gap:.45rem;padding:.7rem;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s}
.poster-card:hover .hover-actions,.poster-card:focus-within .hover-actions{opacity:1}
.hover-actions .btn{padding:.45rem .6rem;font-size:.82rem;width:100%}
.progress-track{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:5px;background:rgba(240,246,252,.18)}
.progress-fill{height:100%;background:var(--primary)}
.remove-x{position:absolute;top:.45rem;right:.45rem;z-index:3}
.poster-meta{padding:.55rem .05rem .75rem}
.poster-meta .t{color:var(--text-heading);font-weight:600;font-size:.88rem;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.poster-meta .s{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.76rem;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.filters{display:flex;gap:.7rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.filters .form-group{flex:1 1 160px;margin:0}
.chip-row{display:flex;gap:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:1.2rem}
.chip-btn{background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid transparent;color:var(--text-muted);border-radius:0;padding:.35rem .2rem;font-weight:650;font-size:.85rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s}
.chip-btn:hover{border-color:var(--accent)}
.chip-btn.active{border-bottom-color:var(--primary);background:transparent;color:#fff}
.load-more{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin:1.6rem 0 .5rem}
.empty{background:transparent;border:0;border-top:1px solid var(--surface-border);border-radius:0;padding:2rem 1rem;text-align:left;color:var(--text-muted)}
.empty h3{color:var(--text-heading);margin-bottom:.4rem}
.skel{background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:6px;overflow:hidden}
.skel .ph{aspect-ratio:2/3;background:linear-gradient(100deg,#161b22 40%,#21262d 50%,#161b22 60%);background-size:200% 100%;animation:shim 1.4s infinite}
@keyframes shim{to{background-position:-200% 0}}
.spinner{display:inline-block;width:16px;height:16px;border:2px solid rgba(240,246,252,.25);border-top-color:#fff;border-radius:50%;animation:spin .7s linear infinite;vertical-align:-3px}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

/* ---------- Detail modal ---------- */
.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:80;background:rgba(1,4,9,.78);backdrop-filter:blur(4px);display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;overflow-y:auto;padding:2.5vh 1rem}
.modal{width:min(980px,100%);background:var(--surface);border:0;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45);overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.modal-close{position:absolute;top:.8rem;right:.8rem;z-index:5}
.detail-hero{position:relative;min-height:300px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end}
.detail-hero .hero-bg{opacity:.5}
.detail-body{position:relative;padding:1.6rem 2rem 2rem;display:grid;grid-template-columns:170px 1fr;gap:1.6rem;margin-top:-90px}
.detail-poster{border-radius:6px;border:0;width:170px;aspect-ratio:2/3;object-fit:cover;background:#111417;box-shadow:none}
.detail-body h2{color:var(--text-heading);font-size:1.7rem;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.detail-body .overview{font-size:.94rem;margin:.8rem 0 1.1rem}
.detail-actions{display:flex;gap:.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:1rem}
.detail-section{padding:0 2rem 1.4rem}
.detail-section h3{color:var(--text-heading);font-size:1.02rem;margin-bottom:.65rem}
.cast-track{display:flex;gap:.8rem;overflow-x:auto;padding-bottom:.5rem}
.cast{flex:0 0 96px;text-align:center}
.cast img,.cast .avatar{width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:1px solid var(--surface-border);background:#21262d;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;color:var(--violet-soft);font-size:1.3rem;margin:0 auto}
.cast .n{font-size:.78rem;color:var(--text-heading);font-weight:600;margin-top:.4rem;line-height:1.25}
.cast .c{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--text-muted);line-height:1.25}
.ep-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:.6rem}
.ep{display:flex;gap:.7rem;align-items:center;background:#0d1117;border:1px solid var(--surface-border);border-radius:8px;padding:.55rem .7rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;text-align:left;color:var(--text)}
.ep:hover{border-color:var(--primary)}
.ep .num{flex:none;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(138,43,226,.15);border:1px solid rgba(138,43,226,.4);color:var(--violet-soft);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;font-size:.85rem}
.ep .et{font-size:.83rem;color:var(--text-heading);font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
.ep .es{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--text-muted)}
.season-row{display:flex;gap:.7rem;align-items:end;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:.8rem}
.season-row .form-group{margin:0;min-width:180px}

/* ---------- Player ---------- */
.player-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:#000;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.player-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;flex-wrap:wrap;background:#0d1117;border-bottom:1px solid var(--surface-border);padding:.6rem .9rem}
.player-bar .pt{color:var(--text-heading);font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;margin-right:auto;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:38vw}
.player-bar select{width:auto;padding:.45rem .6rem;font-size:.85rem}
.player-frame{flex:1;width:100%;border:0;background:#000}
.player-hint{background:#0d1117;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.76rem;padding:.4rem .9rem;border-top:1px solid var(--surface-border)}

/* ---------- Toasts ---------- */
#toasts{position:fixed;right:1rem;bottom:1rem;z-index:120;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:.5rem;max-width:min(360px,90vw)}
.toast{background:#22262b;border:1px solid #343a40;border-radius:6px;color:var(--text-heading);padding:.7rem .9rem;font-size:.87rem;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.toast.success{color:#dff5e8}
.toast.error{color:#ffe1de}

/* ---------- Sources / FastStream (TV prototype) ---------- */
#preloadSlot{position:fixed;left:-9999px;top:-9999px;width:320px;height:180px;overflow:hidden}
.player-stage{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#000;min-height:0}
.player-stage .player-frame{flex:1;min-height:0}
.hud{display:flex;gap:.45rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;background:#0d1117;border-top:1px solid var(--surface-border);padding:.5rem .9rem}
.health{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text-muted)}
.health-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#6e7681;flex:none}
.health-dot.ok{background:var(--success-text)}
.health-dot.slow{background:#e3b341}
.health-dot.bad{background:var(--error)}
.src-row{display:flex;gap:.8rem;align-items:flex-start;background:transparent;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--surface-border);border-radius:0;padding:.95rem 0;margin-bottom:0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.src-row .grow{flex:1;min-width:220px}
.src-row .nm{color:var(--text-heading);font-weight:700}
.src-row code{display:block;font-size:.72rem;color:var(--text-muted);word-break:break-all;font-family:ui-monospace,monospace;margin-top:.15rem}
.src-actions{display:flex;gap:.45rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.log-list{list-style:none;max-height:190px;overflow:auto;font-size:.83rem}
.log-list li{padding:.35rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid #21262d;color:var(--text)}
.log-list li span{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.75rem;margin-right:.5rem}
.stat-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:.65rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.stat{background:transparent;border:0;border-left:1px solid var(--surface-border);border-radius:0;padding:.35rem .75rem}
.stat .k{font-size:.72rem;color:var(--text-muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em}
.stat .v{color:var(--text-heading);font-weight:700}
input[type="range"]{width:100%;accent-color:var(--primary)}
.panel{background:var(--surface);border:0;border-radius:var(--radius);padding:1.5rem;box-shadow:none;margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.panel h2{color:var(--text-heading);font-size:1.15rem;margin-bottom:.4rem}
.panel .section-desc{margin-bottom:1rem}
video.player-frame{width:100%;height:100%;background:#000}
body.locked{overflow:hidden}

/* ---------- Continuous discovery registry ---------- */
.panel-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}
.panel-head .section-desc{max-width:820px}
.discovery-status{padding:.8rem 0;border-top:1px solid var(--surface-border);border-bottom:1px solid var(--surface-border);color:var(--text-heading);font-size:.9rem;margin:.6rem 0 1rem}
.discovery-stats{display:flex;gap:1.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.88rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.discovery-stats strong{color:#fff;font-size:1.02rem;margin-right:.25rem}
.discovery-actions{display:flex;gap:.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin:.8rem 0 1rem}
.discovery-actions .help-text{margin:0;max-width:620px}
.seed-add{display:flex;gap:.7rem;align-items:end;flex-wrap:wrap}.seed-add .grow{flex:1;min-width:240px}.seed-add .form-group{margin-bottom:0}
details.advanced{border-top:1px solid var(--surface-border);margin-top:1.25rem;padding-top:1rem}details.advanced summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--text-heading);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:1rem}.advanced-body{padding-top:.25rem}
.crawler-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:.55rem 1rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.check-line{display:flex;gap:.55rem;align-items:flex-start;color:var(--text);font-weight:500;cursor:pointer}.check-line input{margin-top:.25rem;accent-color:var(--primary)}
.registry-head{margin-top:1.6rem;border-top:1px solid var(--surface-border);padding-top:1.3rem}.registry-head h3{color:var(--text-heading);font-size:1.05rem;margin-bottom:.25rem}
.provider-filters{display:flex;gap:1rem;flex-wrap:wrap}.provider-filters .grow{flex:1;min-width:230px}.provider-filters .form-group{margin-bottom:.7rem}
.provider-status{font-size:.76rem;font-weight:700}.provider-status.installed{color:var(--success-text)}.provider-status.candidate{color:var(--accent)}
.meta-inline{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.8rem}.provider-meta{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.83rem;margin-top:.22rem}.provider-desc{color:var(--text);font-size:.88rem;margin-top:.35rem;max-width:860px}.provider-checks{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.78rem;margin-top:.3rem}.provider-error{color:var(--error);font-size:.8rem;margin-top:.3rem}
.btn-light{background:#f5f3ec;color:#151515}.btn-light:hover{background:#fff}
.page h1,.hero-body h1,.detail-body h2{letter-spacing:-.025em}
textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:90px;line-height:1.45}
@media(max-width:760px){.seed-add .btn{width:100%}.discovery-stats{gap:.8rem}.panel{padding:1.15rem}.topbar-search{order:3;flex-basis:100%}}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .card{padding:1.25rem}
  .form-row{flex-direction:column;gap:0}
  .detail-body{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:1.2rem;margin-top:-60px}
  .detail-poster{width:120px}
  .detail-section{padding:0 1.2rem 1.2rem}
  .hero-body{padding:1.3rem}
  .hero-body h1{font-size:1.6rem}
  .player-bar .pt{max-width:92vw}
  .rail-track .poster-card{flex-basis:128px}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(128px,1fr))}
}
/* ---------- TV premium polish: menu, categories, motion, previews, player ---------- */
:root{--gold:#d8b36a;--focus:#f0c66b;--glass:rgba(13,15,17,.82);--glass2:rgba(18,20,23,.92);--ease-out:cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.21,1)}
.sr-only{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
body{background:radial-gradient(1100px 520px at 18% -8%,rgba(124,58,237,.13),transparent 58%),radial-gradient(900px 460px at 88% 0%,rgba(216,179,106,.07),transparent 55%),var(--bg)}
.page,.topbar-inner{max-width:1680px}
.topbar{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,11,13,.96),rgba(10,11,13,.86));backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);transition:box-shadow .25s ease,background .25s ease}
.topbar.is-scrolled{box-shadow:0 18px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.34);background:rgba(9,10,12,.94)}
.topbar-inner{padding:.72rem clamp(.8rem,2vw,1.6rem);gap:.85rem}
.menu-button{width:42px;height:42px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:#fff;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;font-size:1.05rem;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:transform .18s ease,background .18s ease,border-color .18s ease}
.menu-button:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.logo-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.55rem;font-size:1.08rem}
.logo-mark{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--primary);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-size:.82rem;box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(124,58,237,.35)}
.nav button{position:relative;padding:.55rem .78rem;border-radius:999px;color:#c9cfd3}
.nav button.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);box-shadow:none;color:#fff}
.nav button.active::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:.18rem;width:18px;height:2px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--gold);transform:translateX(-50%)}
.category-strip{max-width:1680px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(.8rem,2vw,1.6rem) .55rem;display:flex;gap:.45rem;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.category-strip::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.category-strip button{flex:0 0 auto;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);color:#d7dbde;border-radius:999px;padding:.34rem .72rem;font-size:.8rem;font-weight:650;cursor:pointer;transition:all .18s ease}
.category-strip button:hover{color:#fff;border-color:rgba(216,179,106,.55);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.topbar-search input{border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05)}
.topbar-search .btn{border-radius:999px}
.menu-scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:88;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:1;transition:opacity .22s ease}
.menu-drawer{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;bottom:0;z-index:90;width:min(360px,88vw);background:#111417;border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);box-shadow:28px 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.45);padding:1.1rem;overflow-y:auto;transform:translateX(-105%);visibility:hidden;transition:transform .28s var(--ease-out),visibility 0s linear .28s}
.menu-drawer.open{transform:translateX(0);visibility:visible;transition-delay:0s}
.menu-drawer-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:1rem}
.menu-drawer h2{color:#fff;font-size:1.1rem}
.menu-section{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);padding:1rem 0}
.menu-section h3{color:var(--gold);font-size:.76rem;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:.55rem}
.menu-link{display:flex;width:100%;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;text-align:left;background:transparent;border:0;color:#e8ebee;padding:.58rem .55rem;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;font-size:.94rem;font-weight:620}
.menu-link:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.menu-link span:last-child{color:var(--text-muted);font-weight:400}
button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px}
.btn:active,.icon-btn:active,.menu-button:active{transform:scale(.97)}
@keyframes zpRise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
@keyframes zpCardIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(12px) scale(.985)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
@keyframes zpFade{from{opacity:0}to{opacity:1}}
@keyframes zpModalIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.985)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
body.route-enter .page{animation:zpFade .32s ease both}
.hero,.rail,.panel{animation:zpRise .45s var(--ease-out) both}
.modal{animation:zpModalIn .28s var(--ease-out) both}
.poster-card{animation:zpCardIn .42s var(--ease-out) both;animation-delay:calc(var(--i,0)*32ms);transform-origin:center 72%}
.poster-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)}
.poster-card:focus-visible{outline:none;transform:scale(1.045);z-index:8}
.poster-card:focus-visible .poster-wrap,.poster-card.is-previewing .poster-wrap{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--focus),0 22px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.48)}
.poster-card.is-previewing{transform:scale(1.045);z-index:9}
.poster-wrap{border-radius:12px;background:#0b0d0f;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.05);transition:box-shadow .22s ease}
.poster-wrap>img{transition:opacity .35s ease,transform .45s var(--ease-out)}
.poster-card:hover .poster-wrap>img{transform:scale(1.035)}
.trailer-layer{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .38s ease;background:#000}
.trailer-layer iframe{position:absolute;top:0;left:-83.35%;width:266.7%;height:100%;border:0;pointer-events:none}
.poster-card.is-previewing .trailer-layer{opacity:1}
.poster-card.is-previewing .poster-wrap>img{opacity:0}
.preview-badge{position:absolute;left:.5rem;bottom:.55rem;z-index:4;background:rgba(0,0,0,.68);color:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-radius:999px;padding:.18rem .5rem;font-size:.68rem;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:0;transform:translateY(3px);transition:all .22s ease}
.poster-card.is-previewing .preview-badge{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}
.card-overview{display:none;color:#eef1f3;font-size:.75rem;line-height:1.35;max-height:2.7em;overflow:hidden}
.poster-card.is-previewing .card-overview{display:block}
.hover-actions{z-index:5;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(4,5,6,.96) 12%,rgba(4,5,6,.58) 58%,transparent)}
.poster-card.is-previewing .hover-actions,.poster-card:focus-within .hover-actions{opacity:1}
.rail-track{scroll-padding-inline:1rem;padding:.25rem .1rem .7rem}
.rail-progress{height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:-.15rem}
.rail-progress i{display:block;height:100%;width:18%;background:var(--gold);border-radius:2px;transition:transform .18s linear;transform-origin:left}
.hero{min-height:clamp(390px,58vh,620px);border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 28px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.34)}
.hero-trailer{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;opacity:0;transition:opacity .55s ease;background:#000}
.hero-trailer.on{opacity:.82}
.hero-trailer iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;transform:scale(1.34);pointer-events:none}
.hero-logo{max-width:min(430px,82%);max-height:112px;object-fit:contain;object-position:left bottom;margin-bottom:.8rem;filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.55))}
.trailer-ctl{display:inline-flex;gap:.45rem;margin-left:auto;align-self:flex-end}
.detail-hero .hero-trailer.on{opacity:.72}
.category-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(230px,1fr));gap:1rem;margin-bottom:2rem}
.category-tile{position:relative;min-height:132px;border:0;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;color:#fff;background:#171a1d;padding:0;transition:transform .22s var(--ease-out),box-shadow .22s ease}
.category-tile img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;opacity:.56;transition:transform .35s var(--ease-out),opacity .25s ease}
.category-tile::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.82),rgba(0,0,0,.18)),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(0,0,0,.72),transparent 62%)}
.category-tile:hover,.category-tile:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.012);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--focus),0 22px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.38)}
.category-tile:hover img{transform:scale(1.05);opacity:.68}
.category-tile b,.category-tile span{position:relative;z-index:2;display:block;margin-left:1rem}
.category-tile b{margin-top:4.4rem;font-size:1.14rem;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.category-tile span{color:#d9dde0;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:1rem}
.category-quick{display:flex;gap:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:-.25rem 0 1.2rem}
.skeleton-card{border-radius:12px}

/* Unified ZeroPlay player */
.player-overlay{background:#000;animation:zpFade .22s ease both}
.player-stage{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden;background:#000}
.player-overlay>.player-frame{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
/* Playback controls stay inside the player and can be hidden for embedded players. */

.media-shell{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#000}
.media-shell iframe,.media-shell video{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:#000}
.media-click{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:4;border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer}
.player-loading{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:6;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.8rem;color:#fff;background:radial-gradient(circle at center,rgba(124,58,237,.16),rgba(0,0,0,.88) 62%);text-align:center;padding:2rem;transition:opacity .25s ease}
.player-loading.hide{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.player-loading .big-spinner{width:46px;height:46px;border:3px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-top-color:#fff;border-radius:50%;animation:spin .75s linear infinite}
.player-bar{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:20;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.88),rgba(0,0,0,.48) 62%,transparent);border:0;padding:.85rem clamp(.8rem,2vw,1.4rem) 2.1rem;transition:transform .25s ease,opacity .25s ease}
.player-bar .pt{max-width:46vw;font-size:1rem}
.player-title-sub{display:block;color:#c8ced3;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:550;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.player-controls{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:20;padding:2.2rem clamp(.8rem,2vw,1.4rem) .9rem;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(0,0,0,.92),rgba(0,0,0,.55) 62%,transparent);transition:transform .25s ease,opacity .25s ease}

.player-hide-btn{border-color:rgba(216,179,106,.4);color:#f0d69c}
.player-chrome-restore{display:none;position:absolute;left:12px;top:50%;z-index:30;width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);border-radius:50%;background:rgba(9,11,14,.68);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;opacity:.32;transition:opacity .16s ease,transform .16s ease}
.player-chrome-restore:hover,.player-chrome-restore:focus-visible{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.06)}
.player-overlay.chrome-hidden .player-chrome-restore{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}

.player-overlay.chrome-hidden{cursor:none}
.player-overlay.chrome-hidden .player-bar{transform:translateY(-108%);opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.player-overlay.chrome-hidden .player-controls{transform:translateY(108%);opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.player-overlay.chrome-hidden .center-play{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.seek-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;color:#fff;font-size:.8rem;margin-bottom:.55rem}
.seek-row input[type="range"]{flex:1;accent-color:var(--primary);height:22px}
.control-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.control-btn{min-width:42px;height:42px;padding:0 .7rem;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);background:rgba(12,13,15,.72);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.35rem;font-weight:700;backdrop-filter:blur(10px);transition:all .16s ease}
input,select,textarea{border-radius:14px}
input[type="range"]{border-radius:999px}
.btn,.icon-btn,.chip-btn,.menu-link,.switch-label{border-radius:14px}
.setting-control,.setting-control input,.setting-control .slider{border-radius:999px}
.control-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.13);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.control-btn.primary{background:var(--primary);border-color:transparent;min-width:52px}
.control-btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed;transform:none}
.control-select{width:auto!important;min-width:118px;height:42px;border-radius:999px!important;background:rgba(12,13,15,.78)!important;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.13)!important;padding:.45rem .75rem!important}
.volume-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.25rem}
.volume-wrap input{width:92px;accent-color:#fff}
.center-play{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;z-index:8;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:76px;height:76px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.24);background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);color:#fff;font-size:1.55rem;cursor:pointer;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);transition:all .2s ease}
.center-play:hover{transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1.05);background:var(--primary)}
.player-status{color:#cfd5da;font-size:.79rem;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:42vw}
.player-message{position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:6rem 1.2rem 7rem;color:#fff}
.player-message>div{max-width:680px;width:100%}
#streamsRoot .overlay{z-index:130}
.streams-hero{display:flex;gap:1rem;align-items:center;margin-bottom:1rem}
.streams-hero img{width:58px;height:84px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:9px;background:#111}
.server-skeleton{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;color:var(--text-muted);padding:1rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--surface-border)}
.server-finder-progress{padding:.75rem;border:1px solid var(--surface-border);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface-2);margin:.65rem 0 1rem;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.85rem}
.server-finder-progress-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap;color:var(--text-heading)}
.discovery-source-statuses{display:flex;gap:.35rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.discovery-source-status{border:1px solid var(--surface-border);border-radius:99px;padding:.2rem .5rem;font-size:.72rem}
.server-option{animation:zpRise .3s var(--ease-out) both}
.server-quality-select{width:auto!important;min-width:128px;padding:.42rem .6rem!important}
.variant-chips{display:flex;gap:.4rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:.35rem}
.variant-chips span{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11);border-radius:999px;padding:.14rem .48rem;font-size:.72rem;color:#e8ebee;background:rgba(255,255,255,.035)}
.streams-toolbar{display:flex;gap:.6rem;align-items:end;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:1rem 0}
.streams-toolbar .form-group{margin:0;min-width:180px}
body.tv-mode .poster-card:focus-visible,body.tv-mode button:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px rgba(240,198,107,.45)}
@media(min-width:1200px){.rail-track .poster-card{flex-basis:176px}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(176px,1fr))}.hero-body{padding:2.6rem}.hero-body h1{font-size:3rem}}
@media(max-width:760px){.category-strip{display:none}.player-bar .pt{max-width:42vw}.player-bar .logo-badge>span:last-child{display:none}.player-status{display:none}.volume-wrap input{display:none}.control-select{min-width:104px}.hero{min-height:430px}.hero-trailer iframe{transform:scale(1.55)}}
.setting-switch{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;padding:.62rem 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.055)}
.setting-switch:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.setting-copy label{color:#eef1f3;font-weight:650;font-size:.9rem;cursor:pointer}
.setting-copy small{display:block;color:var(--text-muted);line-height:1.35;margin-top:.15rem;max-width:560px}
.setting-control{position:relative;display:inline-flex;flex:none;cursor:pointer;width:46px;height:24px}
.setting-control input{width:46px;height:24px;cursor:pointer}
.setting-control input:focus-visible+.slider{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}
.settings-hub-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:1px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:1rem}
.settings-hub-grid>div{background:#121518;padding:1rem}
.settings-hub-grid h3{color:#fff;font-size:.98rem;margin-bottom:.35rem}
.settings-hub-grid p{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.84rem;line-height:1.5}
.settings-actions{display:flex;gap:.55rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:.85rem}
.menu-quick-note{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.78rem;line-height:1.45;margin-bottom:.45rem}
body.compact-cards .rail-track .poster-card{flex-basis:138px}
body.compact-cards .grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(138px,1fr))}
body.hide-category-strip .category-strip{display:none!important}
body.reduce-motion *,body.reduce-motion *::before,body.reduce-motion *::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}
body.reduce-motion .poster-card:hover,body.reduce-motion .poster-card:focus-visible,body.reduce-motion .poster-card.is-previewing{transform:none}
.ep{padding:.45rem}
.ep-main{display:flex;gap:.7rem;align-items:center;flex:1;min-width:0;background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--text);text-align:left;cursor:pointer;padding:.15rem}
.ep-main .ep-copy{min-width:0}
.ep-download{flex:none;display:inline-flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:.08rem;border:1px solid rgba(216,179,106,.35);background:rgba(216,179,106,.08);color:#f3d99b;border-radius:9px;padding:.45rem .55rem;cursor:pointer;font-weight:750;font-size:.9rem}
.ep-download small{font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.02em}
.ep-download:hover{background:rgba(216,179,106,.16);border-color:rgba(216,179,106,.65)}
#downloadsRoot .overlay{z-index:150}
.download-modal{max-width:900px}
.download-list{display:grid;gap:.75rem}
.download-job{background:#0d1114;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.075);border-radius:14px;padding:1rem}
.download-job-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:1rem;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}
.download-job h3{color:#fff;font-size:1rem;margin-bottom:.2rem}
.download-meta{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.8rem;line-height:1.5;word-break:break-word}
.download-progress{height:9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin:.75rem 0 .45rem}
.download-progress i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--primary),var(--gold));border-radius:99px;transition:width .25s ease}
.download-stats{display:flex;gap:.9rem;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#d8dde1;font-size:.8rem}
.download-actions{display:flex;gap:.45rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:.75rem}
.download-empty{border:1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:14px;padding:1.2rem;color:var(--text-muted);text-align:center}
.m3u-result{border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);padding:.8rem 0}
.m3u-result code{display:block;word-break:break-all;color:#cfd5da;font-size:.74rem;margin:.25rem 0}
.storage-meter{height:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:.5rem}
.storage-meter i{display:block;height:100%;background:var(--gold)}
@media(max-width:620px){.ep-download small{display:none}.download-job{padding:.85rem}.settings-hub-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}*,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}.poster-card:hover,.poster-card:focus-visible,.poster-card.is-previewing{transform:none}}

/* Continue Watching: wide 16:9 resume cards designed to be scanned from the couch. */
.continue-track .continue-card{flex:0 0 min(360px,78vw);scroll-snap-align:start}
.continue-card{cursor:pointer;position:relative;transition:transform .16s ease;transform-origin:center 70%}
.continue-card:focus-visible{outline:none;transform:scale(1.028);z-index:4}
.continue-media{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:#08090b;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.continue-media>img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.continue-shade{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(0,0,0,.52),transparent 58%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.22),transparent)}
.continue-play{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:58px;height:58px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,.55);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.28);color:#fff;font-size:1.15rem;padding-left:.18rem}
.continue-card:hover .continue-play,.continue-card:focus-visible .continue-play{background:var(--primary)}
.continue-remove{position:absolute;top:.5rem;right:.5rem;z-index:3;background:rgba(0,0,0,.62);color:#fff}
.continue-meta{padding:.58rem .08rem .75rem}
.continue-meta .t{color:var(--text-heading);font-weight:650;font-size:.94rem;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.continue-meta .s{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.78rem;margin-top:.12rem;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.continue-progress{position:relative!important;left:auto!important;right:auto!important;bottom:auto!important;height:5px;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:.48rem}
.continue-actions{display:flex;gap:.42rem;margin-top:.55rem;flex-wrap:wrap}
.category-rail-track .category-rail-tile{flex:0 0 min(300px,72vw);min-height:150px;scroll-snap-align:start}
body.hide-category-strip .home-category-rail{display:none!important}

/* Episode rows lead with a real 16:9 still when TMDB, Cinemeta/MetaHub or TVmaze provides one. */
.ep-thumb{position:relative;flex:0 0 118px;width:118px;aspect-ratio:16/9;border-radius:9px;overflow:hidden;background:#050607;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.ep-thumb>img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.ep-num-badge{position:absolute;left:.35rem;bottom:.35rem;min-width:1.55rem;height:1.55rem;padding:0 .32rem;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.72);color:#fff;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:.76rem;font-weight:800}
.ep-main:focus-visible .ep-thumb{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--focus)}
@media(max-width:620px){.continue-track .continue-card{flex-basis:min(300px,82vw)}.ep-thumb{flex-basis:92px;width:92px}}

/* Android TV / Xiaomi TV Box profile: fewer layers, no expensive blur, and focus that reads at 10 feet. */
body.android-tv{overscroll-behavior:none}
body.android-tv .footer{display:none}
body.android-tv .rail-track{scrollbar-width:none}
body.android-tv .rail-track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
body.android-tv .poster-card:focus-visible{transform:scale(1.06)}
body.android-tv .continue-card:focus-visible{transform:scale(1.035)}
body.tv-performance{scroll-behavior:auto}
body.tv-performance *,body.tv-performance *::before,body.tv-performance *::after{scroll-behavior:auto!important}
body.tv-performance .hero,body.tv-performance .rail,body.tv-performance .panel,body.tv-performance .modal,body.tv-performance .poster-card,body.tv-performance .server-option{animation:none!important}
body.tv-performance .topbar,body.tv-performance .menu-scrim,body.tv-performance .control-btn,body.tv-performance .center-play{backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important}
body.tv-performance .poster-card,body.tv-performance .continue-card,body.tv-performance .category-tile{transition:transform .12s ease,box-shadow .12s ease}
body.tv-performance .poster-wrap>img,body.tv-performance .category-tile img{transition:none!important}
body.tv-performance .poster-card{contain:layout style}
body.tv-performance .hero{box-shadow:0 16px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
body.tv-performance .rail-track{scroll-snap-type:x proximity}
body.android-tv-low-ram .hero-logo{filter:none}
@media(min-width:1500px){body.android-tv .rail-track .poster-card{flex-basis:190px}body.android-tv .continue-track .continue-card{flex-basis:420px}body.android-tv .category-rail-track .category-rail-tile{flex-basis:340px}}


/* One-glance source state for the normal path. Detailed counters live in diagnostics. */
.source-state-panel{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:1.4rem;border-radius:20px!important;padding:1.35rem 1.5rem!important;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(124,58,237,.18),rgba(255,255,255,.035) 55%)!important}
.source-state-main{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:1rem;min-width:0}
.source-state-dot{flex:0 0 18px;width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#35d07f;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(53,208,127,.14),0 0 28px rgba(53,208,127,.35)}
.source-state-panel.is-searching .source-state-dot{background:#f0c66b;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(240,198,107,.14),0 0 28px rgba(240,198,107,.35);animation:zpStatePulse 1.15s ease-in-out infinite}
.source-state-panel.is-problem .source-state-dot{background:#f85149;box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(248,81,73,.14),0 0 28px rgba(248,81,73,.32)}
.source-state-eyebrow{margin:0 0 .12rem;color:var(--gold);font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
.source-state-panel h2{margin:0!important;font-size:1.65rem!important;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.source-state-panel .section-desc{margin:.18rem 0 0!important;font-size:.98rem}
.source-state-actions{display:flex;gap:.55rem;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.discovery-diagnostics{color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.84rem;line-height:1.5;margin:.2rem 0 1rem;word-break:break-word}
@keyframes zpStatePulse{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}50%{transform:scale(1.18)}}
@media(max-width:720px){.source-state-panel{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.source-state-actions{justify-content:flex-start}}

/* Couch-first Android TV: artwork leads, words and choices step back. */
body.android-tv{background:#050607}
body.android-tv .page{max-width:none;padding:1rem clamp(1.4rem,3.2vw,3.4rem) 3.2rem}
body.android-tv .page>h1{font-size:2.25rem;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:.4rem 0 1.2rem}
body.android-tv .page>.lede,body.android-tv .category-strip,body.android-tv #catalogModeChip{display:none!important}
body.android-tv .topbar-inner{max-width:none;flex-wrap:nowrap;padding:.82rem clamp(1.2rem,3vw,3rem)}
body.android-tv .nav{flex-wrap:nowrap}
body.android-tv .nav button{font-size:1.02rem;padding:.72rem 1rem}
body.android-tv .topbar-search{max-width:430px;margin-left:auto}
body.android-tv .topbar-search input{min-height:46px;font-size:1rem}
body.android-tv .topbar-search .btn{display:none}
body.android-tv{overflow-x:hidden}
body.android-tv .overlay{padding:2.5vh 2.5vw;background:rgba(1,4,9,.9)}
body.android-tv .modal{width:min(980px,94vw);max-height:92vh;overflow-y:auto}
body.android-tv .settings-hub-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
body.android-tv .panel,body.android-tv .form-group,body.android-tv .setting-switch,body.android-tv .form-row>*{min-width:0}
body.android-tv .player-bar,body.android-tv .player-controls{padding-left:3vw;padding-right:3vw}
body.android-tv .player-controls #btnPiP,body.android-tv .player-controls #playerRate,body.android-tv .player-controls .volume-wrap,body.android-tv .player-bar #btnPlayerDownload,body.android-tv .player-bar #btnPlayerDetails,body.android-tv #btnFocusEmbed{display:none}
body.android-tv .player-stage:focus{outline:0}
body.android-tv [data-switch-label]:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:999px}
body.android-tv *{backdrop-filter:none!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:none!important}
body.android-tv *,body.android-tv *::before,body.android-tv *::after{transition-duration:.12s!important;animation-duration:.12s!important}
body.android-tv .spinner,body.android-tv .big-spinner{animation-duration:.85s!important}
body.android-tv .poster-card:hover,body.android-tv .continue-card:hover{transform:none}
body.android-tv .logo-badge{font-size:1.3rem}
body.android-tv .logo-mark{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:13px}
body.android-tv .hero{min-height:clamp(440px,60vh,660px);border-radius:26px;margin-bottom:2.7rem}
body.android-tv .hero-body{max-width:820px;padding:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.6rem)}
body.android-tv .hero-body h1{font-size:clamp(3rem,5.2vw,5.4rem);letter-spacing:-.055em}
body.android-tv .hero-body p{font-size:1.14rem;line-height:1.55;-webkit-line-clamp:2}
body.android-tv .hero-actions{gap:.8rem}
body.android-tv .hero-actions .btn{min-height:56px;padding:.95rem 1.55rem;font-size:1.05rem;border-radius:999px}
body.android-tv #heroServers,body.android-tv #heroList,body.android-tv .trailer-ctl{display:none!important}
body.android-tv .rail{margin-bottom:2.65rem}
body.android-tv .rail-head{margin-bottom:.85rem}
body.android-tv .rail-head h2{font-size:1.72rem;letter-spacing:-.035em}
body.android-tv .rail-arrows,body.android-tv .rail-progress{display:none!important}
body.android-tv .rail-track{gap:1.15rem;padding:.5rem .2rem 1rem}
body.android-tv .rail-track .poster-card{flex-basis:clamp(210px,15.5vw,264px)}
body.android-tv .grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:1.45rem}
body.android-tv .poster-wrap{border-radius:18px}
body.android-tv .poster-badges,body.android-tv .preview-badge,body.android-tv .hover-actions,body.android-tv .card-overview{display:none!important}
body.android-tv .poster-card:focus-visible .poster-wrap::after{content:"▶";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(0,0,0,.58);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.32);color:#fff;font-size:1.25rem;padding-left:.2rem}
body.android-tv .poster-meta{padding:.72rem .12rem .8rem}
body.android-tv .poster-meta .t{font-size:1.08rem}
body.android-tv .poster-meta .s{display:none}
body.android-tv .poster-rate{font-size:.92rem;padding:.32rem .55rem}
body.android-tv .continue-rail{margin-top:.35rem}
body.android-tv .continue-track .continue-card{flex-basis:clamp(430px,34vw,570px)}
body.android-tv .continue-media{border-radius:22px}
body.android-tv .continue-play{width:72px;height:72px;font-size:1.4rem}
body.android-tv .continue-meta .t{font-size:1.18rem}
body.android-tv .continue-meta .s{font-size:.94rem}
body.android-tv .continue-actions{display:none}
body.android-tv .category-rail-track .category-rail-tile{flex-basis:clamp(365px,27vw,470px);min-height:212px}
body.android-tv .category-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(365px,1fr));gap:1.35rem}
body.android-tv .category-tile{min-height:212px;border-radius:22px}
body.android-tv .category-tile b{margin-top:7.6rem;font-size:1.55rem}
body.android-tv .category-tile span{font-size:.96rem}
body.android-tv .filters,body.android-tv .menu-category-list,body.android-tv .menu-quick-note,body.android-tv #menuQuickSettings .settings-actions{display:none!important}
body.android-tv .category-quick{gap:.65rem;margin-bottom:1.6rem}
body.android-tv .chip-btn{min-height:48px;padding:.68rem 1.05rem;font-size:.98rem}
body.android-tv .menu-drawer{width:min(440px,36vw);padding:1.4rem}
body.android-tv .menu-link{min-height:54px;font-size:1.08rem;padding:.8rem .75rem}
body.android-tv .setting-switch{padding:.85rem 0}
body.android-tv .setting-copy label{font-size:1.02rem}
body.android-tv .setting-copy small{display:none}
body.android-tv .source-state-panel{padding:1.6rem 1.8rem!important;margin-bottom:1.4rem}
body.android-tv .source-state-panel h2{font-size:2.2rem!important}
body.android-tv .source-state-panel .section-desc{font-size:1.08rem}
body.android-tv .source-state-actions .btn{min-height:52px;padding:.85rem 1.25rem;font-size:1rem}
body.android-tv .modal{width:min(1500px,96vw);border-radius:24px}
body.android-tv .detail-hero{min-height:390px}
body.android-tv .detail-body{grid-template-columns:235px 1fr;gap:2rem;padding:2rem 2.4rem 2.2rem;margin-top:-110px}
body.android-tv .detail-poster{width:235px;border-radius:16px}
body.android-tv .detail-body h2{font-size:2.5rem}
body.android-tv .detail-body .overview{font-size:1.08rem;line-height:1.6}
body.android-tv .detail-actions .btn,body.android-tv .detail-actions .control-select{min-height:54px;font-size:1rem}
body.android-tv .modal .help-text{display:none}
body.android-tv .detail-section{padding:0 2.4rem 1.8rem}
body.android-tv .detail-section h3{font-size:1.35rem}
body.android-tv .ep-list{grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(350px,1fr));gap:.9rem}
body.android-tv .ep-thumb{flex-basis:172px;width:172px;border-radius:12px}
body.android-tv .ep .et{font-size:.98rem}
body.android-tv .ep .es{font-size:.84rem}
@media(min-width:1700px){body.android-tv .rail-track .poster-card{flex-basis:274px}body.android-tv .continue-track .continue-card{flex-basis:590px}}
@media(max-width:1100px){body.android-tv .topbar-search{display:none}body.android-tv .detail-body{grid-template-columns:180px 1fr}body.android-tv .detail-poster{width:180px}}

/* Personalization and accessibility options from the TV redesign reference. */
.ui-preferences{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:.75rem;margin:.6rem 0 .35rem}
.ui-preferences .form-group{margin:0;min-width:0}
.ui-preferences label{font-size:.82rem}
body.theme-oled{--bg:#000;--surface:#090909;--surface2:#111;--surface-border:#262626;background:#000}
body.theme-oled .topbar{background:rgba(0,0,0,.96)}
body.theme-oled .topbar.is-scrolled{background:rgba(0,0,0,.98)}
body.theme-oled .menu-drawer{background:#080808}
body.theme-warm{--bg:#171411;--surface:#211b16;--surface2:#2b231d;--surface-border:#4a3c30;--primary:#a78bfa;--primary-hover:#8b5cf6;--text:#e7ddd2;--text-heading:#fff9ef;--text-muted:#c5b8aa;--text-dim:#9e8f80;--gold:#edc878;--focus:#ffdc91;background:radial-gradient(1000px 500px at 18% -8%,rgba(124,58,237,.15),transparent 58%),radial-gradient(900px 460px at 88% 0%,rgba(237,200,120,.1),transparent 55%),var(--bg)}
body.theme-warm .topbar{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(24,20,16,.97),rgba(24,20,16,.88))}
body.theme-warm .topbar.is-scrolled{background:rgba(24,20,16,.97)}
body.theme-warm .menu-drawer{background:#211b16}
body.theme-light{--bg:#f2f4f7;--surface:#fff;--surface2:#e9edf2;--surface-border:#d1d8e0;--primary:#6d28d9;--primary-hover:#5b21b6;--primary-soft:rgba(109,40,217,.1);--text:#34404c;--text-heading:#151b22;--text-muted:#596674;--text-dim:#758291;--gold:#8a6200;--focus:#6d28d9;background:radial-gradient(900px 420px at 18% -8%,rgba(124,58,237,.08),transparent 58%),#f2f4f7}
body.theme-light .topbar{background:rgba(246,247,249,.96);border-bottom-color:#d8dde3}
body.theme-light .topbar.is-scrolled{background:rgba(246,247,249,.98)}
body.theme-light .topbar .nav button{color:#43505e}
body.theme-light .topbar .nav button.active{color:#231b35;background:rgba(109,40,217,.09)}
body.theme-light .menu-button{color:#292433;background:#fff;border-color:#d5dbe3}
body.theme-light .category-strip button{color:#43505e;background:rgba(255,255,255,.8);border-color:#d4dbe3}
body.theme-light .zp-sidebar-label{color:#737f8c}
body.theme-light .topbar-search input,body.theme-light input[type="text"],body.theme-light input[type="password"],body.theme-light input[type="number"],body.theme-light input[type="search"],body.theme-light select,body.theme-light textarea{background:#fff;color:#1b2430;border-color:#cfd6df}
body.theme-light .zp-sidebar{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#f5f6f8);border-right-color:#d6dce3}
body.theme-light .zp-sidebar .zp-rail-link{color:#596674}
body.theme-light .zp-sidebar .zp-rail-link:hover{color:#171b22;background:rgba(109,40,217,.06)}
body.theme-light .zp-sidebar .zp-rail-link.active{color:#2b174d;background:rgba(109,40,217,.1);border-color:rgba(109,40,217,.14)}
body.theme-light .zp-sidebar-footcard{border-color:#dce1e7;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(109,40,217,.07),rgba(255,255,255,.8))}
body.theme-light .panel{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff,#f7f8fa);border-color:#dce1e7;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(29,41,57,.08)}
body.theme-light .menu-drawer{background:#fff;color:#202732;border-color:#d8dde3}
body.theme-light .menu-drawer h2,body.theme-light .menu-link{color:#202732}
body.theme-light .menu-link:hover{background:#f0edf7}
body.theme-light .menu-section{border-color:#e1e5ea}
body.theme-light .mobile-bottom-nav{background:rgba(250,250,252,.96);border-color:#d8dde3}
body.theme-light .mobile-bottom-nav button.active{color:#5b21b6;background:rgba(109,40,217,.08)}
body.high-contrast{--text:#fff;--text-heading:#fff;--text-muted:#e1e1e1;--text-dim:#c8c8c8;--surface-border:#737b84;--gold:#ffe17a;--focus:#ffe17a}
body.high-contrast .panel,body.high-contrast .modal,body.high-contrast .menu-drawer{border:1px solid var(--surface-border)}
body.high-contrast button:focus-visible,body.high-contrast a:focus-visible,body.high-contrast input:focus-visible,body.high-contrast select:focus-visible,body.high-contrast textarea:focus-visible{outline-width:3px;outline-offset:3px}
html.font-large{font-size:17px}
html.font-xl{font-size:19px}
@media(max-width:620px){.ui-preferences{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* New ZeroPlay shell: persistent desktop rail, touch-first mobile dock,
   and larger, calmer surfaces. All existing routes and handlers stay intact. */
.zp-sidebar{display:none}
.zp-sidebar-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.78rem;padding:.8rem .7rem 1.75rem;color:var(--text-heading);font-size:1.16rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.035em}
.zp-sidebar-brand:hover{text-decoration:none}
.zp-brand-mark{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#8b5cf6,#6d28d9);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#fff;font-size:.95rem;box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(124,58,237,.35)}
.zp-sidebar-brand small{display:block;margin-top:.2rem;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:.57rem;font-weight:750;letter-spacing:.14em}
.zp-sidebar-label{padding:.35rem .8rem .55rem;color:var(--text-dim);font-size:.65rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase}
.zp-sidebar-label-spaced{margin-top:1.45rem}
.zp-sidebar .zp-rail-nav{display:grid;gap:.25rem}
.zp-sidebar .zp-rail-link{width:100%;min-height:46px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.9rem;text-align:left;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:12px;padding:.65rem .8rem;color:var(--text-muted);background:transparent;font-size:.91rem;font-weight:650;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,transform .18s ease}
.zp-sidebar .zp-rail-link:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.055);color:var(--text-heading);transform:translateX(2px)}
.zp-sidebar .zp-rail-link.active{color:var(--text-heading);background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(124,58,237,.22),rgba(124,58,237,.075));border-color:rgba(167,139,250,.13);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 #8b5cf6}
.zp-rail-icon{width:22px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#a78bfa;font-size:1.12rem;font-weight:700}
.zp-sidebar-genres{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.45rem;padding:0 .65rem}
.zp-sidebar-genres button{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:rgba(255,255,255,.035);border-radius:999px;padding:.38rem .65rem;color:var(--text-muted);font-size:.71rem;font-weight:650;cursor:pointer}
.zp-sidebar-genres button:hover{color:#fff;border-color:rgba(167,139,250,.5);background:rgba(124,58,237,.13)}
.zp-sidebar-spacer{flex:1;min-height:1.5rem}
.zp-sidebar-footcard{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.7rem;padding:.85rem .75rem;margin:.7rem .05rem 1rem;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(124,58,237,.12),rgba(255,255,255,.025))}
.zp-footcard-orb{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:11px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(124,58,237,.22);color:#c4b5fd}
.zp-sidebar-footcard strong,.zp-sidebar-footcard small{display:block}
.zp-sidebar-footcard strong{font-size:.73rem;color:var(--text-heading)}
.zp-sidebar-footcard small{font-size:.62rem;color:var(--text-dim);margin-top:.15rem}
.zp-settings-link{margin-top:.25rem}
.mobile-bottom-nav{display:none}
/* Refined reading surfaces and clear focus affordances. */
.panel{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.065);border-radius:18px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(29,33,37,.96),rgba(20,23,26,.98));box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
.hero{border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.32)}
.hero-body h1{max-width:15ch;text-wrap:balance}
.hero-actions .btn-primary{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8b5cf6,#6d28d9);box-shadow:0 9px 24px rgba(109,40,217,.24)}
.poster-wrap{border-radius:14px;box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.18),inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.poster-card:focus-visible .poster-wrap{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(167,139,250,.88),0 18px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
.rail-head h2{font-size:1.28rem;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.mobile-bottom-nav button:focus-visible,.zp-sidebar button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #b794f6;outline-offset:2px}
@media(min-width:980px){
  body:not(.android-tv) .zp-sidebar{position:fixed;inset:0 auto 0 0;z-index:70;width:250px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:1.15rem .9rem 1rem;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#15171b 0%,#111316 65%,#101214 100%);border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);box-shadow:12px 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.14);overflow-y:auto}

/* Combined user-provided TV previews: premium violet/gold surfaces with
   cyan/teal focus cues. Persistent navigation contains browse routes only;
   optional tools remain behind the explicit menu button. */
:root{--zp-electric:#00d09c;--zp-cyan:#0aa9ff;--zp-focus:#00e5ff}
body:not(.theme-light):not(.theme-warm):not(.theme-oled){--bg:#0b0f13;--surface:#11171d;--surface2:#151d25;--surface-border:#24313a;--text:#dce5e9;--text-heading:#f3f7f8;--text-muted:#93a4ae;--text-dim:#71828c;background:radial-gradient(1000px 460px at 18% -12%,rgba(0,208,156,.08),transparent 62%),radial-gradient(1100px 520px at 96% 2%,rgba(124,58,237,.13),transparent 60%),#0b0f13}
.zp-sidebar{display:none;box-sizing:border-box}

.zp-sidebar-label{color:var(--text-dim)}
.zp-sidebar .zp-rail-link{min-height:48px;border-radius:13px;color:var(--text-muted)}
.zp-sidebar .zp-rail-link:hover{background:rgba(0,208,156,.08);color:var(--text-heading)}
.zp-sidebar .zp-rail-link.active{color:var(--text-heading);background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,208,156,.14),rgba(124,58,237,.08));border-color:rgba(0,208,156,.15);box-shadow:inset 3px 0 var(--zp-electric)}
.zp-rail-icon{color:var(--zp-electric)}
.zp-sidebar-more{width:100%;min-height:46px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.8rem;margin-top:.3rem;padding:.65rem .8rem;border:1px solid rgba(0,208,156,.19);border-radius:13px;background:rgba(0,208,156,.07);color:var(--text-heading);font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}
.zp-sidebar-more:hover{background:rgba(0,208,156,.13)}
.zp-sidebar-footcard{border-color:rgba(0,208,156,.12);background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(0,208,156,.08),rgba(124,58,237,.07))}

.zp-sidebar button:focus-visible,.mobile-bottom-nav button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--zp-focus);outline-offset:3px}

body:not(.theme-light):not(.theme-warm):not(.theme-oled) .btn:focus-visible,body:not(.theme-light):not(.theme-warm):not(.theme-oled) .poster-card:focus-visible,body:not(.theme-light):not(.theme-warm):not(.theme-oled) .continue-card:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--zp-focus);outline-offset:4px}
body:not(.theme-light):not(.theme-warm):not(.theme-oled) .chip.rd{border-color:rgba(0,208,156,.32);color:#66e5c0;background:rgba(0,208,156,.09)}

body:not(.android-tv) .topbar-inner{max-width:none;padding:.72rem clamp(1rem,2.4vw,2rem)}

body:not(.android-tv) #view>.page{max-width:none;padding:1.6rem clamp(1.2rem,3vw,3rem) 2.5rem}
.menu-scrim{background:transparent;backdrop-filter:none}
.menu-drawer{top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 4.6rem);left:clamp(.75rem,2vw,1.5rem);bottom:auto;width:min(390px,calc(100vw - 1.5rem));max-height:calc(100dvh - 5.4rem);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 24px 64px rgba(0,0,0,.55);transform:translateY(-8px) scale(.98);transform-origin:top left;opacity:0;transition:opacity .18s ease,transform .18s ease,visibility 0s linear .18s}

}
@media(max-width:620px){body:not(.android-tv) .topbar-inner{padding:.62rem .78rem;gap:.6rem}body:not(.android-tv) .topbar-search{order:3;flex-basis:100%;min-width:0}body:not(.android-tv) .topbar-search input{min-height:44px}body:not(.android-tv) #view{padding-bottom:6rem}}

</style>

<script>
"use strict";
/* =====================================================================
   ZeroPlay (single-file build)
   - Zero-config catalogue: server-side TMDB when a deployment provides it,
     otherwise keyless Cinemeta, otherwise offline demo data.
   - Continuous crawlers identify servers/addons before installing them.
   - A canonical title identifier verifies movie/series/episode candidates.
   ===================================================================== */

/* ---------------- Android TV shell profile ---------------- */
const APP_VERSION="4.3.0";
const ZERO_PLAY_TV_PARAMS=new URLSearchParams(location.search||"");
const ANDROID_TV_APP=/^(1|true|yes)$/i.test(ZERO_PLAY_TV_PARAMS.get("androidtv")||"")||/ZeroPlayTV\//i.test(navigator.userAgent||"")||!!window.ZeroPlayAndroidTV;
const ANDROID_TV_PROFILE=(()=>{try{return ANDROID_TV_APP&&window.ZeroPlayAndroidTV&&typeof window.ZeroPlayAndroidTV.getProfileJson==="function"?JSON.parse(window.ZeroPlayAndroidTV.getProfileJson()||"{}"):{}}catch(_){return{}}})();
const ANDROID_TV_TOTAL_RAM_MB=Math.round(Number(ANDROID_TV_PROFILE&&ANDROID_TV_PROFILE.totalMemoryMb||0));
const ANDROID_TV_LOW_RAM=!!(ANDROID_TV_PROFILE&&(ANDROID_TV_PROFILE.lowRamDevice||(ANDROID_TV_TOTAL_RAM_MB>0&&ANDROID_TV_TOTAL_RAM_MB<=2560)));

/* ---------------- storage ---------------- */
const LS = { settings:"zp_rd_settings_v1", watchlist:"zp_rd_watchlist_v1", progress:"zp_rd_progress_v1" };
const loadJSON = (k,f)=>{ try{ const v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)); return v??f; }catch{ return f; } };
const saveJSON = (k,v)=>{ try{ localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v)); }catch{} };

let settings = Object.assign({
  source:"vidstuck", disabledSources:[]
}, loadJSON(LS.settings,{}));
const LEGACY_SETTING_KEYS=["tmdbKey","rdToken","rdUser","addonBase","debrid","debridManifestUrl","siteCatalogues"];
const hadLegacySettings=LEGACY_SETTING_KEYS.some(k=>Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(settings,k));
for(const k of LEGACY_SETTING_KEYS) delete settings[k]; /* no user API keys and no Real-Debrid configuration */
settings.stream=Object.assign({preload:"smart",player:"faststream-only",raceTimeoutSec:20,stallSwitch:true,stallTimeoutSec:45,quality:"auto",resolutions:["2160p","1080p","720p","480p"],maxFileSizeGb:5,dataSaver:"auto",dnsWarm:true,sortByHealth:true,trailerPreviews:!ANDROID_TV_APP,volume:.9,muted:false,rate:1,autoFailover:true,embedwaveFailover:false,fastStreamApiProbe:true,nextEpisodeWarm:true,primeThreads:ANDROID_TV_APP?1:2,primeChunkKb:ANDROID_TV_APP?128:256,primeBudgetMb:ANDROID_TV_APP?1:2,bufferTargetSec:ANDROID_TV_APP?12:16},settings.stream||{});
settings.ui=Object.assign({autoplayNext:true,reduceMotion:ANDROID_TV_APP,compactCards:false,showCategoryStrip:true,tvPerformanceMode:ANDROID_TV_APP,androidTvLaunchFocus:true,theme:"dark",textScale:"normal",highContrast:false},settings.ui||{});
settings.downloads=Object.assign({enabled:true,multithreaded:true,threads:ANDROID_TV_APP?2:4,chunkMb:ANDROID_TV_APP?1:2,concurrent:1,m3uExtraction:true,autoSave:true,autoResume:false,refreshExpired:true,keepCompleted:true},settings.downloads||{});
if(settings.stream.player==="auto"||settings.stream.player==="faststream") settings.stream.player="faststream-only"; /* FastStream is the default for every verified direct stream; native playback remains an explicit fallback. */
if(!(Number(settings.stream.maxFileSizeGb)>0)||Number(settings.stream.maxFileSizeGb)>5) settings.stream.maxFileSizeGb=5;
if(settings.source==="embedwave") settings.source="vidstuck"; /* Embedwave is last-resort only — never the saved default */
if(!Array.isArray(settings.customSources)) settings.customSources=[];
if(!Array.isArray(settings.disabledSources)) settings.disabledSources=[];
settings.feed=Object.assign({url:"",auto:true,intervalMin:15,lastCheck:0,healthAuto:true,addonsAuto:true,lastAddonCheck:0},settings.feed||{});
settings.discovery=Object.assign({
  autoStart:true, intervalSec:ANDROID_TV_APP?180:90, githubPausedUntil:0,
  crawlers:{catalogGraph:true,stremioAddons:true,github:true,githubProbe:true,candidateIdentification:true,feeds:true,websites:true,health:true},

function initials(t){ return String(t||"?").trim().split(/\s+/).slice(0,2).map(w=>w[0]).join("").toUpperCase()||"?"; }
function phSVG(title,seed,w,h){
  const hue=Math.abs(Number(seed)||7)*47%360;
  const svg="<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='"+w+"' height='"+h+"'><rect width='100%' height='100%' fill='hsl("+hue+",24%,17%)'/><text x='50%' y='47%' font-family='Arial,sans-serif' font-size='"+Math.round(h*0.2)+"' font-weight='bold' fill='rgba(245,245,242,.92)' text-anchor='middle'>"+esc(initials(title))+"</text><text x='50%' y='60%' font-family='Arial,sans-serif' font-size='"+Math.round(h*0.052)+"' fill='rgba(220,224,227,.82)' text-anchor='middle'>"+esc(String(title||"").slice(0,34))+"</text><text x='50%' y='93%' font-family='Arial,sans-serif' font-size='"+Math.round(h*0.045)+"' fill='#c4b5fd' text-anchor='middle'>ZeroPlay</text></svg>";
  return "data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,"+encodeURIComponent(svg);
}
const IMG = "https://image.tmdb.org/t/p/";
function posterURL(it,size="w342"){

  if(ANDROID_TV_APP) size="w342"; else if(effectiveSaver()) size={w500:"w342",w342:"w185"}[size]||size;
  return it&&it.poster_path ? IMG+size+it.poster_path : phSVG(titleOf(it),it&&it.id,342,513);
}
function backdropURL(it,size="w1280"){

  if(cached&&cached.poster) return cached.poster;
  if(it&&it.poster_url) return typeof cleanArtworkUrl==="function"?(cleanArtworkUrl(it.poster_url,"backdrop")||phSVG(titleOf(it),it&&it.id,1280,720)):it.poster_url;

const keyOf = (type,id)=>type+":"+id;

function clampSettingNumber(value,min,max,fallback){ const n=Number(value); return Number.isFinite(n)?Math.max(min,Math.min(max,n)):fallback; }
function tvPerformanceEnabled(){ return !!(typeof ANDROID_TV_APP!=="undefined"&&ANDROID_TV_APP&&settings.ui&&settings.ui.tvPerformanceMode!==false); }
function streamCfg(){ const st=settings.stream||(settings.stream={}); st.raceTimeoutSec=clampSettingNumber(st.raceTimeoutSec,15,60,20); st.stallTimeoutSec=clampSettingNumber(st.stallTimeoutSec,30,120,45); st.primeThreads=Math.round(clampSettingNumber(st.primeThreads,1,4,2)); st.primeChunkKb=Math.round(clampSettingNumber(st.primeChunkKb,64,1024,256)); st.primeBudgetMb=clampSettingNumber(st.primeBudgetMb,.25,8,2); st.bufferTargetSec=clampSettingNumber(st.bufferTargetSec,6,60,16); if(tvPerformanceEnabled()){ st.primeThreads=Math.min(st.primeThreads,1); st.primeChunkKb=Math.min(st.primeChunkKb,128); st.primeBudgetMb=Math.min(st.primeBudgetMb,1); st.bufferTargetSec=Math.min(st.bufferTargetSec,12); } return st; }
function downloadCfg(){ const d=settings.downloads||(settings.downloads={}); d.threads=Math.round(clampSettingNumber(d.threads,1,8,4)); d.chunkMb=clampSettingNumber(d.chunkMb,.25,8,2); d.concurrent=Math.round(clampSettingNumber(d.concurrent,1,3,1)); if(tvPerformanceEnabled()){ d.threads=Math.min(d.threads,2); d.chunkMb=Math.min(d.chunkMb,1); d.concurrent=1; } return d; }
function embedLoadTimeoutMs(){ return streamCfg().raceTimeoutSec*1000; }
function embedStallTimeoutMs(){ return streamCfg().stallTimeoutSec*1000; }
function downloadsEnabled(){ return downloadCfg().enabled!==false; }
function applyInterfaceSettings(){
  const ui=settings.ui||{};
  const isAndroidTv=typeof ANDROID_TV_APP!=="undefined"&&ANDROID_TV_APP;
  const isLowRamTv=typeof ANDROID_TV_LOW_RAM!=="undefined"&&ANDROID_TV_LOW_RAM;
  const theme=["dark","oled","warm","light"].includes(ui.theme)?ui.theme:"dark";
  const textScale=["normal","large","xl"].includes(ui.textScale)?ui.textScale:"normal";
  ui.theme=theme; ui.textScale=textScale; ui.highContrast=!!ui.highContrast;
  document.body.classList.toggle("theme-oled",theme==="oled");
  document.body.classList.toggle("theme-warm",theme==="warm");
  const root=document.documentElement;
  if(root&&root.classList){ root.classList.toggle("font-large",textScale==="large"); root.classList.toggle("font-xl",textScale==="xl"); }
  document.body.classList.toggle("high-contrast",ui.highContrast);
  document.body.classList.toggle("reduce-motion",!!ui.reduceMotion);
  document.body.classList.toggle("compact-cards",!!ui.compactCards);
  document.body.classList.toggle("hide-category-strip",ui.showCategoryStrip===false);
  document.body.classList.toggle("android-tv",isAndroidTv);
  document.body.classList.toggle("tv-performance",tvPerformanceEnabled());
  document.body.classList.toggle("android-tv-low-ram",!!(isAndroidTv&&isLowRamTv));
  syncFeatureToggles();
  document.querySelectorAll("[data-ui-preference]").forEach(control=>{
    const key=control.dataset.uiPreference;
    if(key==="highContrast") control.checked=!!ui.highContrast;
    else if(key==="theme") control.value=theme;
    else if(key==="textScale") control.value=textScale;
  });
}
function getFeatureToggle(key){
  const st=streamCfg(), d=downloadCfg(), ui=settings.ui||{}, cfg=(settings.discovery||{});
  switch(key){
    case "discovery": return !!cfg.autoStart;
    case "trailers": return st.trailerPreviews!==false;
    case "autoFailover": return st.autoFailover!==false;
    case "stallSwitch": return !!st.stallSwitch;
    case "embedwaveFailover": return !!st.embedwaveFailover;
    case "preload": return st.preload!=="off";
    case "dnsWarm": return !!st.dnsWarm;
    case "sortByHealth": return !!st.sortByHealth;
    case "fastStreamProbe": return st.fastStreamApiProbe!==false;
    case "nextEpisodeWarm": return st.nextEpisodeWarm!==false;
    case "downloads": return d.enabled!==false;
    case "multithreadedDownloads": return d.multithreaded!==false;
    case "m3uExtraction": return d.m3uExtraction!==false;
    case "downloadAutoSave": return d.autoSave!==false;
    case "downloadAutoResume": return !!d.autoResume;
    case "refreshExpiredDownloads": return d.refreshExpired!==false;
    case "keepCompletedDownloads": return d.keepCompleted!==false;
    case "autoplayNext": return ui.autoplayNext!==false;
    case "reduceMotion": return !!ui.reduceMotion;
    case "compactCards": return !!ui.compactCards;
    case "categoryStrip": return ui.showCategoryStrip!==false;
    case "tvPerformance": return ui.tvPerformanceMode!==false;
    case "tvLaunchFocus": return ui.androidTvLaunchFocus!==false;
    case "artworkFallback": return !settings.artwork||settings.artwork.enabled!==false;
    case "artworkCinemeta": return !settings.artwork||settings.artwork.cinemeta!==false;
    case "artworkTvmaze": return !settings.artwork||settings.artwork.tvmaze!==false;
    case "artworkAnilist": return !settings.artwork||settings.artwork.anilist!==false;
    case "artworkItunes": return !settings.artwork||settings.artwork.itunes!==false;
    default: return false;
  }
}
function setFeatureToggle(key,checked){
  const st=streamCfg(), d=downloadCfg(), ui=settings.ui||(settings.ui={});
  switch(key){
    case "discovery": if(checked) startDiscoveryEngine(true,true); else stopDiscoveryEngine(true); break;
    case "trailers": st.trailerPreviews=checked; if(!checked){ try{ stopCardPreview(); document.querySelectorAll(".hero-trailer.on").forEach(stopBackdropPreview); }catch{} } break;
    case "autoFailover": st.autoFailover=checked; break;
    case "stallSwitch": st.stallSwitch=checked; break;
    case "embedwaveFailover": st.embedwaveFailover=checked; break;
    case "preload": if(checked) st.preload=st.preloadLastMode==="aggressive"?"aggressive":"smart"; else { if(st.preload&&st.preload!=="off") st.preloadLastMode=st.preload; st.preload="off"; } break;
    case "dnsWarm": st.dnsWarm=checked; if(checked) setTimeout(()=>{ try{ warmAllSources(); }catch{} },0); break;
    case "sortByHealth": st.sortByHealth=checked; break;
    case "fastStreamProbe": st.fastStreamApiProbe=checked; break;
    case "nextEpisodeWarm": st.nextEpisodeWarm=checked; break;
    case "downloads": d.enabled=checked; if(!checked&&typeof pauseAllDownloads==="function") pauseAllDownloads("Downloads were turned off in Settings"); if(checked&&typeof scheduleDownloads==="function") setTimeout(()=>scheduleDownloads(),0); break;
    case "multithreadedDownloads": d.multithreaded=checked; break;
    case "m3uExtraction": d.m3uExtraction=checked; break;
    case "downloadAutoSave": d.autoSave=checked; break;
    case "downloadAutoResume": d.autoResume=checked; break;
    case "refreshExpiredDownloads": d.refreshExpired=checked; break;
    case "keepCompletedDownloads": d.keepCompleted=checked; break;
    case "autoplayNext": ui.autoplayNext=checked; break;
    case "reduceMotion": ui.reduceMotion=checked; break;
    case "compactCards": ui.compactCards=checked; break;
    case "categoryStrip": ui.showCategoryStrip=checked; break;
    case "tvPerformance": ui.tvPerformanceMode=checked; try{ if(checked){ stopCardPreview(); document.querySelectorAll(".hero-trailer.on").forEach(stopBackdropPreview); } }catch{} break;
    case "tvLaunchFocus": ui.androidTvLaunchFocus=checked; break;
    case "artworkFallback": (settings.artwork||(settings.artwork={})).enabled=checked; break;
    case "artworkCinemeta": (settings.artwork||(settings.artwork={})).cinemeta=checked; break;
    case "artworkTvmaze": (settings.artwork||(settings.artwork={})).tvmaze=checked; break;
    case "artworkAnilist": (settings.artwork||(settings.artwork={})).anilist=checked; break;
    case "artworkItunes": (settings.artwork||(settings.artwork={})).itunes=checked; break;
    default: return;
  }
  saveSettings(); applyInterfaceSettings();
