function syncFeatureToggles(root){
  $$("[data-feature-toggle]",root||document).forEach(input=>{ input.checked=getFeatureToggle(input.dataset.featureToggle); });
}
function featureSwitchHTML(key,label,description,idSuffix){
  const id="feature-"+key+(idSuffix?"-"+idSuffix:"");
  return '<div class="setting-switch"><div class="setting-copy"><label for="'+id+'">'+esc(label)+'</label>'+(description?'<small>'+esc(description)+'</small>':"")+'</div><label tabindex="0" data-switch-label="1" class="switch-label setting-control" for="'+id+'"><input type="checkbox" id="'+id+'" data-feature-toggle="'+esc(key)+'"'+(getFeatureToggle(key)?" checked":"")+'><span class="slider"></span></label></div>';

document.addEventListener("change",e=>{
  const input=e.target&&e.target.closest?e.target.closest("[data-feature-toggle]"):null;
  if(!input) return;
  setFeatureToggle(input.dataset.featureToggle,input.checked);
  syncFeatureToggles();

document.addEventListener("change",e=>{
  const control=e.target&&e.target.closest?e.target.closest("[data-ui-preference]"):null;
  if(!control) return;
  const ui=settings.ui||(settings.ui={});
  const key=control.dataset.uiPreference;
  if(key==="theme") ui.theme=["dark","oled","warm","light"].includes(control.value)?control.value:"dark";
  else if(key==="textScale") ui.textScale=["normal","large","xl"].includes(control.value)?control.value:"normal";
  else if(key==="highContrast") ui.highContrast=!!control.checked;
  saveSettings(); applyInterfaceSettings();

/* ---------------- built-in title identifier ----------------
   The catalogue item is converted into one canonical identity: TMDB id,
   IMDb id, media type, release year, season/episode and every known title
   variant. Crawled servers/addons are searchable, but a candidate result is
   only accepted when this identifier says it is the requested work. */
function identityNormalizeTitle(value){
  return String(value||"")
    .replace(/\s*\(source test\)\s*$/i,"")
    .normalize("NFKD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,"")
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/&/g," and ")
    .replace(/\b(the|a|an)\b/g," ")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g," ")
    .replace(/\s+/g," ")
    .trim();
}
function identityUnique(values){
  const out=[], seen=new Set();
  for(const v of values||[]){
    const s=String(v||"").trim();
    if(!s) continue;
    const k=s.toLowerCase();
    if(seen.has(k)) continue;
    seen.add(k); out.push(s);
  }
  return out;
}
function identityAlternativeTitles(raw){
  const out=[];
  const push=v=>{ if(v) out.push(v); };
  const alt=raw&&(raw.alternative_titles||raw.alternativeTitles);
  if(Array.isArray(raw&&raw.altTitles)) raw.altTitles.forEach(push);
  if(Array.isArray(raw&&raw.alternatives)) raw.alternatives.forEach(push);
  if(raw){
    push(raw.original_title); push(raw.original_name); push(raw.originalTitle); push(raw.originalName);
  }
  if(alt){
    const lists=[alt.titles,alt.results,Array.isArray(alt)?alt:null].filter(Array.isArray);
    for(const list of lists) for(const x of list) push(typeof x==="string"?x:(x&&(x.title||x.name)));
  }
  return identityUnique(out).slice(0,40);
}
function identityParseEpisode(text){
  const s=String(text||"").replace(/[_./-]+/g," ").toLowerCase();
  let m=s.match(/\bs\s*(\d{1,3})\s*e\s*(\d{1,4})\b/);
  if(m) return {season:Number(m[1]),episode:Number(m[2])};
  m=s.match(/\bseason\s*(\d{1,3})\b[^\d]{0,24}\bepisode\s*(\d{1,4})\b/);
  if(m) return {season:Number(m[1]),episode:Number(m[2])};
  m=s.match(/\b(\d{1,2})x(\d{1,4})\b/);
  if(m) return {season:Number(m[1]),episode:Number(m[2])};
  const season=(s.match(/\b(?:season|series|part|cour)\s*(\d{1,3})\b/)||[])[1];
  const episode=(s.match(/\b(?:episode|ep)\s*(\d{1,4})\b/)||[])[1];
  return {season:season==null?null:Number(season),episode:episode==null?null:Number(episode)};
}
function identityExtractIds(text){
  const s=String(text||"");
  const imdb=(s.match(/\btt\d{6,}\b/i)||[])[0]||"";
  const tmdbMatch=s.match(/\btmdb(?:[:/_-]|%3a)(\d{2,})\b/i)||s.match(/[?&](?:tmdb|tmdb_id)=(\d{2,})\b/i);
  return {imdbId:imdb.toLowerCase(),tmdbId:tmdbMatch?Number(tmdbMatch[1]):null};
}
function identityCandidateSlug(url){
  try{
    const u=new URL(String(url||""));
    const parts=u.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).map(x=>{ try{return decodeURIComponent(x);}catch{return x;} });
    const useful=parts.filter(p=>!/^(anime|movie|movies|tv|series|show|watch|detail|info|play|title|video|stream|embed|episode|season|ep-\d+|\d+)$/i.test(p));
    return identityNormalizeTitle(useful.join(" ").replace(/[-_]+/g," "));
  }catch{ return ""; }
}
function identityCleanCandidateTitle(value){
  let s=identityNormalizeTitle(value);
  if(!s) return "";
  s=s.replace(/\b(tt\d{6,}|tmdb\s*\d+)\b/g," ");
  s=s.replace(/\b(?:19|20)\d{2}\b/g," ");
  s=s.replace(/\b(s\d{1,3}\s*e\d{1,4}|season\s*\d{1,3}|episode\s*\d{1,4})\b/g," ");
  s=s.replace(/\b(2160p|1080p|720p|480p|4k|uhd|fhd|hd|sd|web\s*dl|webrip|bluray|blu\s*ray|hdtv|remux|x264|x265|h264|h265|hevc|avc|hdr|dv|atmos|aac|ac3|dts|multi|dual|subbed|dubbed|complete|proper|repack)\b/g," ");
  return s.replace(/\s+/g," ").trim();
}
function buildTitleIdentity(input, overrides){
  input=input||{}; overrides=overrides||{};
  const detail=input.data&&typeof input.data==="object"?input.data:null;
  const item=input.item&&typeof input.item==="object"?input.item:null;
  const raw=Object.assign({},detail||{},item||{},input,overrides);
  const typeRaw=raw.type||raw.media_type||input.type||(item&&item.type)||(detail&&detail.media_type)||"movie";
  const type=(typeRaw==="series"||typeRaw==="tv")?"tv":"movie";
  const title=String(raw.title||raw.name||(detail?titleOf(detail):"")||(item?titleOf(item):"")||"").replace(/\s*\(source test\)\s*$/i,"").trim();
  const alternatives=identityAlternativeTitles(raw);
  const titles=identityUnique([title].concat(alternatives));
  const normalizedTitles=identityUnique(titles.map(identityNormalizeTitle));
  const year=String(raw.year||(detail?yearOf(detail):"")||(item?yearOf(item):"")||"").slice(0,4);
  const imdbId=String(raw.imdb||raw.imdb_id||raw.imdbId||((raw.external_ids||{}).imdb_id)||((detail&&detail.external_ids||{}).imdb_id)||"").toLowerCase();
  const tmdbId=Number(raw.tmdbId||raw.id||(detail&&detail.id)||(item&&item.id))||null;
  const season=raw.season==null?1:(Number(raw.season)||1);
  const episode=raw.episode==null?1:(Number(raw.episode)||1);
  return {
    version:1,
    type,
    tmdbId,
    imdbId:/^tt\d+$/i.test(imdbId)?imdbId:"",
    title,
    titles,
    normalizedTitles,
    year:/^\d{4}$/.test(year)?year:"",
    season:type==="tv"?season:1,
    episode:type==="tv"?episode:1,
    fingerprint:imdbId?("imdb:"+imdbId):tmdbId?("tmdb:"+tmdbId):("title:"+identityNormalizeTitle(title)+":"+(year||""))
  };
}
function identityFromDetail(data,type,season,episode){
  return buildTitleIdentity({data,type:type||typeOf(data),id:data&&data.id,season,episode});
}
function identityTitleScore(candidateTitle, identity){
  const cand=identityCleanCandidateTitle(candidateTitle);
  if(!cand||!identity) return {score:0,matchedTitle:""};
  let best=0, matchedTitle="";
  const candTokens=new Set(cand.split(" ").filter(Boolean));
  for(let i=0;i<(identity.normalizedTitles||[]).length;i++){
    const target=identity.normalizedTitles[i];
    if(!target) continue;
    let score=0;
    if(cand===target) score=100;
    else if(cand.startsWith(target+" ")){
      const extra=cand.split(" ").length-target.split(" ").length;
      score=Math.max(70,92-extra*4);
    }else if(target.startsWith(cand+" ")) score=84;
    else{
      const targetTokens=new Set(target.split(" ").filter(Boolean));
      let hit=0;
      for(const t of targetTokens) if(candTokens.has(t)) hit++;
      const containment=hit/Math.max(1,targetTokens.size);
      const jaccard=hit/Math.max(1,new Set([...targetTokens,...candTokens]).size);
      score=Math.round(containment*60+jaccard*34);
      if(hit===targetTokens.size&&targetTokens.size>1) score=Math.max(score,86);
    }
    if(score>best){ best=score; matchedTitle=(identity.titles||[])[i]||identity.title||""; }
  }
  return {score:best,matchedTitle};
}
function identifyTitleCandidate(candidate, identity, options){
  candidate=candidate||{}; options=options||{};
  identity=identity&&identity.version?identity:buildTitleIdentity(identity||{});
  const reasons=[];
  const text=[candidate.title,candidate.name,candidate.label,candidate.description,candidate.url,candidate.id].filter(Boolean).join(" ");
  const ids=identityExtractIds([candidate.imdbId,candidate.imdb_id,candidate.tmdbId?("tmdb:"+candidate.tmdbId):"",text].join(" "));
  if(candidate.imdbId||candidate.imdb_id) ids.imdbId=String(candidate.imdbId||candidate.imdb_id).toLowerCase();
  if(candidate.tmdbId||candidate.moviedb_id) ids.tmdbId=Number(candidate.tmdbId||candidate.moviedb_id)||ids.tmdbId;
  if(identity.imdbId&&ids.imdbId&&identity.imdbId!==ids.imdbId) return {score:0,verdict:"rejected",accepted:false,hardReject:true,reasons:["different IMDb id"],candidateIds:ids};
  if(identity.tmdbId&&ids.tmdbId&&Number(identity.tmdbId)!==Number(ids.tmdbId)) return {score:0,verdict:"rejected",accepted:false,hardReject:true,reasons:["different TMDB id"],candidateIds:ids};

  const episodeInfo=identityParseEpisode(text);
  let episodeConflict=false;
  if(identity.type==="tv"){
    if(episodeInfo.season!=null&&episodeInfo.season!==Number(identity.season||1)){ episodeConflict=true; reasons.push("different season"); }
    if(episodeInfo.episode!=null&&episodeInfo.episode!==Number(identity.episode||1)){ episodeConflict=true; reasons.push("different episode"); }
  }
  if(episodeConflict&&!options.idVerified) return {score:0,verdict:"rejected",accepted:false,hardReject:true,reasons,candidateIds:ids,episodeInfo};
  if(episodeConflict&&options.idVerified) return {score:0,verdict:"rejected",accepted:false,hardReject:true,reasons,candidateIds:ids,episodeInfo};

  const idExact=(identity.imdbId&&ids.imdbId&&identity.imdbId===ids.imdbId)||(identity.tmdbId&&ids.tmdbId&&Number(identity.tmdbId)===Number(ids.tmdbId));
  if(idExact) reasons.push("exact catalogue id");
  if(options.idVerified) reasons.push(options.idEvidence||"provider queried by exact catalogue id");

  const titleTexts=identityUnique([candidate.title,candidate.name,candidate.label,candidate.description,identityCandidateSlug(candidate.url)]);
  let title={score:0,matchedTitle:""};
  for(const t of titleTexts){
    const scored=identityTitleScore(t,identity);
    if(scored.score>title.score) title=scored;
  }
  let score=title.score;
  if(title.score>=80) reasons.push("title match");
  else if(title.score>=55) reasons.push("partial title match");

  const years=(text.match(/\b(19\d{2}|20\d{2})\b/g)||[]);
  const candYear=String(candidate.year||candidate.releaseInfo||candidate.released||"").slice(0,4);
  if(candYear&&/^\d{4}$/.test(candYear)&&!years.includes(candYear)) years.push(candYear);
  if(identity.year&&years.length){
    if(years.includes(identity.year)){ score=Math.min(100,score+4); reasons.push("year match"); }
    else { score=Math.max(0,score-14); reasons.push("year differs"); }
  }
  const candType=String(candidate.type||candidate.media_type||"").toLowerCase();
  if(candType){
    const normalizedType=(candType==="series"||candType==="tv")?"tv":"movie";
    if(normalizedType!==identity.type){ score=Math.max(0,score-25); reasons.push("media type differs"); }
    else reasons.push("media type match");
  }
  if(idExact||options.idVerified){
    // Exact-ID provider responses often have generic labels such as
    // "1080p WEB-DL". The ID route is the identity evidence; a readable
    // but strongly conflicting title is still rejected.
    const meaningfulTitleTokens=identityCleanCandidateTitle(titleTexts[0]||"").split(" ").filter(Boolean);
    if(title.score<38&&meaningfulTitleTokens.length>=2){
      return {score:title.score,verdict:"rejected",accepted:false,hardReject:true,reasons:reasons.concat(["label describes a different title"]),matchedTitle:title.matchedTitle,candidateIds:ids,episodeInfo};
    }
    score=100;
  }
  score=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Math.round(score)));
  const threshold=Number(options.threshold||85);
  const accepted=score>=threshold;
  const verdict=score>=95?"exact":accepted?"verified":score>=65?"possible":"rejected";
  return {score,verdict,accepted,hardReject:false,reasons,matchedTitle:title.matchedTitle||identity.title,candidateIds:ids,episodeInfo,threshold};
}

const GENRES_MOVIE = {28:"Action",12:"Adventure",16:"Animation",35:"Comedy",80:"Crime",99:"Documentary",18:"Drama",10751:"Family",14:"Fantasy",36:"History",27:"Horror",10402:"Music",9648:"Mystery",10749:"Romance",878:"Science Fiction",10770:"TV Movie",53:"Thriller",10752:"War",37:"Western"};
const GENRES_TV = {10759:"Action & Adventure",16:"Animation",35:"Comedy",80:"Crime",99:"Documentary",18:"Drama",10751:"Family",10762:"Kids",9648:"Mystery",10763:"News",10764:"Reality",10765:"Sci-Fi & Fantasy",10766:"Soap",10767:"Talk",10768:"War & Politics",37:"Western"};
const genreName = (type,id)=>(type==="tv"?GENRES_TV:GENRES_MOVIE)[id]||GENRES_MOVIE[id]||"";
function cmGenreIds(type,names){
  if(!Array.isArray(names)) return [];
  const primary=type==="tv"?GENRES_TV:GENRES_MOVIE;
  const aliases={"sci-fi":type==="tv"?10765:878,"science fiction":type==="tv"?10765:878,"sci-fi & fantasy":10765,"action & adventure":type==="tv"?10759:28,"war & politics":10768};
  const out=[];
  for(const raw of names){
    const name=String(raw||"").trim().toLowerCase();
    let id=aliases[name]||0;
    if(!id){ const hit=Object.entries(primary).find(([,v])=>v.toLowerCase()===name)||Object.entries(GENRES_MOVIE).find(([,v])=>v.toLowerCase()===name); if(hit) id=Number(hit[0]); }
    if(id&&!out.includes(id)) out.push(id);
  }
  return out;
}
function trailerKeyFromData(data){
  if(!data||typeof data!=="object") return "";
  const direct=[data.trailer_key,data.youtubeKey,data.youtube_key,data.trailerKey].find(v=>typeof v==="string"&&/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{6,}$/.test(v));
  if(direct) return direct;
  const stream=(Array.isArray(data.trailerStreams)?data.trailerStreams:[]).find(t=>t&&(t.ytId||t.youtubeId||t.key));
  if(stream) return String(stream.ytId||stream.youtubeId||stream.key||"");
  const trailer=(Array.isArray(data.trailers)?data.trailers:[]).find(t=>t&&(t.source||t.key||t.ytId));
  if(trailer) return String(trailer.source||trailer.key||trailer.ytId||"");
  const videos=data.videos&&Array.isArray(data.videos.results)?data.videos.results:[];
  const video=videos.find(v=>v&&v.site==="YouTube"&&v.type==="Trailer"&&v.key)||videos.find(v=>v&&v.site==="YouTube"&&v.key);
  return video?String(video.key):"";
}

function demoResponse(path,params){
  const page = Number(params.page||1);
  const wrap = results=>({page,total_pages:page>1?page:1,total_results:results.length,results:page>1?[]:results});
  const movies = DEMO.filter(d=>d.media_type==="movie"), shows = DEMO.filter(d=>d.media_type==="tv");
  if(path==="/trending/all/day"||path==="/trending/all/week") return wrap([...DEMO].sort((a,b)=>b.popularity-a.popularity));
  if(path==="/movie/popular"||path==="/movie/now_playing"||path==="/movie/upcoming") return wrap([...movies].sort((a,b)=>b.popularity-a.popularity));
  if(path==="/movie/top_rated") return wrap([...movies].sort((a,b)=>b.vote_average-a.vote_average));
  if(path==="/tv/popular"||path==="/tv/airing_today"||path==="/tv/on_the_air") return wrap([...shows].sort((a,b)=>b.popularity-a.popularity));
  if(path==="/search/multi"||path==="/search/person"){
    const q=String(params.query||"").toLowerCase();
    return wrap(DEMO.filter(d=>titleOf(d).toLowerCase().includes(q)));
  }
  if(path==="/discover/movie"||path==="/discover/tv"){
    let list = path.endsWith("movie")?[...movies]:[...shows];
    if(params.with_genres) list=list.filter(d=>d.genre_ids.includes(Number(params.with_genres)));
    if(params["vote_average.gte"]) list=list.filter(d=>d.vote_average>=Number(params["vote_average.gte"]));
    const y = (params["primary_release_date.gte"]||params["first_air_date.gte"]||"").slice(0,4);
    if(y) list=list.filter(d=>yearOf(d)>=y);
    if(params.sort_by==="vote_average.desc") list.sort((a,b)=>b.vote_average-a.vote_average);
    else list.sort((a,b)=>b.popularity-a.popularity);
    return wrap(list);
  }
  let m = path.match(/^\/(movie|tv)\/(\d+)\/season\/(\d+)$/);
  if(m){ const s=Number(m[3]); return {season_number:s,episodes:Array.from({length:8},(_,i)=>({episode_number:i+1,name:"Episode "+(i+1),air_date:"",runtime:45,overview:""}))}; }
  m = path.match(/^\/(movie|tv)\/(\d+)$/);
  if(m){
    const it = DEMO.find(d=>d.id===Number(m[2])&&d.media_type===m[1]) || DEMO[0];
    const same = DEMO.filter(d=>d.media_type===m[1]&&d.id!==it.id).slice(0,10);
    return Object.assign({},it,{genres:it.genre_ids.map(id=>({id,name:genreName(m[1],id)})),
      runtime:m[1]==="movie"?128:undefined, episode_run_time:m[1]==="tv"?[48]:undefined,
      number_of_seasons:m[1]==="tv"?3:undefined, number_of_episodes:m[1]==="tv"?24:undefined,
      seasons:m[1]==="tv"?[1,2,3].map(n=>({season_number:n,name:"Season "+n,episode_count:8})):undefined,
      status:"Released", credits:{cast:[]}, videos:{results:[]}, recommendations:{results:same}});
  }
  if(path.match(/^\/collection\/\d+$/)) return {parts:[]};
  return wrap([]);
}

/* ---------------- TMDB client ---------------- */
let demoMode = false;
let catalogMode="tmdb";
function setCatalogMode(m){ catalogMode=m; const c=$("#catalogModeChip"); if(c) c.textContent = m==="cinemeta" ? "Cinemeta" : m==="demo" ? "Offline demo" : "TMDB"; }
function setDemo(on){ demoMode=on; $("#demoBanner").classList.toggle("hidden",!on); }
/* ---------------- Cinemeta keyless catalogue ----------------
   Stremio's official catalogue addon (no API key, CORS-open). Used whenever
   no TMDB key/proxy is available, so the app always has a LIVE catalogue
   with real poster/backdrop artwork (Metahub). Metas include moviedb_id,
   so titles keep working with the TMDB-id playback sources. */
const CINEMETA = "https://v3-cinemeta.strem.io";
const cinemetaCache = new Map();
const cinemetaMetaCache = new Map();
const cinemetaByTmdb = new Map();
let cinemetaDownUntil = 0;
const CM_TMDB_GENRES={
 movie:{28:"Action",12:"Adventure",16:"Animation",35:"Comedy",80:"Crime",99:"Documentary",18:"Drama",10751:"Family",14:"Fantasy",36:"History",27:"Horror",10402:"Music",9648:"Mystery",10749:"Romance",878:"Science Fiction",10770:"TV Movie",53:"Thriller",10752:"War",37:"Western"},
 tv:{10759:"Action & Adventure",16:"Animation",35:"Comedy",80:"Crime",99:"Documentary",18:"Drama",10751:"Family",10762:"Kids",9648:"Mystery",10763:"News",10764:"Reality",10765:"Sci-Fi & Fantasy",10766:"Soap",10767:"Talk",10768:"War & Politics",37:"Western"}
};
function cmGenreName(type,id){ return (CM_TMDB_GENRES[type]||{})[id] || ""; }
const CM_GENRE_ALIAS = {"Science Fiction":"Sci-Fi","Action & Adventure":"Action","Sci-Fi & Fantasy":"Sci-Fi","War & Politics":"War","Reality":"Reality-TV","Talk":"Talk-Show","News":null,"TV Movie":null,"Kids":"Family","Soap":null};

async function cinemetaFetch(url, externalSignal){
  const hit = cinemetaCache.get(url);
  if(hit && Date.now()-hit.t < 300000) return hit.data;
  const fetchJson = async(target, timeoutMs)=>{
    const ctl = new AbortController(); const to = setTimeout(()=>ctl.abort(), timeoutMs);
    const abortExternal=()=>ctl.abort(); if(externalSignal){ if(externalSignal.aborted) ctl.abort(); else externalSignal.addEventListener("abort",abortExternal,{once:true}); }
    try{
      const r = await fetch(target, {signal: ctl.signal, headers:{Accept:"application/json"}});
      if(!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP "+r.status);
      return await r.json();
    } finally { clearTimeout(to); if(externalSignal) externalSignal.removeEventListener("abort",abortExternal); }
  };
  let data;
  try{ data = await fetchJson(url, 9000); }
  catch(directErr){
    if(externalSignal&&externalSignal.aborted) throw directErr;
    // Online launches without a bundled TMDB env key can still reach the
    // keyless catalogue through this deployment's own JSON relay if the
    // browser/network cannot reach Cinemeta directly.
    data = await fetchJson("/api/extract?mode=json&url=" + encodeURIComponent(url), 12000);
  }
  cinemetaCache.set(url, {t: Date.now(), data});
  return data;
}
function cmType(type){ return type==="tv" ? "series" : "movie"; }
function cmMapMeta(m){
  if(!m || !m.moviedb_id) return null;
  const type = m.type==="series" ? "tv" : "movie";
  const item = {
    id: Number(m.moviedb_id), media_type: type,
    title: type==="movie" ? m.name : undefined, name: type==="tv" ? m.name : undefined,
    poster_path: null, backdrop_path: null,
    poster_url: m.poster ? m.poster.replace("/poster/small/","/poster/medium/") : null,
    backdrop_url: m.background || null,
    vote_average: parseFloat(m.imdbRating) || 0,
    release_date: type==="movie" ? (m.released||"") : "", first_air_date: type==="tv" ? (m.released||"") : "",
    overview: m.description || "", imdb_id: m.imdb_id || m.id || "", popularity: m.popularity || 0,
    trailer_key: trailerKeyFromData(m),
    logo_url: m.logo || null,
    genres: Array.isArray(m.genres) ? m.genres : (Array.isArray(m.genre) ? m.genre : []),
    genre_ids: cmGenreIds(type, Array.isArray(m.genres) ? m.genres : m.genre)
  };
  if(item.imdb_id) imdbCache[type+":"+item.id] = item.imdb_id;
  cinemetaByTmdb.set(item.id, item.imdb_id);
  return item;
}
async function cmCatalog(type, catalogId, extra, signal){
  const seg = extra ? "/" + Object.entries(extra).map(([k,v])=>k+"="+encodeURIComponent(v)).join("&") : "";
  const data = await cinemetaFetch(CINEMETA + "/catalog/" + cmType(type) + "/" + catalogId + seg + ".json", signal);
  return (data.metas || []).map(cmMapMeta).filter(Boolean);
}
function cmWrap(results, page){
  return {page, total_pages: results.length >= 90 ? page + 2 : page, total_results: results.length, results};
}
function cmClientFilter(items, params, type){
  let list = items.slice();
  const y = (params["primary_release_date.gte"] || params["first_air_date.gte"] || "").slice(0,4);
  if(y) list = list.filter(i => yearOf(i) >= y);
  if(params["vote_average.gte"]) list = list.filter(i => i.vote_average >= Number(params["vote_average.gte"]));
  if(params.sort_by === "vote_average.desc") list.sort((a,b)=>b.vote_average-a.vote_average);
  else if(/date\.desc/.test(params.sort_by||"")) list.sort((a,b)=>String(b.release_date||b.first_air_date).localeCompare(String(a.release_date||a.first_air_date)));
  return list;
}
function lookupImdbByTmdb(tmdbId){
  if(cinemetaByTmdb.get(tmdbId)) return cinemetaByTmdb.get(tmdbId);
  for(const w of watchlist) if(w.id===tmdbId && w.imdb_id) return w.imdb_id;
  for(const p of Object.values(progress)) if(p.id===tmdbId && p.imdb_id) return p.imdb_id;
  return "";
}
async function cmMetaByTmdb(type, tmdbId){
  const imdb = lookupImdbByTmdb(tmdbId);
  if(!imdb) return null;
  if(cinemetaMetaCache.get(imdb)) return cinemetaMetaCache.get(imdb);
  const data = await cinemetaFetch(CINEMETA + "/meta/" + cmType(type) + "/" + imdb + ".json");
  const meta = data.meta || null;
  if(meta) cinemetaMetaCache.set(imdb, meta);
  return meta;
}
async function cmDetail(type, tmdbId){
  const m = await cmMetaByTmdb(type, tmdbId);
  if(!m) return null;
  const isTV = type==="tv";
  const videos = Array.isArray(m.videos) ? m.videos : [];
  const seasonNums = [...new Set(videos.map(v=>v.season))].filter(n=>n!=null).sort((a,b)=>a-b);
  let recs = [];
  try{ recs = (await cmCatalog(type, "top")).filter(i=>i.id!==tmdbId).slice(0,12); }catch{}
  return {
    id: tmdbId, imdb_id: m.imdb_id || m.id,
    title: !isTV ? m.name : undefined, name: isTV ? m.name : undefined,
    overview: m.description || "", vote_average: parseFloat(m.imdbRating)||0,
    release_date: !isTV ? (m.released||"") : "", first_air_date: isTV ? (m.released||"") : "",
    poster_url: m.poster ? m.poster.replace("/poster/small/","/poster/medium/") : null, backdrop_url: m.background || null,
    logo_url: m.logo || null, trailer_key: trailerKeyFromData(m), genre_ids: cmGenreIds(type,m.genres||m.genre),
    poster_path: null, backdrop_path: null,
    genres: (m.genres || m.genre || []).map(name=>({name})),
    runtime: !isTV ? (parseInt(m.runtime)||undefined) : undefined,
    episode_run_time: isTV && parseInt(m.runtime) ? [parseInt(m.runtime)] : undefined,
    number_of_seasons: isTV ? seasonNums.filter(n=>n>0).length || undefined : undefined,
    number_of_episodes: isTV ? videos.filter(v=>v.season>0).length || undefined : undefined,
    seasons: isTV ? seasonNums.map(n=>({season_number:n, name: n===0?"Specials":"Season "+n, episode_count: videos.filter(v=>v.season===n).length})) : undefined,
    status: m.status || "",
    credits: {cast: (m.cast||[]).slice(0,14).map(name=>({name, character:"", profile_path:null}))},
    videos: {results: (m.trailers||[]).map(t=>({site:"YouTube", type:"Trailer", key:t.source})).filter(t=>t.key)},
    recommendations: {results: recs},
    external_ids: {imdb_id: m.imdb_id || m.id}
  };
}
async function cinemetaResponse(path, params){
  params = params || {};
  const page = Number(params.page||1), skip = (page-1)*20;
  if(path==="/trending/all/day"||path==="/trending/all/week"){
    const [mv, tv] = await Promise.all([cmCatalog("movie","top"), cmCatalog("tv","top")]);
    return cmWrap([...mv, ...tv].sort((a,b)=>(b.popularity||0)-(a.popularity||0)).slice(0,60), page);
  }
  if(path==="/movie/popular") return cmWrap(await cmCatalog("movie","top",{skip}), page);
  if(path==="/movie/top_rated") return cmWrap(await cmCatalog("movie","imdbRating",{skip}), page);
  if(path==="/movie/now_playing"||path==="/movie/upcoming") return cmWrap(await cmCatalog("movie","year",{genre:String(new Date().getFullYear()),skip}), page);
  if(path==="/tv/popular"||path==="/tv/airing_today"||path==="/tv/on_the_air") return cmWrap(await cmCatalog("tv","top",{skip}), page);
  if(path==="/search/multi"){
    const q = params.query||"";
    const [mv, tv] = await Promise.all([
      cmCatalog("movie","top",{search:q}).catch(()=>[]),
      cmCatalog("tv","top",{search:q}).catch(()=>[])
    ]);
    return cmWrap([...mv.map(i=>({...i,media_type:"movie"})), ...tv.map(i=>({...i,media_type:"tv"}))], page);
  }
  if(path==="/discover/movie"||path==="/discover/tv"){
    const type = path.endsWith("movie") ? "movie" : "tv";
    let extra = {skip};
    if(params.with_genres){
      const name = cmGenreName(type, Number(params.with_genres));
      const alias = CM_GENRE_ALIAS.hasOwnProperty(name) ? CM_GENRE_ALIAS[name] : name;
      if(alias) extra = {genre: alias, skip};
    }
    return cmWrap(cmClientFilter(await cmCatalog(type, params.sort_by==="vote_average.desc" ? "imdbRating" : "top", extra), params, type), page);
  }
  let mm = path.match(/^\/(movie|tv)\/(\d+)\/season\/(\d+)$/);
  if(mm){
    const meta = await cmMetaByTmdb(mm[1], Number(mm[2]));
    if(!meta) return null;
    const n = Number(mm[3]);
    return {season_number:n, episodes:(meta.videos||[]).filter(v=>v.season===n).sort((a,b)=>a.episode-b.episode).map(v=>({episode_number:v.episode, name:v.name||("Episode "+v.episode), air_date:(v.released||"").slice(0,10), runtime:0, overview:v.overview||v.description||"", still_url:v.thumbnail||v.still_url||"", thumbnail_url:v.thumbnail||"", still_path:v.still_path||null}))};
  }
  if(path==="/genre/movie/list"||path==="/genre/tv/list"){ const t=path.includes("movie")?"movie":"tv"; return {genres:Object.entries(CM_TMDB_GENRES[t]).map(([id,name])=>({id:Number(id),name}))}; }
  mm = path.match(/^\/(movie|tv)\/(\d+)$/);
  if(mm) return cmDetail(mm[1], Number(mm[2]));
  return null;
}
async function cinemetaSafe(path, params){
  if(Date.now() < cinemetaDownUntil) return null;
  try{ const c = await cinemetaResponse(path, params); if(c) return c; return null; }
  catch{ cinemetaDownUntil = Date.now() + 60000; return null; }
}

async function tmdb(path,params={}){
  if(demoMode){
    const c=await cinemetaSafe(path,params);
    if(c){ setCatalogMode("cinemeta"); $("#demoBanner").classList.add("hidden"); return c; }
    setCatalogMode("demo"); $("#demoBanner").classList.remove("hidden"); return demoResponse(path,params);
  }
  try{
    const url=new URL("/api/tmdb",location.origin);
    url.searchParams.set("path",path);
    for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(params)) if(v!==""&&v!=null) url.searchParams.set(k,v);
    const r=await fetch(url,{headers:{Accept:"application/json"}});
    if(!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP "+r.status);
    const data=await r.json();
    if(data&&data.success===false) throw new Error(data.status_message||"TMDB error");
    setCatalogMode("tmdb-bundled");
    return data;
  }catch(err){
    const c=await cinemetaSafe(path,params);
    if(c){ demoMode=true; $("#demoBanner").classList.add("hidden"); setCatalogMode("cinemeta"); return c; }
    setDemo(true); setCatalogMode("demo"); return demoResponse(path,params);
  }
}
/* ---------------- playback sources (ZeroPlay logic) ---------------- */
const SOURCES=[{id:"vidstuck",name:"VidStuck"},{id:"zxcstream",name:"ZXCStream (Beta)"},{id:"embedwave",name:"Embedwave (BETA)"}];
const SOURCE_HOSTS=["vidstuck.cc","zxcstream.cc","embedwave.cc"];
function sourceURL(item,position={},provider){
  const id=(SOURCES.find(s=>s.id===provider)||SOURCES[0]).id;
  const season=Number.isInteger(position.season)&&position.season>=0?position.season:1;
  const episode=Number.isInteger(position.episode)&&position.episode>0?position.episode:1;
  const suffix=item.type+"/"+item.id+(item.type==="tv"?"/"+season+"/"+episode:"");
  const host=id==="embedwave"?"embedwave.cc":id==="zxcstream"?"zxcstream.cc":"vidstuck.cc";
  const u=id==="zxcstream"?new URL("https://"+host+"/player/"+suffix):new URL("https://"+host+"/embed/"+suffix);
  if(id==="zxcstream"){ u.searchParams.set("domainAd","zeroplay"); u.searchParams.set("color","65E6CC"); u.searchParams.set("autoplay","true"); }
  if(id==="vidstuck"){
    for(const [k,v] of Object.entries({branding:"ZeroPlay",color:"65E6CC",subtitle:"english",overlay:"true"})) u.searchParams.set(k,v);
    if(item.type==="tv") for(const k of ["nextEpisode","episodeSelector","autoplayNextEpisode"]) u.searchParams.set(k,"true");
    if(Number.isFinite(position.timestamp)&&position.timestamp>30&&Number(position.percent)<95) u.searchParams.set("progress",String(Math.floor(position.timestamp)));
  }
  return u.href;
}
/* ---------------- FastStream preload + source engine (TV prototype) ----------------
   "FastStream" here is a built-in preload/optimiser engine — there is no external
   service call. It does what a browser page genuinely can: DNS warm-up
   (preconnect + reachability timing), intent preloading, next-episode warm-up,
   ranged warm-up for direct media files, and source health scoring that powers
   race/stall failover. Cross-origin embed players cannot be segmented-downloaded
   or quality-forced by a hosting page; the UI never claims otherwise. */
const CAP_GB_HARD = 5;
const DIRECT_RE = /\.(mp4|m3u8|mpd|webm|mov|m4v)(\?|#|$)/i;
function isDirectMedia(u){ try{ return DIRECT_RE.test(new URL(u).pathname); }catch{ return DIRECT_RE.test(String(u||"")); } }
function capGb(){ const v=Number(settings.stream.maxFileSizeGb); return Math.min(CAP_GB_HARD, v>0?v:CAP_GB_HARD); }
function capBytes(){ return capGb()*1000*1000*1000; }
function fmtBytes(b){ if(b==null) return "unknown"; if(b>=1e9) return (b/1e9).toFixed(2)+" GB"; if(b>=1e6) return (b/1e6).toFixed(1)+" MB"; if(b>=1e3) return (b/1e3).toFixed(0)+" KB"; return b+" B"; }
function decideSizeCap(bytes, cap){ if(bytes==null) return {allowed:true, known:false}; return {allowed: bytes<=cap, known:true}; }
async function probeFileSize(url){
  const ctl=new AbortController(); const to=setTimeout(()=>ctl.abort(),8000);
  try{ const r=await fetch(url,{method:"HEAD",signal:ctl.signal,credentials:"omit"}); const len=Number(r.headers.get("content-length")); if(len>0) return len; }catch{}
  try{ const r=await fetch(url,{headers:{Range:"bytes=0-0"},signal:ctl.signal,credentials:"omit"}); const cr=r.headers.get("content-range"); let found=null; if(cr&&cr.includes("/")){ const total=Number(cr.split("/").pop()); if(total>0) found=total; } const len=Number(r.headers.get("content-length")); if(found==null&&r.status===200&&len>1) found=len; try{ if(r.body) await r.body.cancel(); }catch{} if(found) return found; }catch{} finally{ clearTimeout(to); }
  return null; /* size unknown (host blocks CORS probes) — playback allowed, marked unknown */
}
function effectiveSaver(){ if(tvPerformanceEnabled()) return true; const m=settings.stream.dataSaver; if(m==="on") return true; if(m==="off") return false; const c=navigator.connection||{}; return !!(c.saveData||/(^|-)2g$/.test(c.effectiveType||"")); }
function connInfo(){ const c=navigator.connection||{}; return {type:c.effectiveType||"unknown",downlink:c.downlink||null,saveData:!!c.saveData,rtt:c.rtt||null}; }
function routeNow(){ const r=(location.hash.replace(/^#\/?/,"").split("?")[0]||"home"); return r==="discover"||r==="settings"||r==="configure"||r==="debrid"?"sources":r; }

/* ---- source registry: ZeroPlay built-ins + your websites ---- */
const LAST_RESORT=new Set(["embedwave"]); /* always tried only after every other enabled source */
function allSources(includeDisabled){
  const dis=new Set(settings.disabledSources||[]);
  const list=SOURCES.map(s=>({id:s.id,name:s.name,kind:"builtin",enabled:!dis.has(s.id)}))
    .concat((settings.customSources||[]).map(c=>({id:c.id,name:c.name,kind:"custom",movieTpl:c.movieTpl||"",tvTpl:c.tvTpl||"",direct:!!c.direct,enabled:c.enabled!==false,addedVia:c.addedVia||"manual"})))
    .concat((settings.sites||[]).map(c=>{ const p=(settings.providers||[]).find(x=>x.id===c.id); return {id:c.id,providerId:p?p.id:c.id,name:c.name,kind:"site",base:c.base,home:c.home||c.base,lookup:c.lookup||"dynamic",searchTemplate:c.searchTemplate||"",identification:p?p.identification:null,enabled:(c.enabled!==false&&!dis.has(c.id))}; }))
    .concat((settings.addons||[]).map(a=>({id:a.id,providerId:a.providerId||a.id,name:a.name,kind:"addon",base:a.base,manifestUrl:a.manifestUrl||"",types:a.types||[],idPrefixes:a.idPrefixes||[],resources:a.resources||[],catalogDefs:a.catalogDefs||[],searchCatalogs:a.searchCatalogs||[],identification:a.identification||null,stars:a.stars||0,enabled:(a.enabled!==false&&!dis.has(a.id))})));
  const out=includeDisabled?list:list.filter(s=>s.enabled);
  out.sort((a,b)=>{ const la=LAST_RESORT.has(a.id)?1:0, lb=LAST_RESORT.has(b.id)?1:0; if(la!==lb) return la-lb; return settings.stream.sortByHealth ? healthScore(b.id)-healthScore(a.id) : 0; });
  return out;
}
function getSource(id){ return allSources(true).find(s=>s.id===id); }
function sourceOptionsHTML(selected,forDefault){
  const all=allSources();
  const normal=all.filter(s=>s.kind!=="addon");
  const addons=all.filter(s=>s.kind==="addon").sort((a,b)=>healthScore(b.id)-healthScore(a.id)||((b.stars||0)-(a.stars||0)));
  let addonOptions=addons.slice(0,100);
  if(selected&&!addonOptions.some(s=>s.id===selected)){ const chosen=addons.find(s=>s.id===selected); if(chosen) addonOptions=[chosen].concat(addonOptions); }
  const list=normal.concat(addonOptions);
  if(!list.length) return '<option value="">No sources enabled</option>';
  return list.map(s=>{ const lr=LAST_RESORT.has(s.id); return '<option value="'+esc(s.id)+'"'+(s.id===selected?" selected":"")+((forDefault&&lr)?" disabled":"")+">"+esc(s.name)+(lr?" \u00b7 last resort":"")+"</option>"; }).join("");
}
function defaultSourceId(){ const list=allSources(); if(list.some(s=>s.id===settings.source)&&!LAST_RESORT.has(settings.source)) return settings.source; const normal=list.find(s=>!LAST_RESORT.has(s.id)); return (normal||list[0]||{id:"vidstuck"}).id; }
function sourceHost(source){ try{ if(source.kind==="builtin") return source.id==="embedwave"?"embedwave.cc":source.id==="zxcstream"?"zxcstream.cc":"vidstuck.cc"; if(source.kind==="site"||source.kind==="addon") return new URL(source.base||source.home).hostname; return new URL(source.movieTpl||source.tvTpl).hostname; }catch{ return ""; } }
function sourceOrigin(source){ const h=sourceHost(source); return h?"https://"+h:""; }

/* ---- templates: {tmdb} {imdb} {type} {season} {episode} {title} {year} ---- */
function applyTemplate(tpl, ctx){
  return String(tpl||"")
    .replaceAll("{tmdb}", String(ctx.id||""))
    .replaceAll("{id}", String(ctx.id||""))
    .replaceAll("{imdb}", String(ctx.imdb||""))
    .replaceAll("{type}", ctx.type||"movie")
    .replaceAll("{season}", String(ctx.season==null?1:ctx.season))
    .replaceAll("{episode}", String(ctx.episode==null?1:ctx.episode))
    .replaceAll("{title}", encodeURIComponent(ctx.title||""))
    .replaceAll("{year}", String(ctx.year||""));
}
const imdbCache={};
async function fetchImdbId(type,id){
  const k=type+":"+id; if(imdbCache[k]!==undefined) return imdbCache[k];
  let out="";
  try{ const d=await tmdb("/"+type+"/"+id, type==="tv"?{append_to_response:"external_ids"}:{}); out=(type==="tv"?(d.external_ids&&d.external_ids.imdb_id):d.imdb_id)||""; }catch{}
  imdbCache[k]=out; return out;
}
async function resolveSourceURL(source, ctx){
  if(!source) throw new Error("No playback source enabled — add one in Sources");
  const identity=(ctx&&ctx.identity&&ctx.identity.version)?ctx.identity:buildTitleIdentity(ctx||{});
  const richCtx=Object.assign({},ctx||{},{identity,imdb:(ctx&&ctx.imdb)||identity.imdbId||"",title:identity.title||(ctx&&ctx.title)||"",altTitles:identity.titles||[],year:identity.year||(ctx&&ctx.year)||"",season:identity.season,episode:identity.episode});
  if(source.kind==="addon") return resolveAddonURL(source,richCtx);
  if(source.kind==="site") return resolveSiteURL(source,richCtx);
  if(source.kind==="builtin") return sourceURL({type:richCtx.type,id:richCtx.id},{season:richCtx.season,episode:richCtx.episode,timestamp:richCtx.timestamp,percent:richCtx.percent},source.id);
  const tpl = richCtx.type==="tv" ? (source.tvTpl||source.movieTpl) : (source.movieTpl||source.tvTpl);
  if(!tpl) throw new Error(source.name+" has no "+richCtx.type+" template");
  let imdb=richCtx.imdb||"";
  if(tpl.includes("{imdb}")&&!imdb&&richCtx.id) imdb=await fetchImdbId(richCtx.type,richCtx.id);
  return applyTemplate(tpl,Object.assign({},richCtx,{imdb}));
}

/* ---- paste-a-website smart detection ---- */
function prettyHostName(host){ const h=String(host||"").replace(/^www\./,""); const first=h.split(".")[0]||"Source"; return first.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+first.slice(1); }
function parsePastedLink(raw){
  const input=String(raw||"").trim(); if(!input) return null;
  let u; try{ u=new URL(input.includes("://")?input:"https://"+input); }catch{ return null; }
  if(u.protocol!=="https:"&&u.protocol!=="http:") return null;
  const name=prettyHostName(u.hostname);
  const s=u.href.replace(/%7B/gi,"{").replace(/%7D/gi,"}"); /* URL parser encodes { } — restore pasted placeholders */
  if(/\{(tmdb|imdb|id|season|episode|type)\}/.test(s)){
    const isTv=s.includes("{season}")||s.includes("/tv/");
    return {name, movieTpl:isTv?"":s, tvTpl:isTv?s:"", direct:isDirectMedia(s), detected:"Template kept exactly as pasted"};
  }
  if(isDirectMedia(s)) return {name, movieTpl:s, tvTpl:"", direct:true, detected:"Direct media file link (.mp4/.m3u8/…) — plays in the built-in player with the "+CAP_GB_HARD+" GB cap check"};
  if(/tt\d{6,}/.test(s)){
    const t=s.replace(/tt\d{6,}/,"{imdb}");
    const m=t.match(/^(.*\{imdb\})\/(\d{1,3})\/(\d{1,4})(\/?(?:[?#].*)?)$/);
    if(m) return {name, movieTpl:m[1]+(m[4]||""), tvTpl:m[1]+"/{season}/{episode}"+(m[4]||""), direct:false, detected:"IMDb id + season/episode detected → converted to a reusable template"};
    return {name, movieTpl:t, tvTpl:"", direct:false, detected:"IMDb id detected → converted to {imdb} template"};
  }
  const parts=u.pathname.split("/").filter(p=>p.length);
  const numIdx=parts.findIndex(p=>/^\d{2,}$/.test(p));
  if(numIdx>=0){
    const withSeasons=/^\d{1,3}$/.test(parts[numIdx+1]||"")&&/^\d{1,4}$/.test(parts[numIdx+2]||"");
    const base=parts.slice(0,numIdx+1); base[numIdx]="{tmdb}";
    let movieTpl=u.origin+"/"+base.join("/")+u.search, tvTpl="", detected="TMDB id detected → converted to {tmdb} template";
    if(withSeasons){ const tp=parts.slice(); tp[numIdx]="{tmdb}"; tp[numIdx+1]="{season}"; tp[numIdx+2]="{episode}"; tvTpl=u.origin+"/"+tp.join("/")+u.search; detected="TMDB id + season/episode detected → converted to templates"; }
    const kindIdx=parts.findIndex(p=>p==="movie"||p==="tv");
    if(kindIdx>=0&&kindIdx<numIdx){
      if(parts[kindIdx]==="movie"&&!tvTpl){ const tp=parts.slice(0,numIdx+1); tp[kindIdx]="tv"; tp[numIdx]="{tmdb}"; tvTpl=u.origin+"/"+tp.join("/")+"/{season}/{episode}"+u.search; }
      if(parts[kindIdx]==="tv"&&withSeasons){ const mp=parts.slice(0,numIdx+1); mp[kindIdx]="movie"; mp[numIdx]="{tmdb}"; movieTpl=u.origin+"/"+mp.join("/")+u.search; }
    }
    return {name,movieTpl,tvTpl,direct:false,detected};
  }
  const q=new URLSearchParams(u.search);
  for(const key of ["tmdb","id","movie","tmdb_id"]){ const v=q.get(key); if(v&&/^\d{2,}$/.test(v)){ q.set(key,"{tmdb}"); const qs=q.toString().replace(/%7B/g,"{").replace(/%7D/g,"}"); return {name, movieTpl:u.origin+u.pathname+"?"+qs, tvTpl:"", direct:false, detected:"TMDB id in query string detected → converted to template"}; } }
  return {name, movieTpl:"", tvTpl:"", direct:false, site:true, base:u.origin, home:s, detected:"Website detected → default dynamic lookup. ZeroPlay keeps its own cover/title and checks this site for that exact title/episode only when you press play."};
}
function validateTemplate(t){ if(!t) return true; try{ const u=new URL(t.replace(/\{[^}]+\}/g,"1")); return u.protocol==="https:"||u.protocol==="http:"; }catch{ return false; } }

/* ---- health scoring + reachability ---- */
function recordHealth(id, ok, ms){
  const h=settings.health[id]||(settings.health[id]={ok:0,fail:0,avgMs:0,last:0,lastOk:0});
  h.last=Date.now();
  if(ok){ h.ok++; h.lastOk=h.last; if(ms>0) h.avgMs=h.avgMs?Math.round(h.avgMs*0.6+ms*0.4):Math.round(ms); } else h.fail++;
  saveSettings();
}
function healthScore(id){ const h=settings.health[id]; if(!h||(!h.ok&&!h.fail)) return 50; const ratio=h.ok/Math.max(1,h.ok+h.fail); let s=ratio*80; if(h.avgMs) s+=Math.max(0,20-Math.min(20,h.avgMs/100)); return Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(100,s))); }
function healthBadge(id){ const h=settings.health[id]; const sc=healthScore(id); const untouched=!h||(!h.ok&&!h.fail); const cls=untouched?"unk":sc>=70?"ok":sc>=40?"slow":"bad"; const label=untouched?"not checked":sc+" · "+(h.avgMs?h.avgMs+" ms":"—"); return '<span class="health"><span class="health-dot '+cls+'"></span>'+esc(label)+"</span>"; }
async function pingHost(origin, timeoutMs){
  if(!origin) return {ok:false,ms:0};
  const ctl=new AbortController(); const to=setTimeout(()=>ctl.abort(),timeoutMs||6000); const t0=performance.now();
  try{ await fetch(origin+"/favicon.ico",{mode:"no-cors",signal:ctl.signal,cache:"no-store",credentials:"omit"}); return {ok:true,ms:performance.now()-t0}; }
  catch{ return {ok:false,ms:performance.now()-t0}; } finally{ clearTimeout(to); }
}
async function runHealthChecks(manual,limit){
  const all=allSources(true).slice().sort((a,b)=>(((settings.health[a.id]||{}).last)||0)-(((settings.health[b.id]||{}).last)||0));
  const list=Number(limit)>0?all.slice(0,Number(limit)):all;
  for(const s of list){ const before=settings.health[s.id]&&settings.health[s.id].lastOk>0; const origin=sourceOrigin(s); if(!origin) continue; const r=await pingHost(origin); recordHealth(s.id,r.ok,r.ms); if(before!==undefined&&before!==r.ok&&settings.health[s.id].last) dlog(s.name+" "+(r.ok?"reachable ("+Math.round(r.ms)+" ms)":"unreachable")); }
  if(manual) toast("Health check complete for "+list.length+" sources"+(all.length>list.length?" (next batch)":""),"success");
  if(routeNow()==="sources"&&!(document.activeElement&&/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(document.activeElement.tagName||""))) renderSources(true);
  return list.length;
}

/* ---- DNS warm-up + preload ---- */
const warmedHosts=new Set();
function warmHost(origin){
  if(!origin||warmedHosts.has(origin)) return Promise.resolve(null);
  warmedHosts.add(origin);
  try{ const l=document.createElement("link"); l.rel="preconnect"; l.href=origin; l.crossOrigin="anonymous"; document.head.appendChild(l); const d=document.createElement("link"); d.rel="dns-prefetch"; d.href=origin; document.head.appendChild(d); }catch{}
  return pingHost(origin);
}
function warmAllSources(){ if(!settings.stream.dnsWarm) return; const all=allSources(); const batch=all.filter(s=>s.kind!=="addon").concat(all.filter(s=>s.kind==="addon").slice(0,24)); batch.forEach(s=>{ const o=sourceOrigin(s); if(o) warmHost(o).then(r=>{ if(r) recordHealth(s.id,r.ok,r.ms); }); }); }
async function warmDirectMedia(url){
  const q=settings.stream.quality; const bytes=(q==="480p"||effectiveSaver())?256*1024:q==="2160p"?2*1024*1024:1024*1024;
  const ctl=new AbortController(); const to=setTimeout(()=>ctl.abort(),10000); const t0=performance.now();
  try{ const r=await fetch(url,{headers:{Range:"bytes=0-"+(bytes-1)},signal:ctl.signal,credentials:"omit"});
    if(r.status!==206){ try{ if(r.body) await r.body.cancel(); }catch{} return {ok:false,ms:performance.now()-t0,got:0,rangeIgnored:true}; }
    if(r.body){ const rd=r.body.getReader(); let got=0; while(got<bytes){ const part=await rd.read(); if(part.done) break; got+=part.value.length; if(got>=bytes) break; } try{ await rd.cancel(); }catch{} return {ok:true,ms:performance.now()-t0,got}; }
    return {ok:r.ok,ms:performance.now()-t0,got:0};
  }catch{ return {ok:false,ms:performance.now()-t0,got:0}; } finally{ clearTimeout(to); }
}
let preloadCache=null;
function preloadKey(ctx,sourceId){ return sourceId+":"+ctx.type+":"+ctx.id+":"+(ctx.season||1)+":"+(ctx.episode||1); }
function preloadSlotEl(){ let el=document.getElementById("preloadSlot"); if(!el){ el=document.createElement("div"); el.id="preloadSlot"; el.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true"); document.body.appendChild(el); } return el; }
async function faststreamPreload(ctx, sourceId){
  const mode=settings.stream.preload; if(mode==="off"||effectiveSaver()) return;
  const source=getSource(sourceId||defaultSourceId()); if(!source||!source.enabled) return;
  const t0=performance.now();
  const ping=await warmHost(sourceOrigin(source)); if(ping) recordHealth(source.id,ping.ok,ping.ms);
  let url=""; try{ url=await resolveSourceURL(source,ctx); }catch{ return; }
  if(settings.stream.preload==="off"||effectiveSaver()) return;
  const direct=!!(source.direct||isDirectMedia(url));
  if(direct){ const w=await warmDirectMedia(url); if(settings.stream.preload==="off"||effectiveSaver()) return; preloadCache={key:preloadKey(ctx,source.id),url,mode:"direct file warmed ("+fmtBytes(w.got)+")",ms:Math.round(performance.now()-t0)}; }
  else if(mode==="aggressive"){
    const slot=preloadSlotEl(); slot.innerHTML="";
    const f=document.createElement("iframe"); f.referrerPolicy=embedReferrerPolicyForUrl(url); f.src=url; f.setAttribute("allow","encrypted-media"); f.setAttribute("loading","eager"); f.title="FastStream preload";
    slot.appendChild(f); preloadCache={key:preloadKey(ctx,source.id),url,mode:"player preloaded",frame:f,ms:Math.round(performance.now()-t0)};
  } else preloadCache={key:preloadKey(ctx,source.id),url,mode:"DNS + connection warmed",ms:Math.round(performance.now()-t0)};
  updateFastBadge();
}
function takePreloadedFrame(key,url){ if(preloadCache&&preloadCache.frame&&preloadCache.key===key&&preloadCache.url===url){ const f=preloadCache.frame; preloadCache=null; return f; } return null; }
function clearPreload(){ const el=document.getElementById("preloadSlot"); if(el) el.innerHTML=""; preloadCache=null; }
function updateFastBadge(){ const b=document.getElementById("fastBadge"); if(b) b.textContent=preloadCache?("FastStream: "+preloadCache.mode+" · "+preloadCache.ms+" ms"):""; }

/* ---- source discovery: feed auto-add + continuous health (browsers cannot crawl the web;
        discovery = your feed URL checked on an interval + built-in/custom health tracking) ---- */
function parseFeedData(data){
  const arr=Array.isArray(data)?data:(data&&Array.isArray(data.sources)?data.sources:[]);
  const out=[];
  for(const e of arr){ if(!e||typeof e!=="object") continue;
    if(e.manifestUrl||e.transportUrl||e.repoUrl||e.github||e.feedUrl||e.feed||e.website||e.site||e.manifest) continue;
    const movieTpl=String(e.movieTpl||e.movie||e.url||"").trim();
    const tvTpl=String(e.tvTpl||e.tv||e.episode||"").trim();
    if(!e.movieTpl&&!e.movie&&e.url&&!tvTpl){ const seedKind=classifySeedUrl(e.url).kind; if(seedKind==="github"||seedKind==="manifest"||seedKind==="feed") continue; }
    if(!validateTemplate(movieTpl)||!validateTemplate(tvTpl)) continue;
    if(!movieTpl&&!tvTpl) continue;
    let host=""; try{ host=new URL(movieTpl||tvTpl).hostname; }catch{ continue; }
    out.push({name:String(e.name||prettyHostName(host)).slice(0,40),movieTpl,tvTpl,direct:!!e.direct||isDirectMedia(movieTpl||tvTpl)});
  }
  return out;
}
function sourceSignature(s){ return (s.movieTpl||"")+"|"+(s.tvTpl||""); }
async function checkFeed(manual){
  const url=(settings.feed.url||"").trim();
  if(!url){ if(manual) toast("Add a provider feed URL first","error"); return 0; }
  try{
    const result=await processFeedUrl(url,{from:"manual feed check"});
    settings.feed.lastCheck=Date.now(); saveSettings();
    const added=(result.added||0)+(result.templatesAdded||0);
    if(added) toast(added+" new feed entr"+(added===1?"y":"ies")+" processed","success");
    else if(manual) toast("Feed checked — no new entries");
    if(routeNow()==="sources") renderSources(true);
    return added;
  }catch(err){ settings.feed.lastCheck=Date.now(); saveSettings(); dlog("Feed check failed: "+(err&&err.message||err)); if(manual) toast("Feed check failed: "+(err&&err.message||err),"error"); if(routeNow()==="sources") renderSources(true); return 0; }
}
function dlog(msg){ if(!Array.isArray(settings.dlog)) settings.dlog=[]; settings.dlog.unshift({t:Date.now(),msg:String(msg)}); settings.dlog=settings.dlog.slice(0,100); saveSettings(); }
let discoveryTimer=null;
function scheduleDiscovery(){
