Change these in Settings → FastStream configuration and playback.</p><div class="settings-actions"><button class="btn btn-outline btn-sm" type="button" data-settings-section="faststream">Change speed defaults</button></div></div></div>'
    +'<div id="downloadJobsList" style="margin-top:1rem"><span class="spinner"></span> Loading stored downloads…</div></section>'
    +'<section class="panel" id="m3uExtractor"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>M3U extraction</h2><p class="section-desc">Paste a website/watch page or an M3U/M3U8 URL. ZeroPlay extracts playlist links, can inspect quality variants and segment counts, and can download the assembled HLS file. A cross-origin embed alone cannot be converted into an M3U.</p></div>'+featureSwitchHTML("m3uExtraction","M3U extraction enabled","","downloads")+'</div>'
    +'<div class="form-row"><div class="form-group grow"><label for="m3uUrl">Website, watch-page or M3U/M3U8 URL</label><input type="text" id="m3uUrl" placeholder="https://example.com/watch/... or https://cdn.example/stream.m3u8"></div><div class="form-group"><label for="m3uTitle">Download title (optional)</label><input type="text" id="m3uTitle" placeholder="My extracted stream"></div></div>'
    +'<details class="advanced"><summary>Paste playlist text instead</summary><div class="advanced-body"><div class="form-group"><label for="m3uText">M3U/M3U8 text</label><textarea id="m3uText" rows="7" placeholder="#EXTM3U\n#EXT-X-STREAM-INF:..."></textarea><small class="help-text">Relative links are resolved against the URL above. To download a pasted media playlist, its real hosted URL must be entered above.</small></div></div></details>'
    +'<button class="btn btn-primary" id="btnExtractM3u" type="button">Extract M3U links</button><div id="m3uStatus" class="status-box hidden"></div><div id="m3uResults"></div></section></div>';
  document.getElementById("btnExtractM3u").onclick=runM3uExtraction;
  document.getElementById("btnClearCompletedDownloads").onclick=()=>clearCompletedDownloads();
  renderM3uResults(); syncFeatureToggles(view); updateDownloadStorageMeter();
  loadDownloadJobs().then(()=>{ renderDownloadJobLists(); updateDownloadStorageMeter(); });
}
document.addEventListener("click",e=>{
  const downloadBtn=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest("[data-download-action][data-download-id]");
  if(downloadBtn){ e.preventDefault(); handleDownloadAction(downloadBtn.dataset.downloadAction,downloadBtn.dataset.downloadId,downloadBtn); return; }
  const m3uBtn=e.target.closest&&e.target.closest("[data-m3u-action][data-m3u-index]");
  if(m3uBtn){ e.preventDefault(); handleM3uAction(m3uBtn.dataset.m3uAction,Number(m3uBtn.dataset.m3uIndex),m3uBtn); }
});

/* ---------------- detail modal ---------------- */
let detailState=null;
async function openDetail(type,id){
  if(typeof rememberTvFocus==="function") rememberTvFocus(document.activeElement);
  stopCardPreview();
  document.querySelectorAll(".hero-trailer.on").forEach(stopBackdropPreview);
  detailState={type,id,season:null,episode:1,data:null};
  $("#modalRoot").innerHTML='<div class="overlay" id="detailOverlay"><div class="modal"><button class="icon-btn modal-close" id="btnCloseDetail" aria-label="Close">×</button><div style="padding:3rem;text-align:center;color:var(--text-muted)"><span class="spinner"></span> Loading…</div></div></div>';
  document.body.classList.add("locked");
  $("#btnCloseDetail").onclick=closeDetail;
  $("#detailOverlay").addEventListener("click",e=>{ if(e.target.id==="detailOverlay") closeDetail(); });
  try{
    let externalItem=searchResultItems.get(keyOf(type,Number(id)))||null;
    let localItem=catalogItemFor(type,Number(id));
    const hasLocalTitle=!!(localItem&&localItem.id&&titleOf(localItem)!=="Title"&&titleOf(localItem)!=="Untitled");
    if(!externalItem&&Number(id)>=900000000){
      if(hasLocalTitle) externalItem=localItem;
      else{
        const saved=watchlist.find(item=>item.type===type&&Number(item.id)===Number(id))||progress[keyOf(type,Number(id))];
        if(saved){ externalItem=snapToItem(saved); localItem=externalItem; }
      }
    }
    let d,usedLocalFallback=!!externalItem;
    if(externalItem) d=externalItem;
    else{
      try{ d=await tmdb("/"+type+"/"+id,{append_to_response:"credits,videos,recommendations,external_ids,alternative_titles"}); }catch{}
      const remoteUsable=!!(d&&Number(d.id)===Number(id)&&titleOf(d)!=="Title"&&titleOf(d)!=="Untitled");
      const remoteMatchesLocal=!hasLocalTitle||remoteUsable&&searchNormTitle(titleOf(d))===searchNormTitle(titleOf(localItem));
      if(hasLocalTitle&&(!remoteUsable||!remoteMatchesLocal)){ d=localItem; usedLocalFallback=true; }
      else if(remoteUsable&&remoteMatchesLocal) d=Object.assign({},hasLocalTitle?localItem:{},d);
      else throw new Error("No title metadata is available");
    }
    d=Object.assign({credits:{cast:[]},videos:{results:[]},recommendations:{results:[]},external_ids:{imdb_id:""}},d,{id:Number(id),media_type:type});
    detailState.data=d;
    if(type==="tv"){ const prev=progress[keyOf(type,id)]; const seasons=(d.seasons||[]).filter(s=>s.season_number>0); detailState.season=(prev&&prev.season)||(seasons[0]&&seasons[0].season_number)||1; detailState.episode=(prev&&prev.season===detailState.season&&prev.episode)||1; }
    drawDetail();
    if(type==="tv"&&!usedLocalFallback) loadEpisodes();
  }catch(err){
    $(".modal").innerHTML='<button class="icon-btn modal-close" id="btnCloseDetail" aria-label="Close">×</button><div style="padding:2.5rem"><div class="status-box error">Could not load this title. Check your connection and try again.</div></div>';
    $("#btnCloseDetail").onclick=closeDetail;
  }
}
function closeDetail(){ const preview=document.getElementById("detailTrailer"); if(preview) stopBackdropPreview(preview); $("#modalRoot").innerHTML=""; detailState=null; if(!playerState) document.body.classList.remove("locked"); if(typeof restoreTvFocus==="function") restoreTvFocus(); }
function drawDetail(){
  const d=rememberCatalogItem(Object.assign({},detailState.data,{media_type:detailState.type})); detailState.data=d;
  const type=detailState.type, isTV=type==="tv";
  const genres=(d.genres||[]).map(g=>g.name).filter(Boolean);
  const runtime=isTV?((d.episode_run_time||[])[0]?d.episode_run_time[0]+" min/ep":""):(d.runtime?Math.floor(d.runtime/60)+"h "+(d.runtime%60)+"m":"");
  const trailer=(d.videos&&d.videos.results||[]).find(v=>v.site==="YouTube"&&v.type==="Trailer")||(d.videos&&d.videos.results||[]).find(v=>v.site==="YouTube");
  const cast=(d.credits&&d.credits.cast||[]).slice(0,14);
  const recs=(d.recommendations&&d.recommendations.results||[]).slice(0,12);
  const prev=progress[keyOf(type,d.id)]||{};
  const playLabel=isTV?("▶ Watch S"+(prev.season||detailState.season||1)+" E"+(prev.episode||1)):"▶ Watch Now";
  const seasons=(d.seasons||[]).filter(s=>s.season_number>=0);
  $(".modal").innerHTML='<button class="icon-btn modal-close" id="btnCloseDetail" aria-label="Close">×</button>'
        +'<div class="detail-hero"><img class="hero-bg" src="'+esc(backdropURL(d))+'" alt=""'+artworkImgAttrs(d,"backdrop",backdropURL(d))+'><div class="hero-trailer" id="detailTrailer" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="hero-shade"></div></div>'
        +'<div class="detail-body"><img class="detail-poster" src="'+esc(posterURL(d,"w500"))+'" alt="'+esc(titleOf(d))+'"'+artworkImgAttrs(d,"poster",posterURL(d,"w500"))+'><div>'
    +'<span class="logo-badge" style="margin-bottom:.6rem">'+(isTV?"Series":"Movie")+'</span>'
    +"<h2>"+esc(titleOf(d))+"</h2>"
    +'<div class="hero-meta">'+(d.vote_average?'<span class="chip star">★ '+Number(d.vote_average).toFixed(1)+'</span>':"")+(yearOf(d)?'<span class="chip">'+esc(yearOf(d))+"</span>":"")+(runtime?'<span class="chip">'+esc(runtime)+"</span>":"")+(isTV&&d.number_of_seasons?'<span class="chip">'+d.number_of_seasons+" Seasons · "+(d.number_of_episodes||"?")+" Episodes</span>":"")+(d.status?'<span class="chip">'+esc(d.status)+"</span>":"")+'</div>'
    +(genres.length?'<div class="hero-meta">'+genres.map(g=>'<span class="chip violet">'+esc(g)+"</span>").join("")+"</div>":"")
    +'<p class="overview">'+esc(d.overview||"No synopsis available.")+"</p>"
    +'<div class="detail-actions"><button class="btn btn-primary btn-large" id="btnPlay">'+esc(playLabel)+"</button>"
    +(trailer?'<button class="btn btn-secondary" id="btnTrailer">▶ Trailer</button><button class="btn btn-outline" id="btnDetailPreviewSound">Preview sound</button>':"")
    +'<button class="btn btn-secondary" id="btnStreams">Servers with this title</button>'
    +(downloadsEnabled()?'<button class="btn btn-secondary" id="btnDownloadTitle" type="button">⬇ Download'+(isTV?" episode":"")+'</button>':"")
    +'<button class="btn btn-outline" id="btnWatchlist" data-type="'+type+'" data-id="'+d.id+'">'+(inWatchlist(type,d.id)?"✓ In Library":"+ Watchlist")+"</button>"
    +'<label class="sr-only" for="detailQuality">Preferred quality</label><select id="detailQuality" class="control-select" aria-label="Preferred quality">'+[["auto","Auto quality"],["2160p","4K 2160p"],["1080p","1080p"],["720p","720p"],["480p","480p"]].map(([v,t])=>'<option value="'+v+'"'+(settings.stream.quality===v?" selected":"")+">"+t+"</option>").join("")+"</select></div>"
    +'<div class="help-text">Servers are checked against this exact title'+(isTV?" and episode":"")+' — ZeroPlay only lists servers that return a match.</div>'
    +(prev.percent?'<div class="help-text">Resume available — '+Math.round(prev.percent)+"% watched"+(isTV?" (S"+(prev.season||1)+" E"+(prev.episode||1)+")":"")+".</div>":"")
    +"</div></div>"
    +(isTV&&seasons.length?'<div class="detail-section"><h3>Episodes</h3><div class="season-row"><div class="form-group"><label for="seasonSelect">Season</label><select id="seasonSelect">'+seasons.map(s=>'<option value="'+s.season_number+'"'+(s.season_number===detailState.season?" selected":"")+">"+esc(s.name||("Season "+s.season_number))+(s.episode_count?" ("+s.episode_count+")":"")+"</option>").join("")+'</select></div></div><div id="epList"><span class="spinner"></span> <span style="color:var(--text-muted)">Loading episodes…</span></div></div>':"")
    +(cast.length?'<div class="detail-section"><h3>Cast</h3><div class="cast-track">'+cast.map(c=>'<div class="cast">'+(c.profile_path?'<img loading="lazy" src="'+IMG+"w185"+esc(c.profile_path)+'" alt="'+esc(c.name)+'">':'<div class="avatar">'+esc(initials(c.name))+'</div>')+'<div class="n">'+esc(c.name)+'</div><div class="c">'+esc(c.character||"")+"</div></div>").join("")+"</div></div>":"")
    +(recs.length?'<div class="detail-section" id="recSection"><h3>More Like This</h3><div class="rail-track">'+recs.map(r=>cardHTML(Object.assign({},r,{media_type:type}))).join("")+"</div></div>":"");
  $("#btnCloseDetail").onclick=closeDetail;
  $("#btnPlay").onclick=()=>{ const q=$("#detailQuality"); if(q){ settings.stream.quality=q.value; applyQualityPreset(q.value); saveSettings(); } openPlayer(snap(d,type),{season:isTV?(prev.season||detailState.season||1):undefined,episode:isTV?(prev.episode||1):undefined,source:defaultSourceId()}); };
  const dq=$("#detailQuality"); if(dq) dq.onchange=e=>{ settings.stream.quality=e.target.value; applyQualityPreset(e.target.value); saveSettings(); toast("Quality preference: "+e.target.value); };
  $("#btnStreams").onclick=()=>{ const identity=identityFromDetail(d,type,isTV?(detailState.season||prev.season||1):1,isTV?(detailState.episode||prev.episode||1):1); showStreamsModal({type,id:d.id,title:identity.title,altTitles:identity.titles,year:identity.year,season:identity.season,episode:identity.episode,imdb:identity.imdbId,identity,item:snap(d,type)}); };
  const downloadTitleBtn=$("#btnDownloadTitle");
  if(downloadTitleBtn) downloadTitleBtn.onclick=()=>{ const identity=identityFromDetail(d,type,isTV?(detailState.season||prev.season||1):1,isTV?(detailState.episode||prev.episode||1):1); openDownloadForContext({type,id:d.id,title:identity.title,altTitles:identity.titles,year:identity.year,season:identity.season,episode:identity.episode,imdb:identity.imdbId,identity,item:snap(d,type)}); };
  $("#btnWatchlist").onclick=()=>toggleWatchlist(type,d.id,null,snap(d,type));
  if(trailer){
    $("#btnTrailer").onclick=()=>openTrailer(titleOf(d),trailer.key);
    const detailItem=rememberCatalogItem(Object.assign({},d,{trailer_key:trailer.key,media_type:type}));
    const detailTrailer=$("#detailTrailer");
    const soundBtn=$("#btnDetailPreviewSound");
    if(soundBtn) soundBtn.onclick=()=>{ toggleBackdropPreviewSound(detailTrailer,detailItem); soundBtn.textContent=detailTrailer&&detailTrailer.dataset.sound==="1"?"Mute preview":"Preview sound"; };
    startBackdropPreview(detailTrailer,detailItem,{delay:750});
  }
  const seasonSelect=$("#seasonSelect");
  if(isTV&&seasonSelect) seasonSelect.onchange=e=>{ detailState.season=Number(e.target.value); loadEpisodes(); };
  const rec=$("#recSection"); if(rec) bindCards(rec);
  bindArtworkFallbacks($(".modal"));
  void resolveArtwork(d,{backdrop:true});
  if(ANDROID_TV_APP) setTimeout(()=>{ const play=document.getElementById("btnPlay"); if(play&&detailState) play.focus({preventScroll:true}); },40);
  const da=document.querySelector(".detail-actions"); if(da&&!document.getElementById("fastBadge")){ const fb=document.createElement("span"); fb.className="chip violet"; fb.id="fastBadge"; da.appendChild(fb); }
  faststreamPreload({type,id:d.id,title:titleOf(d),year:yearOf(d),season:isTV?(prev.season||detailState.season||1):1,episode:isTV?(prev.episode||1):1,identity:identityFromDetail(d,type,isTV?(prev.season||detailState.season||1):1,isTV?(prev.episode||1):1)}, defaultSourceId());
}

const tvmazeEpisodeArtworkCache=new Map();
function episodeStillInfo(ep,item){
  let raw=ep&&(ep.still_url||ep.thumbnail_url||ep.thumbnail)||"";
  if(!raw&&ep&&ep.still_path) raw=/^https?:\/\//i.test(String(ep.still_path))?String(ep.still_path):IMG+"w300"+ep.still_path;
  const still=cleanArtworkUrl(raw,"backdrop");
  if(still) return {url:still,missing:false};
  const fallback=item?backdropURL(item,"w300"):"";
  return {url:/^data:/i.test(fallback)?phSVG("Episode "+(ep&&ep.episode_number||""),(item&&item.id||9)+(ep&&ep.episode_number||0),640,360):fallback,missing:true};
}
async function fillEpisodeThumbnailsFromTvmaze(box,stateToken,season){
  if(!box||!artworkFallbackEnabled()||!artworkSetting("tvmaze")||!stateToken||!stateToken.data) return;
  const missing=$$('img[data-episode-thumb-missing="1"]',box);
  if(!missing.length) return;
  const item=snapToItem(snap(stateToken.data,"tv"));
  const found=await tvmazeShowForItem(item);
  if(!found.show||detailState!==stateToken||Number(detailState.season)!==Number(season)||!box.isConnected) return;
  const showId=Number(found.show.id);
  if(!showId) return;
  if(!tvmazeEpisodeArtworkCache.has(showId)){
    const promise=(async()=>{
      const rows=await artworkFetchJson("https://api.tvmaze.com/shows/"+showId+"/episodes?specials=1",{timeoutMs:12000});
      const map=new Map();
      (Array.isArray(rows)?rows:[]).forEach(row=>{
        const image=row&&row.image||{};
        const url=cleanArtworkUrl(tvPerformanceEnabled()?(image.medium||image.original||""):(image.original||image.medium||""),"backdrop");
        if(url) map.set(Number(row.season)+":"+Number(row.number),url);
      });
      return map;
    })().catch(()=>new Map());
    tvmazeEpisodeArtworkCache.set(showId,promise);
  }
  const map=await tvmazeEpisodeArtworkCache.get(showId);
  if(detailState!==stateToken||Number(detailState.season)!==Number(season)||!box.isConnected) return;
  for(const img of missing){
    if(!img.isConnected) continue;
    const url=map.get(Number(season)+":"+Number(img.dataset.episodeThumb||0));
    if(url&&await artworkProbeImage(url)){ delete img.dataset.fb; img.dataset.episodeThumbMissing=""; img.src=url; }
  }
}

async function loadEpisodes(){
  const box=$("#epList"); if(!box||!detailState) return;
  const stateToken=detailState, season=detailState.season;
  try{
    const data=await tmdb("/tv/"+detailState.id+"/season/"+season);
    const eps=data.episodes||[];
    if(!detailState||detailState!==stateToken) return;
    box.innerHTML=eps.length?'<div class="ep-list">'+eps.map(ep=>{
      const still=episodeStillInfo(ep,detailState.data);
      return '<div class="ep" data-ep="'+ep.episode_number+'"><button class="ep-main" type="button" data-ep-play="'+ep.episode_number+'" aria-label="Play episode '+ep.episode_number+'"><span class="ep-thumb"><img class="episode-thumb-img" loading="lazy" src="'+esc(still.url)+'" alt="" data-episode-thumb="'+ep.episode_number+'"'+(still.missing?' data-episode-thumb-missing="1"':"")+'><span class="ep-num-badge">'+ep.episode_number+'</span></span><span class="ep-copy"><span class="et">'+esc(ep.name||("Episode "+ep.episode_number))+'</span><br><span class="es">'+esc(ep.air_date||"")+(ep.runtime?" · "+ep.runtime+" min":"")+'</span></span></button>'+(downloadsEnabled()?'<button class="ep-download" type="button" data-ep-download="'+ep.episode_number+'" aria-label="Download episode '+ep.episode_number+'" title="Download this episode">⬇<small>Download</small></button>':"")+"</div>";
    }).join("")+"</div>"
      :'<p style="color:var(--text-muted)">No episode data for this season.</p>';
    $$(".ep",box).forEach(row=>{
      const episodeNumber=Number(row.dataset.ep)||1;
      const mark=()=>{ detailState.episode=episodeNumber; };
      row.addEventListener("mouseenter",mark);
      const play=row.querySelector("[data-ep-play]");
      if(play){ play.addEventListener("focus",mark); play.onclick=()=>openPlayer(snap(detailState.data,"tv"),{season:detailState.season,episode:episodeNumber,source:defaultSourceId()}); }
      const download=row.querySelector("[data-ep-download]");
      if(download){ download.addEventListener("focus",mark); download.onclick=e=>{ e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation(); const identity=identityFromDetail(detailState.data,"tv",detailState.season,episodeNumber); openDownloadForContext({type:"tv",id:detailState.id,title:identity.title,altTitles:identity.titles,year:identity.year,season:identity.season,episode:identity.episode,imdb:identity.imdbId,identity,item:snap(detailState.data,"tv")}); }; }
    });
    void fillEpisodeThumbnailsFromTvmaze(box,stateToken,season);
  }catch{ box.innerHTML='<div class="status-box error">Could not load episodes.</div>'; }
}

/* ---------------- views ---------------- */
function continueItems(){
  return Object.values(progress).filter(p=>p.title&&(!p.percent||p.percent<98)).sort((a,b)=>(b.updatedAt||0)-(a.updatedAt||0)).slice(0,14)
    .map(p=>snapToItem(p));
}
async function renderHome(){
  const resumeItems=continueItems();
  const resumeHTML=resumeItems.length?continueRailHTML(resumeItems):"";
  const heroHTML='<div id="heroSlot">'+skeletonRail("Featured")+"</div>";
  view.innerHTML='<div class="page">'+(ANDROID_TV_APP&&resumeItems.length?resumeHTML+heroHTML:heroHTML+resumeHTML)
    +(watchlist.length?railHTML("My Watchlist",watchlist.map(w=>({id:w.id,media_type:w.type,title:w.type==="movie"?w.title:undefined,name:w.type==="tv"?w.title:undefined,poster_path:w.poster_path,poster_url:w.poster_url||null,backdrop_url:w.backdrop_url||null,imdb_id:w.imdb_id||null,release_date:w.year?w.year+"-01-01":"",first_air_date:w.year?w.year+"-01-01":"",vote_average:w.rating?Number(w.rating):0,trailer_key:w.trailer_key||null,logo_url:w.logo_url||null,genre_ids:w.genre_ids||[],overview:w.overview||""}))):"")
    +'<div id="homeCategoryRail"></div><div id="railTrending">'+skeletonRail("Trending Today")+'</div><div id="railMovies">'+skeletonRail("Popular Movies")+'</div><div id="railSeries">'+skeletonRail("Popular Series")+'</div><div id="railAction">'+skeletonRail("Action & Adventure")+'</div><div id="railAnimation">'+skeletonRail("Animated Worlds")+'</div><div id="railThriller">'+skeletonRail("After Dark: Thrillers")+'</div><div id="railTop">'+skeletonRail("Top Rated Movies")+'</div><div id="railNow">'+skeletonRail("Now Playing")+"</div></div>";
  bindCards(view);
  const fill=async(id,title,path,params,opts)=>{ try{ const d=await tmdb(path,params); const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el){ el.outerHTML=railHTML(title,(d.results||[]).filter(x=>typeOf(x)==="movie"||typeOf(x)==="tv").slice(0,tvPerformanceEnabled()?12:16),opts); bindCards(view); } return d.results||[]; }catch{ const el=document.getElementById(id); if(el) el.innerHTML='<div class="status-box error">'+esc(title)+' failed to load. <button class="btn btn-secondary btn-xs" onclick="location.hash=\'#/home\';location.reload()">Retry</button></div>'; return []; } };
  const trending=await fill("railTrending","Trending Today","/trending/all/day",{page:1});
  const hero=(trending||[]).find(x=>x.backdrop_path||x.backdrop_url)||(trending||[])[0];
  const hs=$("#heroSlot");
  if(hero&&hs){
    const type=typeOf(hero);
    const remembered=rememberCatalogItem(hero);
    const heroGenres=(remembered.genre_ids||[]).map(id=>genreName(type,id)).filter(Boolean).slice(0,3);
        hs.innerHTML='<section class="hero"><img class="hero-bg" src="'+esc(backdropURL(hero))+'" alt=""'+artworkImgAttrs(remembered,"backdrop",backdropURL(hero))+'><div class="hero-trailer" id="homeHeroTrailer" aria-hidden="true"></div><div class="hero-shade"></div><div class="hero-body">'
      +'<span class="logo-badge">Featured</span>'+(remembered.logo_url?'<img class="hero-logo" id="heroLogo" src="'+esc(remembered.logo_url)+'" alt="" style="display:none">':"")+'<h1 id="heroTitle">'+esc(titleOf(hero))+"</h1>"
      +'<div class="hero-meta">'+(hero.vote_average?'<span class="chip star">★ '+Number(hero.vote_average).toFixed(1)+"</span>":"")+'<span class="chip">'+(type==="tv"?"TV Series":"Movie")+"</span>"+(yearOf(hero)?'<span class="chip">'+esc(yearOf(hero))+"</span>":"")+heroGenres.map(g=>'<span class="chip violet">'+esc(g)+"</span>").join("")+'</div>'
      +"<p>"+esc(hero.overview||"")+"</p>"
      +'<div class="hero-actions"><button class="btn btn-primary btn-large" id="heroPlay">▶ Watch Now</button><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="heroDetails">Details</button><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="heroServers">Servers</button><button class="btn btn-outline" id="heroList">'+(inWatchlist(type,hero.id)?"✓ In Library":"+ Watchlist")+'</button><span class="trailer-ctl"><button class="btn btn-outline" id="heroPreviewSound" type="button">Trailer sound</button></span></div></div></section>';
    $("#heroPlay").onclick=()=>openPlayer(snap(hero,type),{});
    $("#heroDetails").onclick=()=>openDetail(type,hero.id);
    $("#heroServers").onclick=()=>{ const identity=buildTitleIdentity({item:remembered,type,id:hero.id,title:titleOf(hero),year:yearOf(hero),imdb:remembered.imdb_id||""}); showStreamsModal({type,id:hero.id,title:identity.title,altTitles:identity.titles,year:identity.year,season:1,episode:1,imdb:identity.imdbId,identity,item:snap(hero,type)}); };
    $("#heroList").onclick=e=>{ toggleWatchlist(type,hero.id,null,snap(hero,type)); e.target.textContent=inWatchlist(type,hero.id)?"✓ In Library":"+ Watchlist"; };
    const heroLogo=$("#heroLogo"), heroTitle=$("#heroTitle");
    if(heroLogo){ heroLogo.addEventListener("load",()=>{ heroLogo.style.display="block"; if(heroTitle) heroTitle.style.display="none"; }); heroLogo.addEventListener("error",()=>heroLogo.remove()); if(heroLogo.complete&&heroLogo.naturalWidth){ heroLogo.style.display="block"; if(heroTitle) heroTitle.style.display="none"; } }
    const heroTrailer=$("#homeHeroTrailer"), soundBtn=$("#heroPreviewSound");
    if(soundBtn) soundBtn.onclick=()=>{ toggleBackdropPreviewSound(heroTrailer,remembered); soundBtn.textContent=heroTrailer&&heroTrailer.dataset.sound==="1"?"Mute trailer":"Trailer sound"; };
    bindArtworkFallbacks(hs);
    startBackdropPreview(heroTrailer,remembered,{delay:tvPerformanceEnabled()?2200:1000});
  } else if(hs){ hs.innerHTML=""; }

  const homeCategorySlot=document.getElementById("homeCategoryRail");
  if(homeCategorySlot){
    const homePools={movie:[],tv:[]};
    (trending||[]).forEach(item=>{ const t=typeOf(item); if(homePools[t]) homePools[t].push(item); });
    homeCategorySlot.outerHTML=homeCategoryRailHTML(homePools);
    bindCards(view);
  }
  fill("railMovies","Popular Movies","/movie/popular",{page:1});
  fill("railSeries","Popular Series","/tv/popular",{page:1});
  fill("railAction","Action & Adventure","/discover/movie",{with_genres:28,sort_by:"popularity.desc",page:1});
  fill("railAnimation","Animated Worlds","/discover/movie",{with_genres:16,sort_by:"popularity.desc",page:1});
  fill("railThriller","After Dark: Thrillers","/discover/movie",{with_genres:53,sort_by:"popularity.desc",page:1});
  fill("railTop","Top Rated Movies","/movie/top_rated",{page:1});
  fill("railNow","Now Playing","/movie/now_playing",{page:1});
}

  ["tv",18,"Drama"],["tv",16,"Animation"],["tv",80,"Crime"],["tv",9648,"Mystery"]

function categoryTileHTML(type,id,name,pool,index){
  const list=Array.isArray(pool)?pool:[];
  const rep=list.find(x=>(x.genre_ids||[]).includes(Number(id))&&(x.backdrop_path||x.backdrop_url||x.poster_path||x.poster_url))||list.find(x=>x.backdrop_path||x.backdrop_url||x.poster_path||x.poster_url)||list[index%Math.max(1,list.length)]||null;
  const item=rep?rememberCatalogItem(rep):null;
  const img=item?backdropURL(item,"w780"):phSVG(name,id,640,360);
  const attrs=item?artworkImgAttrs(item,"backdrop",img):"";
  return '<button class="category-tile category-rail-tile" type="button" data-category-type="'+type+'" data-category-id="'+id+'" aria-label="Browse '+esc(name)+' '+(type==="tv"?"series":"movies")+'"><img loading="lazy" src="'+esc(img)+'" alt=""'+attrs+'><b>'+esc(name)+'</b><span>'+(type==="tv"?"Series":"Movies")+' · Browse shelf →</span></button>';
}
function homeCategoryRailHTML(pools){
  if(settings.ui&&settings.ui.showCategoryStrip===false) return "";
  const tiles=HOME_CATEGORY_TILES.map(([type,id,name],index)=>categoryTileHTML(type,id,name,(pools&&pools[type])||[],index)).join("");
  return '<section class="rail home-category-rail"><div class="rail-head"><h2>Browse by Category</h2><div class="rail-arrows"><button class="icon-btn" data-scroll="-1" aria-label="Scroll categories left">‹</button><button class="icon-btn" data-scroll="1" aria-label="Scroll categories right">›</button></div></div><div class="rail-track category-rail-track">'+tiles+'<button class="category-tile category-rail-tile category-all-tile" type="button" data-menu-route="categories"><img loading="lazy" src="'+esc(phSVG("All Categories",99,640,360))+'" alt=""><b>All Categories</b><span>Movies & series · Open →</span></button></div><div class="rail-progress" aria-hidden="true"><i></i></div></section>';
}

function categoryHash(type,id){ return "#/"+(type==="tv"?"series":"movies")+"?genre="+encodeURIComponent(id); }
function navigateCategory(type,id){ closeMenuDrawer(); const target=categoryHash(type,id); if(location.hash===target) render(); else location.hash=target; }
async function renderCategories(){
  view.innerHTML='<div class="page"><h1>Categories</h1><p class="lede">Jump straight into a mood. Every tile opens a focused, TV-friendly shelf.</p><div id="categoryGroups"><p style="color:var(--text-muted)"><span class="spinner"></span> Loading categories…</p></div></div>';
  bindCards(view);
  let pools={movie:[],tv:[]};
  try{
    const [movies,shows]=await Promise.all([tmdb("/movie/popular",{page:1}),tmdb("/tv/popular",{page:1})]);
    pools.movie=movies.results||[]; pools.tv=shows.results||[];
  }catch{}

  }).join("");
  bindArtworkFallbacks(box);

const browseState={type:"movie",page:1,total:1,items:[],genre:"",year:"",rating:"",sort:"popularity.desc",loading:false};
function renderBrowse(type,initial){
  initial=initial||{};
  const genres=type==="tv"?GENRES_TV:GENRES_MOVIE;
  const genre=initial.genre&&genres[initial.genre]?String(initial.genre):"";
  const sort=initial.sort&&["popularity.desc","vote_average.desc",type==="tv"?"first_air_date.desc":"primary_release_date.desc"].includes(initial.sort)?initial.sort:"popularity.desc";
  Object.assign(browseState,{type,page:1,items:[],genre,year:/^\d{4}$/.test(initial.year||"")?initial.year:"",rating:["6","7","8"].includes(String(initial.rating||""))?String(initial.rating):"",sort});
  const years=['<option value="">Any year</option>']; for(let y=2026;y>=1980;y--) years.push('<option value="'+y+'"'+(String(y)===browseState.year?" selected":"")+">"+y+" &amp; newer</option>");
  const title=genre?(genres[genre]+" "+(type==="tv"?"Series":"Movies")):(type==="tv"?"TV Series":"Movies");
  const quick=(CATEGORY_GROUPS.find(g=>g.type===type)||{items:[]}).items.slice(0,9);
  view.innerHTML='<div class="page"><h1>'+esc(title)+'</h1><p class="lede">Browse with a remote, keyboard, mouse or touch — focused titles preview their trailer inline.</p>'
    +'<div class="category-quick" id="browseCategories"><button class="chip-btn'+(!genre?" active":"")+'" data-browse-genre="" type="button">All</button>'+quick.map(([id,n])=>'<button class="chip-btn'+(String(id)===genre?" active":"")+'" data-browse-genre="'+id+'" type="button">'+esc(n)+"</button>").join("")+'<button class="chip-btn" data-menu-route="categories" type="button">All categories</button></div>'
    +'<div class="filters"><div class="form-group"><label for="fGenre">Genre</label><select id="fGenre"><option value="">All genres</option>'+Object.entries(genres).map(([id,n])=>'<option value="'+id+'"'+(id===genre?" selected":"")+">"+esc(n)+"</option>").join("")+'</select></div>'
    +'<div class="form-group"><label for="fYear">Released</label><select id="fYear">'+years.join("")+'</select></div>'
    +'<div class="form-group"><label for="fRating">Minimum rating</label><select id="fRating"><option value="">Any rating</option>'+[6,7,8].map(r=>'<option value="'+r+'"'+(browseState.rating===String(r)?" selected":"")+">★ "+r+"+</option>").join("")+'</select></div>'
    +'<div class="form-group"><label for="fSort">Sort</label><select id="fSort"><option value="popularity.desc"'+(sort==="popularity.desc"?" selected":"")+'>Most popular</option><option value="vote_average.desc"'+(sort==="vote_average.desc"?" selected":"")+'>Top rated</option><option value="'+(type==="tv"?"first_air_date.desc":"primary_release_date.desc")+'"'+(sort===(type==="tv"?"first_air_date.desc":"primary_release_date.desc")?" selected":"")+'>Newest</option></select></div></div>'
    +'<div class="grid" id="browseGrid"></div><div class="load-more"><button class="btn btn-secondary" id="btnMore">Load more</button></div></div>';
  bindCards(view);
  const syncHash=()=>{ const q=new URLSearchParams(); if(browseState.genre) q.set("genre",browseState.genre); if(browseState.year) q.set("year",browseState.year); if(browseState.rating) q.set("rating",browseState.rating); if(browseState.sort&&browseState.sort!=="popularity.desc") q.set("sort",browseState.sort); history.replaceState(null,"","#/"+(type==="tv"?"series":"movies")+(q.toString()?"?"+q:"")); };
  const reload=()=>{ browseState.page=1; browseState.items=[]; $("#browseGrid").innerHTML=""; $$("#browseCategories [data-browse-genre]").forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle("active",b.dataset.browseGenre===browseState.genre)); syncHash(); loadBrowsePage(); };
  $("#browseCategories").addEventListener("click",e=>{ const b=e.target.closest("[data-browse-genre]"); if(!b) return; browseState.genre=b.dataset.browseGenre; $("#fGenre").value=browseState.genre; reload(); });
  $("#fGenre").onchange=e=>{ browseState.genre=e.target.value; reload(); };
  $("#fYear").onchange=e=>{ browseState.year=e.target.value; reload(); };
  $("#fRating").onchange=e=>{ browseState.rating=e.target.value; reload(); };
  $("#fSort").onchange=e=>{ browseState.sort=e.target.value; reload(); };
  $("#btnMore").onclick=()=>{ browseState.page++; loadBrowsePage(); };
  loadBrowsePage();
}
async function loadBrowsePage(){
  if(browseState.loading) return; browseState.loading=true;
  const btn=$("#btnMore"); if(btn){ btn.disabled=true; btn.innerHTML='<span class="spinner"></span> Loading…'; }
  const grid=$("#browseGrid");
  try{
    const params={page:browseState.page,sort_by:browseState.sort};
    if(browseState.genre) params.with_genres=browseState.genre;
    if(browseState.rating){ params["vote_average.gte"]=browseState.rating; params["vote_count.gte"]="100"; }
    if(browseState.year){ const k=browseState.type==="tv"?"first_air_date.gte":"primary_release_date.gte"; params[k]=browseState.year+"-01-01"; }
    const filtered=browseState.genre||browseState.year||browseState.rating||browseState.sort!=="popularity.desc";
    const path=filtered?"/discover/"+browseState.type:(browseState.type==="tv"?"/tv/popular":"/movie/popular");
    const d=await tmdb(path,filtered?params:{page:browseState.page});
    browseState.total=d.total_pages||1;
    const seen=new Set(browseState.items.map(i=>i.id));
    const fresh=(d.results||[]).filter(x=>!seen.has(x.id));
    browseState.items.push(...fresh);
    if(grid){ if(browseState.page===1&&!fresh.length) grid.innerHTML='<div class="empty" style="grid-column:1/-1"><h3>Nothing found</h3><p>Try loosening the filters above.</p></div>';
      else { grid.insertAdjacentHTML("beforeend",fresh.map((it,i)=>cardHTML(Object.assign({},it,{media_type:browseState.type}),{index:i})).join("")); bindArtworkFallbacks(grid); } }
    if(btn) btn.style.display=browseState.page>=browseState.total?"none":"";
  }catch{ if(grid&&browseState.page===1) grid.innerHTML='<div class="status-box error" style="grid-column:1/-1">Catalog failed to load. Check your connection, then open Settings to review playback and discovery.</div>'; }
  browseState.loading=false; if(btn){ btn.disabled=false; btn.textContent="Load more"; }
}

const searchState={q:"",filter:"all",results:[]};
let searchSequence=0, searchController=null, searchTimer=null;
const SEARCH_RECENTS_KEY="zp_rd_search_recent_v1";
const searchResultItems=new Map();
function searchRecentItems(){ const value=loadJSON(SEARCH_RECENTS_KEY,[]); return Array.isArray(value)?value.filter(x=>typeof x==="string").slice(0,10):[]; }
function searchNormTitle(value){ return String(value||"").toLowerCase().normalize("NFKD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,"").replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g," ").trim(); }
function searchHash(value){ let h=2166136261; for(const c of String(value)){ h^=c.charCodeAt(0); h=Math.imul(h,16777619); } return 900000000+((h>>>0)%3000000000); }
const searchFetchCache=new Map();
async function searchFetchJson(url,signal,options){
  const ttl=options&&Number.isFinite(options.ttl)?options.ttl:300000;
  const cacheKey=options&&options.cacheKey||url, cached=searchFetchCache.get(cacheKey);
  if(cached&&Date.now()-cached.time<ttl) return cached.data;
  if(signal&&signal.aborted) throw new DOMException("Search superseded","AbortError");
  const controller=new AbortController(), timer=setTimeout(()=>controller.abort(),10000);
  const abort=()=>controller.abort();
  if(signal) signal.addEventListener("abort",abort,{once:true});
  try{
    const requestOptions=options&&options.fetchOptions||{};
    const response=await fetch(url,Object.assign({},requestOptions,{signal:controller.signal,headers:Object.assign({Accept:"application/json"},requestOptions.headers||{})}));
    if(!response.ok) throw new Error("HTTP "+response.status);
    const data=await response.json(); if(ttl>0){ searchFetchCache.set(cacheKey,{time:Date.now(),data}); while(searchFetchCache.size>100) searchFetchCache.delete(searchFetchCache.keys().next().value); } return data;
  }finally{ clearTimeout(timer); if(signal) signal.removeEventListener("abort",abort); }
}
function searchExternalItem(input,provider,providerId){
  if(!input||!input.title) return null;
  const type=input.type==="movie"||input.media_type==="movie"?"movie":"tv";
  const id=searchHash(provider+":"+providerId+":"+type);
  const year=Number(input.year)||0, date=year?year+"-01-01":"";
  const item={id,media_type:type,title:type==="movie"?input.title:undefined,name:type==="tv"?input.title:undefined,
    release_date:type==="movie"?date:"",first_air_date:type==="tv"?date:"",poster_url:input.poster||null,backdrop_url:input.backdrop||null,
    vote_average:Number(input.rating)||0,overview:input.desc||"",imdb_id:input.imdb||null,genre_ids:[],search_provider:provider,search_provider_id:String(providerId||"")};
  searchResultItems.set(keyOf(type,id),item); while(searchResultItems.size>180) searchResultItems.delete(searchResultItems.keys().next().value); return item;
}
function normalizeSearchCinemeta(meta,type){
  if(!meta||!meta.name) return null;
  const t=type==="movie"?"movie":"tv";
  if(meta.moviedb_id){ const mapped=cmMapMeta(meta); if(mapped) return mapped; }
  return searchExternalItem({title:String(meta.name),type:t,year:String(meta.releaseInfo||"").slice(0,4),poster:meta.poster,desc:meta.description,rating:meta.imdbRating,imdb:meta.imdb_id||(String(meta.id||"").startsWith("tt")?meta.id:"")},"Cinemeta",meta.id||meta.name);
}
function searchFuzzyMatch(item,q){
  const query=searchNormTitle(q), haystack=searchNormTitle(titleOf(item)+" "+(item.overview||""));
  return !query||query.split(" ").every(word=>haystack.includes(word));
}
async function searchAllCatalogs(q,signal){
  const encoded=encodeURIComponent(q);
  const cm=(type)=>searchFetchJson(CINEMETA+"/catalog/"+cmType(type)+"/top/search="+encoded+".json",signal).then(data=>(data.metas||[]).map(meta=>normalizeSearchCinemeta(meta,type)).filter(Boolean)).catch(error=>{if(signal&&signal.aborted) throw error;return[];});
  const tvmaze=searchFetchJson("https://api.tvmaze.com/search/shows?q="+encoded,signal).then(data=>(data||[]).map(({show})=>{
    if(!show) return null;
    return searchExternalItem({title:show.name,type:"tv",year:String(show.premiered||"").slice(0,4),poster:show.image&&(show.image.medium||show.image.original),desc:String(show.summary||"").replace(/<[^>]*>/g," "),rating:show.rating&&show.rating.average,imdb:show.externals&&show.externals.imdb},"TVmaze",show.id);
  }).filter(Boolean)).catch(error=>{if(signal&&signal.aborted) throw error;return[];});
  const anilistQuery="query($q:String){Page(page:1,perPage:20){media(search:$q,type:ANIME){id seasonYear description(asHtml:false) coverImage{large} title{english romaji}}}}";
  const anilist=searchFetchJson("https://graphql.anilist.co",signal,{ttl:600000,cacheKey:"anilist:"+searchNormTitle(q),fetchOptions:{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({query:anilistQuery,variables:{q}})}}).then(data=>((((data||{}).data||{}).Page||{}).media||[]).map(anime=>searchExternalItem({title:(anime.title&&(anime.title.english||anime.title.romaji))||"Untitled",type:"tv",year:anime.seasonYear,poster:anime.coverImage&&anime.coverImage.large,desc:String(anime.description||"").replace(/<[^>]*>/g," ")},"AniList",anime.id)).filter(Boolean)).catch(error=>{if(signal&&signal.aborted) throw error;return[];});
  const groups=await Promise.all([cm("movie"),cm("tv"),tvmaze,anilist]);
  if(signal.aborted) throw new DOMException("Search superseded","AbortError");
  const merged=new Map();
  for(const item of groups.flat()){
    if(!item||!titleOf(item)) continue;
    const type=typeOf(item), year=yearOf(item), title=searchNormTitle(titleOf(item));
    const key=title+"|"+year+"|"+type, previous=merged.get(key);
    const score=x=>(x.id&&x.id<900000000?4:0)+(x.poster_url?2:0)+(x.imdb_id?1:0);
    if(!previous||score(item)>score(previous)) merged.set(key,item);
  }
  return [...merged.values()].filter(item=>searchFuzzyMatch(item,q)).sort((a,b)=>(Number(b.vote_average)||0)-(Number(a.vote_average)||0)).slice(0,60);
}
function renderSearch(q){
  if(searchController) searchController.abort(); clearTimeout(searchTimer); searchSequence++;
  searchState.q=q||""; searchState.filter="all"; searchState.results=[];
  view.innerHTML='<div class="page"><h1>Search</h1><p class="lede">Search movies and series across Cinemeta, TVmaze, and AniList.</p>'
    +'<form id="searchForm" class="input-with-action" style="margin-bottom:1rem"><input type="search" id="searchInput" placeholder="Search movies and TV series…" autocomplete="off" maxlength="200" value="'+esc(searchState.q)+'" aria-label="Search movies and TV series"><button class="btn btn-primary" type="submit">Search</button></form>'
    +'<div class="search-recents" id="searchRecents" aria-label="Recent searches"></div>'
    +'<div class="chip-row" id="searchChips"><button class="chip-btn active" data-f="all" type="button">All</button><button class="chip-btn" data-f="movie" type="button">Movies</button><button class="chip-btn" data-f="tv" type="button">TV Series &amp; anime</button></div>'
    +'<div id="searchResults" aria-live="polite" aria-busy="false"></div></div>';
  bindCards(view); renderSearchRecents();
  const input=$("#searchInput");
  $("#searchForm").onsubmit=e=>{e.preventDefault();searchState.q=input.value.trim();const target="#/search?q="+encodeURIComponent(searchState.q);if(location.hash===target)runSearch();else location.hash=target;};
  input.addEventListener("input",()=>{searchState.q=input.value.trim();clearTimeout(searchTimer);if(!searchState.q){if(searchController)searchController.abort();searchState.results=[];drawSearchResults();renderSearchRecents();return;}searchTimer=setTimeout(()=>runSearch(),350);});
  $("#searchChips").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-f]");if(!b)return;searchState.filter=b.dataset.f;$$('#searchChips .chip-btn').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle("active",x===b));drawSearchResults();});
  $("#searchRecents").addEventListener("click",e=>{const b=e.target.closest("[data-search-recent]");if(!b)return;input.value=b.dataset.searchRecent;searchState.q=input.value;runSearch();input.focus({preventScroll:true});});
  if(searchState.q) runSearch(); else drawSearchResults();
  setTimeout(()=>{const field=$("#searchInput");if(field)field.focus({preventScroll:true});},30);
}
async function runSearch(){
  const input=$("#searchInput"),box=$("#searchResults"); if(!box||!input)return;
  const q=input.value.trim(); searchState.q=q;
  if(searchController) searchController.abort();
  const sequence=++searchSequence;
  if(!q){searchState.results=[];drawSearchResults();return;}
  searchController=new AbortController(); box.setAttribute("aria-busy","true");
  box.innerHTML='<div class="search-skeleton" aria-label="Searching">'+'<span class="skel"></span>'.repeat(6)+'</div><p class="lede">Searching available catalogues…</p>';
  try{
    const results=await searchAllCatalogs(q,searchController.signal);
    if(sequence!==searchSequence)return;
    searchState.results=results;
    const recents=searchRecentItems(),normalized=searchNormTitle(q);
    saveJSON(SEARCH_RECENTS_KEY,[q,...recents.filter(item=>searchNormTitle(item)!==normalized)].slice(0,10));
    renderSearchRecents(); drawSearchResults();
  }catch(error){
    if(error&&error.name==="AbortError")return;
    if(sequence!==searchSequence)return;
    box.innerHTML='<div class="status-box error">Search could not reach the catalogues. Check your connection and try again.</div>';
  }finally{if(sequence===searchSequence)box.setAttribute("aria-busy","false");}
}
function renderSearchRecents(){
  const host=$("#searchRecents");if(!host)return;
  const recents=searchRecentItems();host.innerHTML=recents.length?'<span class="search-recent-label">Recent</span>'+recents.map(q=>'<button class="chip-btn search-recent" type="button" data-search-recent="'+esc(q)+'">'+esc(q)+'</button>').join(""):"";
}
function drawSearchResults(){
  const box=$("#searchResults");if(!box)return;
  const q=searchState.q;
  if(!q){box.setAttribute("aria-busy","false");box.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><h3>Find your next watch</h3><p>Type a title and results will appear automatically.</p></div>';return;}
  const list=searchState.results.filter(item=>searchState.filter==="all"||typeOf(item)===searchState.filter);
  box.innerHTML=list.length?'<p class="lede">'+list.length+' result'+(list.length===1?"":"s")+' for “'+esc(q)+'” — merged across Cinemeta, TVmaze, and AniList.</p><div class="grid">'+list.map((item,index)=>cardHTML(item,{index})).join("")+"</div>"
    :'<div class="empty"><h3>No matches yet</h3><p>Try another spelling or title; results are combined from the available catalogues.</p></div>';
  box.setAttribute("aria-busy","false");bindArtworkFallbacks(box);
}

function renderLibrary(){
  const cont=continueItems();
  const wl=watchlist.map(snapToItem);
  view.innerHTML='<div class="page"><h1>My Library</h1><p class="lede">Stored locally in this browser — no account needed.</p>'
    +'<section class="panel"><div class="panel-head"><div><h2>Downloads</h2><p class="section-desc" id="libraryDownloads">Checking stored downloads…</p></div><button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" data-menu-route="downloads">Open downloads</button></div></section>'
    +(cont.length?continueRailHTML(cont):"")
    +(wl.length?'<section class="rail"><div class="rail-head"><h2>Watchlist</h2></div><div class="grid">'+wl.map(it=>cardHTML(it,{remove:true})).join("")+"</div></section>":"")
    +(!cont.length&&!wl.length?'<div class="empty"><h3>Your library is empty</h3><p>Press <strong>+ Watchlist</strong> on any title, or just start watching — progress lands here automatically.</p><p style="margin-top:1rem"><button class="btn btn-primary" id="libBrowse">Browse trending</button></p></div>':"")
    +((cont.length||wl.length)?'<div style="display:flex;gap:.6rem;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:1rem"><button class="btn btn-danger" id="clearHistory">Clear watch history</button><button class="btn btn-danger" id="clearList">Clear watchlist</button></div>':"")
    +"</div>";
  bindCards(view);
  const b=$("#libBrowse"); if(b) b.onclick=()=>location.hash="#/home";
  const ch=$("#clearHistory"); if(ch) ch.onclick=()=>{ progress={}; saveProgress(); toast("Watch history cleared"); renderLibrary(); };
  const cl=$("#clearList"); if(cl) cl.onclick=()=>{ watchlist=[]; saveWatchlist(); toast("Watchlist cleared"); renderLibrary(); };
  loadDownloadJobs().then(()=>{ const el=$("#libraryDownloads"); if(el){ const jobs=sortedDownloadJobs(); el.textContent=jobs.length?jobs.filter(j=>j.status==="complete").length+" complete · "+jobs.filter(j=>["running","queued"].includes(j.status)).length+" active · "+jobs.filter(j=>j.status==="paused").length+" paused/resumable":"No downloads yet. Episode and title Download buttons appear when downloads are enabled."; } });
}

function exportZeroPlaySettings(){
  const blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify({app:"ZeroPlay",version:1,exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(),settings},null,2)],{type:"application/json"});
  const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a=document.createElement("a"); a.href=url; a.download="zeroplay-settings.json"; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),1000);
}
async function importZeroPlaySettings(file){
  if(!file) return;
  try{
    const data=JSON.parse(await file.text());
    const incoming=data&&data.settings&&typeof data.settings==="object"?data.settings:data;
    if(!incoming||typeof incoming!=="object"||Array.isArray(incoming)) throw new Error("That file does not contain ZeroPlay settings");
    const allowed=["source","disabledSources","stream","ui","downloads","artwork","feed","discovery","providers","providerTombstones","customSources","sites","addons","health","dlog"];
    const arrayKeys=new Set(["disabledSources","providers","customSources","sites","addons","dlog"]);
    const objectKeys=new Set(["stream","ui","downloads","artwork","feed","discovery","providerTombstones","health"]);
    const staged={};
    for(const key of allowed){
      if(!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(incoming,key)) continue;
      const value=incoming[key];
      if(key==="source"&&typeof value!=="string") throw new Error("Imported settings have an invalid default source");
      if(arrayKeys.has(key)&&!Array.isArray(value)) throw new Error("Imported settings have an invalid "+key+" list");
      if(objectKeys.has(key)&&(!value||typeof value!=="object"||Array.isArray(value))) throw new Error("Imported settings have an invalid "+key+" section");
      staged[key]=value;
    }
    for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(staged)) settings[key]=objectKeys.has(key)?Object.assign({},settings[key]||{},value):value;
    for(const key of LEGACY_SETTING_KEYS) delete settings[key];
    streamCfg(); downloadCfg(); saveSettings(); applyInterfaceSettings(); scheduleDiscovery();
    toast("Settings imported","success"); renderSources(true);
  }catch(e){ toast("Settings import failed: "+(e.message||e),"error"); }
}
function clearPlaybackCaches(){
  settings.health={}; saveSettings();
  try{ titleServerCache.clear(); }catch{}
  try{ siteLookupCache.clear(); }catch{}
  try{ catalogItemCache.clear(); trailerKeyCache.clear(); trailerFetchCache.clear(); }catch{}
  try{ clearPreload(); }catch{}
  toast("Playback health and server caches cleared","success"); renderSources(true);
}
function applyTvSourcesLayout(settingsPage,sectionTarget){
  if(!ANDROID_TV_APP||!view) return;
  const page=view.querySelector(".page"); if(!page) return;
  const targetBySection={"add-website":"settingsAddWebsite",continuous:"discoveryPanel",faststream:"settingsFastStream",sources:"settingsPlaybackSources",switches:"settingsHub",androidtv:"settingsHub",artwork:"settingsHub"};
  const wanted=settingsPage?["sourceStatePanel",targetBySection[sectionTarget]||"settingsHub"]:["sourceStatePanel","settingsAddWebsite","settingsPlaybackSources"];
  page.querySelectorAll(":scope > .panel").forEach(panel=>{ panel.hidden=!wanted.includes(panel.id); });
}

  +'<button class="btn btn-primary btn-large" id="btnOptSave" type="button" style="width:100%">Save playback settings</button></section></div>';

  /* ---- wire up ---- */
  const note=(msg,type)=>{ const n=$("#detectNote"); n.textContent=msg; n.className="status-box "+type; };
  $("#btnDetect").onclick=()=>{

  const collectForm=()=>{

  };

    if(!validateTemplate(f.movieTpl)||!validateTemplate(f.tvTpl)){ note("Templates must be valid http(s) URLs (placeholders like {tmdb} are allowed).","error"); return; }

    settings.customSources.push(src); saveSettings(); dlog("Source added manually: "+src.name);
    toast("Source added: "+src.name,"success"); warmHost(sourceOrigin(src)).then(r=>{ if(r) recordHealth(src.id,r.ok,r.ms); if(routeNow()==="sources") renderSources(true); });
    renderSources(true);
  };
  $("#btnTestNew").onclick=()=>{
    const f=collectForm();
    if(!f.movieTpl){ note("The Inception test needs a movie template.","error"); return; }
    openSourceTest({id:"__test",name:f.name||"Test source",kind:"custom",movieTpl:f.movieTpl,tvTpl:f.tvTpl,direct:f.direct,enabled:true},"movie");
  };
  $("#btnPlayLink").onclick=()=>{
    const raw=$("#playLink").value.trim(); if(!raw){ toast("Paste a link first","error"); return; }
    let u; try{ u=new URL(raw.includes("://")?raw:"https://"+raw); }catch{ toast("That is not a valid link","error"); return; }
    const direct=isDirectMedia(u.href);
    openSourceTest({id:"__link",name:prettyHostName(u.hostname),kind:"custom",movieTpl:u.href,tvTpl:"",direct,enabled:true},"movie");
  };
  $("#srcList").addEventListener("click",e=>{
    const def=e.target.closest("[data-src-default]"), tst=e.target.closest("[data-src-test]"), tog=e.target.closest("[data-src-toggle]"), del=e.target.closest("[data-src-delete]");
    if(def){ settings.source=def.dataset.srcDefault; saveSettings(); toast("Default source updated","success"); renderSources(true); }
    if(tst){ const s=getSource(tst.dataset.srcTest); if(s) openSourceTest(s, s.tvTpl&&!s.movieTpl?"tv":"movie"); }
    if(tog){
      const id=tog.dataset.srcToggle, s=getSource(id);
      if(s&&s.kind==="custom"){ const c=settings.customSources.find(x=>x.id===id); if(c){ c.enabled=c.enabled===false?true:false; } }
      else if(s&&s.kind==="site"){ const site=(settings.sites||[]).find(x=>x.id===id); if(site){ site.enabled=site.enabled===false?true:false; setProviderEnabled(id,site.enabled); } }
      else { const dis=new Set(settings.disabledSources||[]); dis.has(id)?dis.delete(id):dis.add(id); settings.disabledSources=[...dis]; }
      saveSettings(); renderSources(true);
    }
    if(del){ const did=del.dataset.srcDelete; if(getProvider(did)) removeProviderById(did); settings.customSources=settings.customSources.filter(x=>x.id!==did); settings.sites=(settings.sites||[]).filter(x=>x.id!==did); saveSettings(); toast("Source removed"); renderSources(true); }
  });
  $("#optCap").addEventListener("input",e=>{ $("#optCapVal").textContent=Number(e.target.value).toFixed(1).replace(/\.0$/,"")+" GB"; });
  const fastStreamToggle=$("#btnFastStreamToggle");
  if(fastStreamToggle) fastStreamToggle.onclick=()=>{
    const stNow=streamCfg(), disabling=stNow.player!=="builtin";
    if(disabling){
      stNow.fastStreamPreviousPlayer=stNow.player||"faststream-only";
      stNow.player="builtin"; stNow.fastStreamApiProbe=false;
      if(typeof fastStreamProbeCleanup==="function") fastStreamProbeCleanup();
      if(stNow.preload!=="off"){ stNow.preloadLastMode=stNow.preload; stNow.preload="off"; }
      clearPreload();
    }else{
      stNow.player=stNow.fastStreamPreviousPlayer&&stNow.fastStreamPreviousPlayer!=="builtin"?stNow.fastStreamPreviousPlayer:"faststream-only";
      if(stNow.player==="auto"||stNow.player==="faststream") stNow.player="faststream-only";
      stNow.fastStreamApiProbe=true;
      stNow.preload=stNow.preloadLastMode==="aggressive"?"aggressive":"smart";
    }
    saveSettings();
    if(playerState&&playerState.direct&&((disabling&&/^faststream/.test(playerState.engine||""))||(!disabling&&playerState.engine==="native"))){
      const active=playerState, stage=$("#playerStage"), source=getSource(active.source)||active.tempSource||{id:active.source||"",name:"Direct stream"};
      const resumeAt=currentPlaybackTime();
      clearPlayerTimers();
      if(stage) void mountDirectVideo(stage,active.url,source,performance.now(),resumeAt);
    }
    toast(disabling?"FastStream disabled — direct streams will use the ZeroPlay player":"FastStream enabled for direct streams","success");
    renderSources(true);
  };
  $("#btnOptSave").onclick=()=>{
    const stNow=streamCfg(), dlNow=downloadCfg();
    stNow.player=$("#optPlayer").value; stNow.preload=$("#optPreload").value; if(stNow.preload!=="off") stNow.preloadLastMode=stNow.preload;
    const requestedDefault=$("#optDefaultSource")?.value||"";
    if(requestedDefault&&getSource(requestedDefault)&&!LAST_RESORT.has(requestedDefault)) settings.source=requestedDefault;
    stNow.raceTimeoutSec=clampSettingNumber($("#optRace").value,15,60,20);
    stNow.stallTimeoutSec=clampSettingNumber($("#optStallSec").value,30,120,45);
    stNow.bufferTargetSec=clampSettingNumber($("#optBufferTarget").value,6,60,16);
    stNow.primeThreads=Math.round(clampSettingNumber($("#optPrimeThreads").value,1,4,2));
    stNow.primeChunkKb=Math.round(clampSettingNumber($("#optPrimeChunk").value,64,1024,256));
    stNow.primeBudgetMb=clampSettingNumber($("#optPrimeBudget").value,.25,8,2);
    stNow.maxFileSizeGb=Math.min(CAP_GB_HARD,Math.max(1,Number($("#optCap").value)||CAP_GB_HARD));
    stNow.dataSaver=$("#optSaver").value;
    dlNow.threads=Math.round(clampSettingNumber($("#optDownloadThreads").value,1,8,4));
    dlNow.chunkMb=clampSettingNumber($("#optDownloadChunk").value,.25,8,2);
    dlNow.concurrent=Math.round(clampSettingNumber($("#optDownloadConcurrent").value,1,3,1));
    if(stNow.trailerPreviews===false){ stopCardPreview(); document.querySelectorAll(".hero-trailer.on").forEach(stopBackdropPreview); }
    applyQualityPreset($("#optQuality").value);
    saveSettings(); applyInterfaceSettings(); warmedHosts.clear(); warmAllSources();
    if(typeof scheduleDownloads==="function") scheduleDownloads();
    toast("Playback, FastStream and download settings saved","success"); renderSources(true);
  };
  const exportBtn=$("#btnExportSettings"); if(exportBtn) exportBtn.onclick=exportZeroPlaySettings;
  const importInput=$("#importSettingsFile"); if(importInput) importInput.onchange=()=>importZeroPlaySettings(importInput.files&&importInput.files[0]);
  const clearBtn=$("#btnClearPlaybackCaches"); if(clearBtn) clearBtn.onclick=clearPlaybackCaches;
  const clearArtworkBtn=$("#btnClearArtworkCache"); if(clearArtworkBtn) clearArtworkBtn.onclick=()=>{ clearArtworkCache(); toast("Artwork cache cleared — visible posters will be checked again","success"); renderSources(true); };
  const runBtn=$("#btnSettingsRunDiscovery"); if(runBtn) runBtn.onclick=async()=>{ runBtn.disabled=true; runBtn.innerHTML='<span class="spinner"></span> Searching…'; try{ await runDiscoveryCycle("settings"); }catch(e){ toast("Source search could not finish: "+(e.message||e),"error"); } finally{ renderSources(true); } };
  const sourceStateBtn=$("#btnSourceStateSearch"); if(sourceStateBtn) sourceStateBtn.onclick=async()=>{ sourceStateBtn.disabled=true; sourceStateBtn.innerHTML='<span class="spinner"></span> Searching…'; refreshSourceStatePanel(); try{ await runDiscoveryCycle("source status"); }catch(e){ toast("Source search could not finish: "+(e.message||e),"error"); } finally{ renderSources(true); } };
  wireAddonPanel();
  syncFeatureToggles(view);
  refreshSourceStatePanel();
  applyTvSourcesLayout(settingsPage,sectionTarget);
  if(!soft){
    const targets={"add-website":"settingsAddWebsite",continuous:"discoveryPanel",faststream:"settingsFastStream",sources:"settingsPlaybackSources",switches:"settingsHub",androidtv:"settingsAndroidTv",artwork:"settingsArtwork"};
    const target=targets[sectionTarget]&&document.getElementById(targets[sectionTarget]);
    if(target) setTimeout(()=>target.scrollIntoView({block:"start",behavior:document.body.classList.contains("reduce-motion")?"auto":"smooth"}),40);
    else window.scrollTo({top:0});
  }
}

/* ---------------- continuous discovery + server identification ----------------
   The crawler does not blindly add every URL it sees. Each endpoint is first
   identified: What is it? Which protocol/capabilities does it expose? Can it
   search? Which catalogue identifiers does it understand? Does it support
   movies/series/episodes? Only an identified, usable server/addon is
   installed into the provider registry for later playback searches.
   Arbitrary GitHub code is never executed: GitHub projects are inspected for
   declarative manifests/endpoints and remain candidates until a hosted
   endpoint can be identified. */
const PROVIDER_CATEGORIES=[
  ["streams","Streams"],["catalogs","Catalogues"],["metadata","Metadata"],["subtitles","Subtitles"],
  ["discovery","Discovery"],["websites","Websites"],["projects","Projects"],["feeds","Feeds"]
];
const DEFAULT_GITHUB_QUERIES=[

  // TV and remote navigation
  "android tv webview in:name,description,readme","android tv dpad in:name,description,readme","android tv remote navigation in:name,description,readme","tv spatial navigation in:name,description,readme","dpad navigation javascript in:name,description,readme","focus management tv in:name,description,readme","10 foot ui in:name,description,readme","leanback web app in:name,description,readme","remote first ui in:name,description,readme","webview media player tv in:name,description,readme",
  // Player controls and playback engines
  "html5 video player controls in:name,description,readme","faststream player in:name,description,readme","hls player javascript in:name,description,readme","dash player javascript in:name,description,readme","video.js hls in:name,description,readme","shaka player tv in:name,description,readme","mpeg dash player in:name,description,readme","media source extensions in:name,description,readme","player keyboard shortcuts in:name,description,readme","video quality selector in:name,description,readme",
  // Playlists, extraction, and downloads
  "m3u8 extractor javascript in:name,description,readme","m3u playlist parser in:name,description,readme","hls downloader javascript in:name,description,readme","hls segment downloader in:name,description,readme","browser download manager indexeddb in:name,description,readme","resumable downloads javascript in:name,description,readme","range request downloader javascript in:name,description,readme","indexeddb media storage in:name,description,readme","playlist extractor web in:name,description,readme","streamlink web player in:name,description,readme",
  // Catalogue, metadata, artwork, and subtitles
  "tmdb catalogue api in:name,description,readme","cinemeta api in:name,description,readme","meta api streaming in:name,description,readme","tvmaze api artwork in:name,description,readme","anilist api artwork in:name,description,readme","movie metadata api javascript in:name,description,readme","episode metadata api in:name,description,readme","subtitle provider api in:name,description,readme","opensubtitles api javascript in:name,description,readme","anime metadata provider in:name,description,readme",
  // Resilience, performance, and accessibility
  "video failover javascript in:name,description,readme","stream health check javascript in:name,description,readme","cdn stream resolver in:name,description,readme","cors media proxy in:name,description,readme","web performance tv in:name,description,readme","low memory webview in:name,description,readme","reduced motion media ui in:name,description,readme","accessible video controls in:name,description,readme","focus trap modal javascript in:name,description,readme","scroll reveal focus javascript in:name,description,readme"
];
// Upgrade older TV profiles in place: preserve custom searches, then add the built-in tool registry.
if(Array.isArray(settings.discovery.githubQueries)){
  const known=new Set(settings.discovery.githubQueries);
  for(const query of DEFAULT_GITHUB_QUERIES) if(!known.has(query)){ settings.discovery.githubQueries.push(query); known.add(query); }
}
let discoveryRuntime={running:false,cycleRunning:false,timer:null,startedOnce:false,lastSummary:null,lastError:"",lastFoundAt:0,lastFoundCount:0,deferredForPlayback:false};
let providerUi={category:"all",status:"all",query:"",limit:80};

async function fetchJsonLoose(url, timeoutMs){
  const ctl=new AbortController(); const to=setTimeout(()=>ctl.abort(), timeoutMs||9000);
  try{ const r=await fetch(url,{signal:ctl.signal,headers:{Accept:"application/json"}}); if(!r.ok) throw new Error("HTTP "+r.status); return await r.json(); }
  catch(e){
    try{ const r=await fetch("/api/extract?mode=json&url="+encodeURIComponent(url),{signal:ctl.signal}); if(r.ok) return await r.json(); }catch{}
    return null;
  } finally{ clearTimeout(to); }
}
async function fetchTextLoose(url, timeoutMs){
  const ctl=new AbortController(); const to=setTimeout(()=>ctl.abort(),timeoutMs||9000);
  try{ const r=await fetch(url,{signal:ctl.signal}); if(!r.ok) return ""; return await r.text(); }
  catch{ return ""; } finally{ clearTimeout(to); }
}
function discoveryDelay(ms){ return new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,ms)); }
function defaultDiscoveryConfig(){
  return {
    autoStart:true, intervalSec:90, githubPausedUntil:0,
    crawlers:{catalogGraph:true,stremioAddons:true,github:true,githubProbe:true,candidateIdentification:true,feeds:true,websites:true,health:true},
    githubQueries:DEFAULT_GITHUB_QUERIES.slice(), cursors:{}, seeds:[],
    stats:{cycles:0,lastCycleAt:0,lastAdded:0,lastInstalled:0,lastIdentified:0,lastErrors:0,lastSummary:""}
  };
}
function discoveryCfg(){
  if(!settings.discovery||typeof settings.discovery!=="object"||Array.isArray(settings.discovery)) settings.discovery={};
  const cfg=settings.discovery;
  const defaults=defaultDiscoveryConfig();
  for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(defaults)) if(cfg[key]===undefined) cfg[key]=value;
  if(!cfg.crawlers||typeof cfg.crawlers!=="object"||Array.isArray(cfg.crawlers)) cfg.crawlers={};
  for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(defaults.crawlers)) if(cfg.crawlers[key]===undefined) cfg.crawlers[key]=value;
  if(!Array.isArray(cfg.githubQueries)||!cfg.githubQueries.length) cfg.githubQueries=DEFAULT_GITHUB_QUERIES.slice();
  if(!cfg.cursors||typeof cfg.cursors!=="object"||Array.isArray(cfg.cursors)) cfg.cursors={};
  if(!Array.isArray(cfg.seeds)) cfg.seeds=[];
  if(!cfg.stats||typeof cfg.stats!=="object"||Array.isArray(cfg.stats)) cfg.stats={};
  for(const [key,value] of Object.entries(defaults.stats)) if(cfg.stats[key]===undefined) cfg.stats[key]=value;
  const tvPerf=typeof tvPerformanceEnabled==="function"&&tvPerformanceEnabled();
  cfg.intervalSec=Math.min(900,Math.max(tvPerf?120:20,Number(cfg.intervalSec)||(tvPerf?180:90)));
  return cfg;
}
function cleanHttpUrl(raw){
  try{
    let s=String(raw||"").trim();
    if(!s) return "";
    if(/^stremio:\/\//i.test(s)) s="https://"+s.replace(/^stremio:\/\//i,"");
    if(!/^\w+:\/\//.test(s)) s="https://"+s;
    const u=new URL(s);
    if(u.protocol!=="https:"&&u.protocol!=="http:") return "";
    u.hash="";
    return u.href;
  }catch{ return ""; }
}
function manifestBaseFromUrl(url){
  const clean=cleanHttpUrl(url);
  return clean?clean.replace(/\/manifest\.json(\?.*)?$/i,"").replace(/\/$/,""):"";
}
function providerStableKey(value){ return String(value||"").trim().toLowerCase().replace(/\/$/,""); }
function providerIdFor(rec){
  rec=rec||{};
  if(rec.id) return String(rec.id);
  if(rec.manifestUrl||rec.base||rec.endpoint&&rec.kind==="stremio-addon") return "addon:"+providerStableKey(rec.base||manifestBaseFromUrl(rec.manifestUrl)||rec.endpoint);
  if(rec.repoUrl||rec.fullName){
    const full=rec.fullName||String(rec.repoUrl).replace(/^https?:\/\/github\.com\//i,"").replace(/\.git$/i,"");
    return "github:"+providerStableKey(full);
  }
  if(rec.kind==="website"||rec.kind==="website-lookup") { try{return "site:"+new URL(rec.endpoint||rec.base||rec.home).hostname.toLowerCase();}catch{} }
  if(rec.kind==="feed") return "feed:"+providerStableKey(rec.endpoint||rec.url);
  return "provider:"+providerStableKey(rec.endpoint||rec.manifestUrl||rec.repoUrl||rec.name||Date.now());
}
function uniqueStringList(values){
  const out=[]; const seen=new Set();
  for(const v of values||[]){ const s=String(v||"").trim(); if(!s||seen.has(s.toLowerCase())) continue; seen.add(s.toLowerCase()); out.push(s); }
  return out;
}
function manifestInfo(manifest){
  const empty={valid:false,resources:[],resourceMap:{},types:[],idPrefixes:[],categories:[],catalogDefs:[],addonCatalogs:[],searchCatalogs:[],stream:false,playableStream:false,identification:null};
  if(!manifest||typeof manifest!=="object") return empty;
  const resources=[], resourceMap={};
  let idPrefixes=Array.isArray(manifest.idPrefixes)?manifest.idPrefixes.slice():[];
  for(const r of (manifest.resources||[])){
    if(typeof r==="string"){ resources.push(r); resourceMap[r]={name:r}; }
    else if(r&&r.name){ resources.push(r.name); resourceMap[r.name]=r; if(Array.isArray(r.idPrefixes)) idPrefixes=idPrefixes.concat(r.idPrefixes); }
  }
  idPrefixes=uniqueStringList(idPrefixes.map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase()));
  const types=uniqueStringList((manifest.types||[]).map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase()));
  const categoryFor={stream:"streams",catalog:"catalogs",meta:"metadata",subtitles:"subtitles",addon_catalog:"discovery"};
  const categories=uniqueStringList(resources.map(r=>categoryFor[r]).filter(Boolean));
  const cleanDefs=list=>(Array.isArray(list)?list:[]).filter(c=>c&&(c.id||c.type)).map(c=>({
    type:String(c.type||""), id:String(c.id||""), name:String(c.name||"").slice(0,80),
    extraSupported:uniqueStringList([].concat(c.extraSupported||[],(c.extra||[]).map(e=>typeof e==="string"?e:e&&e.name).filter(Boolean)))
  }));
  const catalogDefs=cleanDefs(manifest.catalogs);
  const addonCatalogs=cleanDefs(manifest.addonCatalogs);
  const searchCatalogs=catalogDefs.filter(c=>c.extraSupported.includes("search"));
  const stream=resources.includes("stream");
  const supportsMovie=types.includes("movie"), supportsSeries=types.includes("series")||types.includes("tv");
  const idModes=[];
  if(!idPrefixes.length||idPrefixes.includes("tt")) idModes.push("imdb-id");
  if(idPrefixes.includes("tmdb")) idModes.push("tmdb-id");
  if(searchCatalogs.length) idModes.push("catalog-search");
  if(resources.includes("meta")) idModes.push("meta-id");
  const playableStream=!!(stream&&(supportsMovie||supportsSeries)&&(idModes.includes("imdb-id")||idModes.includes("tmdb-id")||idModes.includes("catalog-search")));
  const valid=!!((manifest.id||manifest.name)&&resources.length);
  const identification={
    version:1, kind:"stremio-addon", confidence:valid?96:55, identifiedAt:Date.now(),
    searchable:!!searchCatalogs.length,
    supports:{
      movie:supportsMovie, series:supportsSeries, streams:stream, catalog:resources.includes("catalog"),
      meta:resources.includes("meta"), subtitles:resources.includes("subtitles"), addonCatalog:resources.includes("addon_catalog"),
      search:!!searchCatalogs.length, episodeLookup:!!(stream&&supportsSeries)
    },
    identifierModes:idModes,
    idPrefixes,
    checks:["manifest JSON","declared resources","declared media types","catalogue ID prefixes",searchCatalogs.length?"searchable catalogues":"no searchable catalogue declared"],
    installable:!!(valid&&categories.length),
    playableStream
  };
  return {valid,resources,resourceMap,types,idPrefixes,categories,catalogDefs,addonCatalogs,searchCatalogs,stream,playableStream,identification};
}
function providerFromManifest(manifestUrl, manifest, meta){
  meta=meta||{};
  const cleanManifest=cleanHttpUrl(manifestUrl||meta.manifestUrl||"");
  if(!cleanManifest||!manifest) return null;
  const info=manifestInfo(manifest);
  if(!info.valid) return null;
  const base=manifestBaseFromUrl(cleanManifest);
  const repoOnly=!!meta.repoOnly;
  const categories=uniqueStringList((repoOnly?["projects"]:[ ]).concat(info.categories));
  const identification=Object.assign({},info.identification,repoOnly?{kind:"github-project-manifest",confidence:78,installable:false,checks:(info.identification.checks||[]).concat(["manifest found in repository; hosted endpoint not yet identified"])}:{});
  const titleScopedDiscovery=!!(meta.deferInstall&&info.playableStream&&!repoOnly);
  return {
    id:meta.id||("addon:"+base), name:String(manifest.name||manifest.id||meta.name||"Identified addon").slice(0,80),
    kind:repoOnly?"github-project":"stremio-addon", categories,
    status:meta.status||((!repoOnly&&identification.installable&&!titleScopedDiscovery)?"installed":"candidate"),
    titleScopedDiscovery,
    enabled:meta.enabled!==false,
    endpoint:repoOnly?"":base, base:repoOnly?"":base, manifestUrl:cleanManifest,
    manifestId:String(manifest.id||""), version:String(manifest.version||""),
    resources:info.resources, types:info.types, idPrefixes:info.idPrefixes,
    catalogDefs:info.catalogDefs, addonCatalogs:info.addonCatalogs, searchCatalogs:info.searchCatalogs,
    stars:Number(meta.stars||0)||0, source:meta.from||meta.source||"", from:meta.from||meta.source||"",
    repoUrl:meta.repoUrl||"", homepage:meta.homepage||"", tags:uniqueStringList(meta.tags||[]),
    description:String(manifest.description||meta.description||"").slice(0,240),
    identification, lastCheckedAt:Date.now(), lastError:""
  };
}
function providerToAddon(provider){
  if(!provider||provider.status!=="installed"||!provider.base) return null;
  const idn=provider.identification||{};
  const supports=idn.supports||{};
  if(!(provider.categories||[]).includes("streams")&&!supports.streams) return null;
  if(idn.playableStream===false&&!(provider.searchCatalogs&&provider.searchCatalogs.length)) return null;
  return {
    id:"addon:"+provider.base, providerId:provider.id, name:provider.name||"Addon", base:provider.base,
    manifestUrl:provider.manifestUrl||(provider.base+"/manifest.json"), types:provider.types||["movie","series"],
    idPrefixes:provider.idPrefixes||idn.idPrefixes||[], resources:provider.resources||["stream"], supportsMeta:!!supports.meta,
    catalogDefs:provider.catalogDefs||[], addonCatalogs:provider.addonCatalogs||[], searchCatalogs:provider.searchCatalogs||[],
    identification:provider.identification||null, stars:provider.stars||0, from:provider.source||provider.from||"",
    enabled:provider.enabled!==false, kind:"addon"
  };
}
function upsertProvider(rec, opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  if(!rec) return null;
  if(!Array.isArray(settings.providers)) settings.providers=[];
  if(!settings.providerTombstones||typeof settings.providerTombstones!=="object") settings.providerTombstones={};
  const id=providerIdFor(rec);
  if(settings.providerTombstones[id]&&!opts.force) return null;
  if(opts.force) delete settings.providerTombstones[id];
  const now=Date.now();
  const clean=Object.assign({},rec,{id,lastSeenAt:now});
  clean.categories=uniqueStringList(clean.categories||[]);
  clean.tags=uniqueStringList(clean.tags||[]);
  const idx=settings.providers.findIndex(p=>p.id===id);
  if(idx<0){
    clean.discoveredAt=clean.discoveredAt||now;
    clean.status=clean.status||"candidate";
    clean.enabled=clean.enabled!==false;
    settings.providers.push(clean);
    return {provider:clean,added:true,upgraded:clean.status==="installed"};
  }
  const prev=settings.providers[idx];
  const wasInstalled=prev.status==="installed";
  const merged=Object.assign({},prev,clean,{
    id, discoveredAt:prev.discoveredAt||now,
    enabled:opts.setEnabled===undefined?(prev.enabled!==false):!!opts.setEnabled,
    categories:uniqueStringList([].concat(prev.categories||[],clean.categories||[])),
    tags:uniqueStringList([].concat(prev.tags||[],clean.tags||[])),
    status:(prev.status==="installed"&&clean.status==="candidate"&&!opts.allowDowngrade)?"installed":(clean.status||prev.status||"candidate")
  });
  settings.providers[idx]=merged;
  return {provider:merged,added:false,upgraded:!wasInstalled&&merged.status==="installed"};

function absorbProvider(result, rec, opts){
  const up=upsertProvider(rec,opts);
  if(!up) return null;
  result.seen=(result.seen||0)+1;
  if(up.added) result.added=(result.added||0)+1;
  if(up.upgraded) result.installed=(result.installed||0)+1;
  if(up.provider.status==="installed") result.identified=(result.identified||0)+1;
  else result.candidates=(result.candidates||0)+1;
  return up;
}
function syncInstalledAddonsFromProviders(){
  const providers=Array.isArray(settings.providers)?settings.providers:[];
  const addons=[];
  const seen=new Set();
  for(const p of providers){
    const addon=providerToAddon(p);
    if(addon&&!seen.has(addon.base)){ seen.add(addon.base); addons.push(addon); }
  }
  addons.sort((a,b)=>((b.stars||0)-(a.stars||0))||String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name)));
  settings.addons=addons;
  return addons;
}
function identifyWebsiteProvider(site, profile, from){

function ensureProviderRegistry(){

      id:a.id||("addon:"+a.base),name:a.name||"Addon",kind:"stremio-addon",categories:["streams"],status:"installed",enabled:a.enabled!==false,
      endpoint:a.base,base:a.base,manifestUrl:a.manifestUrl||(a.base+"/manifest.json"),types:a.types||["movie","series"],
      idPrefixes:a.idPrefixes||[],resources:a.resources||["stream"],catalogDefs:a.catalogDefs||[],addonCatalogs:a.addonCatalogs||[],searchCatalogs:a.searchCatalogs||[],
      stars:a.stars||0,source:a.from||"existing registry",from:a.from||"existing registry",
      identification:a.identification||{version:1,kind:"stremio-addon",confidence:70,identifiedAt:Date.now(),searchable:!!(a.searchCatalogs&&a.searchCatalogs.length),supports:{movie:true,series:true,streams:true,catalog:false,meta:false,subtitles:false,addonCatalog:false,search:!!(a.searchCatalogs&&a.searchCatalogs.length),episodeLookup:true},identifierModes:["imdb-id"],idPrefixes:a.idPrefixes||[],checks:["migrated from previously discovered addon"],installable:true,playableStream:true}

  if(settings.feed&&settings.feed.url){
    upsertProvider({name:"Configured provider feed",kind:"feed",categories:["feeds"],status:"installed",endpoint:settings.feed.url,source:"settings",identification:{version:1,kind:"feed",confidence:60,identifiedAt:Date.now(),searchable:false,supports:{movie:false,series:false,streams:false,catalog:false,meta:false,subtitles:false,addonCatalog:false,search:false,episodeLookup:false},identifierModes:["feed-entry"],idPrefixes:[],checks:["feed configured"],installable:true,playableStream:false}});
  }
