function getProvider(id){ return (settings.providers||[]).find(p=>p.id===id)||null; }
function setProviderEnabled(id,enabled){
  const p=getProvider(id); if(!p) return false;
  p.enabled=!!enabled;
  if(p.base&&(p.categories||[]).includes("streams")){
    const addonId="addon:"+p.base; const dis=new Set(settings.disabledSources||[]);
    if(enabled) dis.delete(addonId); else dis.add(addonId);
    settings.disabledSources=[...dis];
  }
  if(p.kind==="website-lookup"){
    const site=(settings.sites||[]).find(s=>s.id===p.id||providerStableKey(s.base)===providerStableKey(p.base));
    if(site) site.enabled=!!enabled;
  }
  syncInstalledAddonsFromProviders(); saveSettings(); return true;
}
function removeProviderById(id){
  const p=getProvider(id); if(!p) return false;
  if(!settings.providerTombstones||typeof settings.providerTombstones!=="object") settings.providerTombstones={};
  settings.providerTombstones[id]=Date.now();
  settings.providers=(settings.providers||[]).filter(x=>x.id!==id);
  if(p.kind==="website-lookup") settings.sites=(settings.sites||[]).filter(s=>s.id!==p.id&&providerStableKey(s.base)!==providerStableKey(p.base));
  const cfg=discoveryCfg();
  cfg.seeds=(cfg.seeds||[]).filter(seed=>providerIdFor({endpoint:seed.url,kind:seed.kind,manifestUrl:seed.kind==="manifest"?seed.url:"",repoUrl:seed.kind==="github"?seed.url:""})!==id);
  syncInstalledAddonsFromProviders(); saveSettings();
  dlog("Provider removed: "+(p.name||id));
  return true;
}
function providerCounts(){
  const counts={all:0,installed:0,candidate:0,disabled:0};
  for(const [id] of PROVIDER_CATEGORIES) counts[id]=0;
  for(const p of (settings.providers||[])){
    counts.all++;
    if(p.status==="installed") counts.installed++; else counts.candidate++;
    if(p.enabled===false) counts.disabled++;
    for(const c of (p.categories||[])) if(c in counts) counts[c]++;
  }
  return counts;
}
async function probeManifestUrl(manifestUrl, meta){
  meta=meta||{};
  const clean=cleanHttpUrl(manifestUrl);
  if(!clean) return null;
  const data=await fetchJsonLoose(clean,12000);
  if(!data||typeof data!=="object") return null;
  const info=manifestInfo(data);
  if(!info.valid) return null;
  return providerFromManifest(clean,data,meta);
}
function extractManifestUrls(text, baseUrl){
  const out=[]; const seen=new Set();
  const raw=String(text||"");
  const matches=raw.match(/https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>)\]]+/gi)||[];
  for(const m of matches){
    const cleaned=m.replace(/[.,;!?]+$/,"");
    try{
      const u=new URL(cleaned,baseUrl||undefined);
      if(/\/manifest\.json(\?|$)/i.test(u.href)&&!seen.has(u.href)){ seen.add(u.href); out.push(u.href); }
    }catch{}
  }
  const stremio=raw.match(/stremio:\/\/[^\s"'<>)\]]+/gi)||[];
  for(const m of stremio){
    const u=cleanHttpUrl(m.replace(/[.,;!?]+$/,""));
    if(u&&/\/manifest\.json(\?|$)/i.test(u)&&!seen.has(u)){ seen.add(u); out.push(u); }
  }
  return out;
}
function identifyGitHubRepo(repo){
  const topics=Array.isArray(repo&&repo.topics)?repo.topics:[];
  const text=[repo&&repo.name,repo&&repo.description].concat(topics).join(" ").toLowerCase();
  let confidence=34;
  if(topics.includes("stremio-addon")||topics.includes("stremio-addons")) confidence+=34;
  else if(topics.includes("stremio")||/\bstremio\b/.test(text)) confidence+=22;
  if(/\b(addon|server|api|stream|iptv|m3u|subtitle|metadata)\b/.test(text)) confidence+=10;
  if(repo&&repo.homepage) confidence+=5;
  confidence=Math.min(80,confidence);
  return {
    version:1,kind:"github-project",confidence,identifiedAt:Date.now(),searchable:false,
    supports:{movie:false,series:false,streams:false,catalog:false,meta:false,subtitles:false,addonCatalog:false,search:false,episodeLookup:false},
    identifierModes:[],idPrefixes:[],
    checks:["GitHub repository metadata",topics.length?("topics: "+topics.slice(0,6).join(", ")):"no repository topics","hosted declarative endpoint not yet identified"],
    installable:false,playableStream:false
  };
}
function githubRepoToProvider(repo, from){
  if(!repo||!repo.html_url) return null;
  const homepage=cleanHttpUrl(repo.homepage||"");
  return {
    name:String(repo.full_name||repo.name||"GitHub project").slice(0,90), fullName:repo.full_name||"",
    kind:"github-project",categories:["projects"],status:"candidate",enabled:true,
    endpoint:"",repoUrl:repo.html_url,homepage,stars:Number(repo.stargazers_count||0)||0,
    source:from||"GitHub crawler",from:from||"GitHub crawler",tags:uniqueStringList(repo.topics||[]),
    description:String(repo.description||"").slice(0,240),defaultBranch:repo.default_branch||"main",hasPages:!!repo.has_pages,
    identification:identifyGitHubRepo(repo),lastSeenAt:Date.now()
  };
}
async function githubApiFetch(url){
  const cfg=discoveryCfg();
  if(Number(cfg.githubPausedUntil||0)>Date.now()) return null;
  const ctl=new AbortController(); const to=setTimeout(()=>ctl.abort(),12000);
  try{
    const r=await fetch(url,{signal:ctl.signal,headers:{Accept:"application/vnd.github+json","X-GitHub-Api-Version":"2022-11-28"}});
    const remaining=r.headers.get("x-ratelimit-remaining");
    const reset=Number(r.headers.get("x-ratelimit-reset")||0);
    if(r.status===403||r.status===429||remaining==="0"){
      const retry=Number(r.headers.get("retry-after")||0);
      cfg.githubPausedUntil=retry?Date.now()+retry*1000:(reset?reset*1000:Date.now()+10*60*1000);
      saveSettings();
      if(r.status===403||r.status===429) return null;
    }
    if(!r.ok) return null;
    return await r.json();
  }catch{
    return await fetchJsonLoose(url,12000);
  } finally{ clearTimeout(to); }
}
function githubOwnerRepo(provider){
  const full=provider&&(provider.fullName||String(provider.repoUrl||"").replace(/^https?:\/\/github\.com\//i,"").replace(/\.git$/i,""));
  const parts=String(full||"").split("/").filter(Boolean);
  return parts.length>=2?{owner:parts[0],repo:parts[1],full:parts[0]+"/"+parts[1]}:null;
}
async function probeGitHubProvider(provider){
  if(!provider) return false;
  const gr=githubOwnerRepo(provider);
  provider.lastCheckedAt=Date.now(); provider.lastError="";
  const candidateUrls=[];
  const addUrl=(url,hosted)=>{ const clean=cleanHttpUrl(url); if(clean&&!candidateUrls.some(x=>x.url===clean)) candidateUrls.push({url:clean,hosted:!!hosted}); };
  for(const u of extractManifestUrls([provider.description,provider.homepage].join(" "),provider.repoUrl)) addUrl(u,!/raw\.githubusercontent\.com/i.test(u));
  if(provider.homepage){
    if(/\/manifest\.json(\?|$)/i.test(provider.homepage)) addUrl(provider.homepage,true);
    else { try{const u=new URL(provider.homepage); addUrl(u.href.replace(/\/?$/,"/")+"manifest.json",true);}catch{} }
  }
  if(gr&&provider.hasPages) addUrl("https://"+gr.owner+".github.io/"+gr.repo+"/manifest.json",true);
  if(gr){
    const branches=uniqueStringList([provider.defaultBranch||"main","main","master"]);
    for(const branch of branches){
      const readme=await fetchTextLoose("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/"+gr.full+"/"+branch+"/README.md",9000);
      if(readme){ for(const u of extractManifestUrls(readme,provider.repoUrl)) addUrl(u,!/raw\.githubusercontent\.com/i.test(u)); break; }
    }
  }
  const hosted=candidateUrls.filter(x=>x.hosted);
  for(const c of hosted){
    const crawlerSeed=/^GitHub crawler/i.test(String(provider.source||provider.from||""));
    const rec=await probeManifestUrl(c.url,{id:provider.id,deferInstall:crawlerSeed,from:"GitHub identification",repoUrl:provider.repoUrl,stars:provider.stars||0,tags:provider.tags||[],description:provider.description||""});
    if(rec&&(rec.status==="installed"||rec.titleScopedDiscovery)){
      Object.assign(provider,rec,{id:provider.id,kind:"stremio-addon",repoUrl:provider.repoUrl,fullName:provider.fullName,categories:uniqueStringList([].concat(rec.categories||[],["projects"])),lastCheckedAt:Date.now(),lastError:""});
      return provider.status==="installed";
    }
  }
  if(gr){
    const paths=["manifest.json","addon/manifest.json","public/manifest.json","stremio-addon/manifest.json","src/manifest.json"];
    const branches=uniqueStringList([provider.defaultBranch||"main","main","master"]);
    for(const branch of branches){
      for(const path of paths){
        const rawUrl="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/"+gr.full+"/"+branch+"/"+path;
        const rec=await probeManifestUrl(rawUrl,{id:provider.id,repoOnly:true,from:"GitHub identification",repoUrl:provider.repoUrl,stars:provider.stars||0,tags:provider.tags||[],description:provider.description||""});
        if(rec){
          Object.assign(provider,rec,{id:provider.id,kind:"github-project",status:"candidate",repoUrl:provider.repoUrl,fullName:provider.fullName,manifestRepoUrl:rawUrl,categories:uniqueStringList([].concat(rec.categories||[],provider.categories||[])),lastCheckedAt:Date.now(),lastError:"Manifest identified in repository, but no hosted endpoint was found."});
          return false;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  provider.lastError="No hosted manifest/endpoint identified yet.";
  return false;
}
function classifySeedUrl(raw){
  const clean=cleanHttpUrl(raw);
  if(!clean) return {url:"",kind:"invalid"};
  let u; try{u=new URL(clean);}catch{return {url:clean,kind:"invalid"};}
  if(u.hostname.toLowerCase()==="github.com"&&u.pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean).length>=2) return {url:clean,kind:"github"};
  if(/\/manifest\.json(\?|$)/i.test(clean)) return {url:clean,kind:"manifest"};
  if(isDirectMedia(clean)) return {url:clean,kind:"direct"};
  if(/\.json(\?|$)/i.test(clean)||/\/(feed|sources|providers|addons)(\/|$|\?)/i.test(u.pathname+u.search)) return {url:clean,kind:"feed"};
  return {url:clean,kind:"website"};
}
function providerCandidateFromSeed(seed){
  const c=classifySeedUrl(seed&&seed.url||seed);
  if(!c.url) return null;
  const base={status:"candidate",enabled:true,source:"discovery seed",from:"discovery seed",lastCheckedAt:0,identification:{version:1,kind:"unknown",confidence:15,identifiedAt:0,searchable:false,supports:{movie:false,series:false,streams:false,catalog:false,meta:false,subtitles:false,addonCatalog:false,search:false,episodeLookup:false},identifierModes:[],idPrefixes:[],checks:["waiting for server identification"],installable:false,playableStream:false}};
  if(c.kind==="github") return Object.assign(base,{name:c.url.replace(/^https?:\/\/github\.com\//i,""),kind:"github-project",categories:["projects"],repoUrl:c.url});
  if(c.kind==="manifest") return Object.assign(base,{name:(()=>{try{return new URL(c.url).hostname;}catch{return "Addon endpoint";}})(),kind:"stremio-addon",categories:[],manifestUrl:c.url,endpoint:manifestBaseFromUrl(c.url),base:manifestBaseFromUrl(c.url)});
  if(c.kind==="feed") return Object.assign(base,{name:(()=>{try{return new URL(c.url).hostname+" feed";}catch{return "Provider feed";}})(),kind:"feed",categories:["feeds"],endpoint:c.url});
  if(c.kind==="direct") return Object.assign(base,{name:(()=>{try{return new URL(c.url).hostname;}catch{return "Direct host";}})(),kind:"direct-host",categories:["websites"],endpoint:c.url,description:"Direct media URL, not an identified searchable server."});
  return Object.assign(base,{name:(()=>{try{return prettyHostName(new URL(c.url).hostname);}catch{return "Website";}})(),kind:"website-lookup",categories:["websites"],endpoint:c.url,base:(()=>{try{return new URL(c.url).origin;}catch{return c.url;}})(),home:c.url});
}
function addDiscoverySeedRecord(raw, meta){
  meta=meta||{};
  const c=classifySeedUrl(raw);
  if(!c.url) return null;
  const cfg=discoveryCfg();
  let seed=(cfg.seeds||[]).find(s=>providerStableKey(s.url)===providerStableKey(c.url));
  if(!seed){ seed={url:c.url,kind:c.kind,name:meta.name||"",addedAt:Date.now(),lastCheckedAt:0,lastError:""}; cfg.seeds.push(seed); }
  else { seed.kind=c.kind; if(meta.name) seed.name=meta.name; }
  return seed;

async function identifyAndRegisterEndpoint(raw, meta){
  meta=meta||{};
  const c=classifySeedUrl(raw);
  if(!c.url) return null;
  const result={seen:0,added:0,installed:0,identified:0,candidates:0};
  if(c.kind==="github"){
    const parts=new URL(c.url).pathname.split("/").filter(Boolean);
    const repo=await githubApiFetch("https://api.github.com/repos/"+parts[0]+"/"+parts[1]);
    const rec=repo?githubRepoToProvider(repo,meta.from||"seed identification"):providerCandidateFromSeed(c);
    const up=absorbProvider(result,rec,{force:!!meta.force});
    if(up&&discoveryCfg().crawlers.githubProbe!==false) await probeGitHubProvider(up.provider);
    syncInstalledAddonsFromProviders(); saveSettings();
    return up?up.provider:null;
  }
  if(c.kind==="manifest"){
    const rec=await probeManifestUrl(c.url,{id:meta.existingId||"",from:meta.from||"seed identification"});
    if(rec){ const up=absorbProvider(result,rec,{force:!!meta.force}); syncInstalledAddonsFromProviders(); saveSettings(); return up?up.provider:null; }
    const up=absorbProvider(result,providerCandidateFromSeed(c),{force:!!meta.force}); saveSettings(); return up?up.provider:null;
  }
  if(c.kind==="feed"){
    try{ await processFeedUrl(c.url,{from:meta.from||"seed identification"}); }catch(e){ const up=absorbProvider(result,Object.assign(providerCandidateFromSeed(c),{lastError:e.message||String(e)}),{force:!!meta.force}); saveSettings(); return up?up.provider:null; }
    return getProvider(providerIdFor({kind:"feed",endpoint:c.url}));
  }
  if(c.kind==="direct"){
    const up=absorbProvider(result,providerCandidateFromSeed(c),{force:!!meta.force}); saveSettings(); return up?up.provider:null;
  }
  // Website or unknown server: first ask whether it is actually an addon
  // server, then fall back to identifying it as a searchable website.
  try{
    const u=new URL(c.url);
    const guesses=[];
    const addGuess=x=>{ const clean=cleanHttpUrl(x); if(clean&&!guesses.includes(clean)) guesses.push(clean); };
    addGuess(u.href.replace(/\/?$/,"/")+"manifest.json");
    addGuess(u.origin+"/manifest.json");
    for(const guess of guesses){
      const rec=await probeManifestUrl(guess,{id:meta.existingId||"",from:meta.from||"server identification"});
      if(rec){ const up=absorbProvider(result,rec,{force:!!meta.force}); syncInstalledAddonsFromProviders(); saveSettings(); return up?up.provider:null; }
    }
  }catch{}
  const profile=await registerWebsiteSource(c.url,false,meta.name||"",{force:!!meta.force});
  const site=(settings.sites||[]).find(s=>{ try{return new URL(s.base).hostname.toLowerCase()===new URL(c.url).hostname.toLowerCase();}catch{return false;} });
  if(site){ const up=absorbProvider(result,identifyWebsiteProvider(site,profile,meta.from||"server identification"),{force:!!meta.force}); saveSettings(); return up?up.provider:null; }
  return null;
}
async function addDiscoverySeed(raw, meta){
  meta=meta||{};
  const seed=addDiscoverySeedRecord(raw,meta);
  if(!seed) throw new Error("Paste a valid server, addon, GitHub, feed or website URL");
  seed.lastCheckedAt=Date.now(); seed.lastError="";
  try{
    const provider=await identifyAndRegisterEndpoint(seed.url,{from:meta.from||"manual seed",force:true,name:meta.name||seed.name||""});
    seed.lastCheckedAt=Date.now();
    if(provider) seed.providerId=provider.id;
    saveSettings();
    return provider;
  }catch(e){ seed.lastError=e.message||String(e); seed.lastCheckedAt=Date.now(); saveSettings(); throw e; }
}
function parseFeedProviders(data){
  const lists=[];
  if(Array.isArray(data)) lists.push(data);
  if(data&&typeof data==="object"){
    for(const key of ["providers","addons","sources","items","servers"]) if(Array.isArray(data[key])) lists.push(data[key]);
  }
  const out=[];
  for(const list of lists){
    for(const e of list){
      if(typeof e==="string"){ out.push({seedUrl:e}); continue; }
      if(!e||typeof e!=="object") continue;
      const manifestUrl=cleanHttpUrl(e.manifestUrl||e.transportUrl||e.transport_url||"");
      if(manifestUrl&&e.manifest){
        const provider=providerFromManifest(manifestUrl,e.manifest,{stars:e.stars||0,from:"provider feed",tags:e.tags||e.categories||[]});
        if(provider) out.push({provider});
        continue;
      }
      const seedUrl=cleanHttpUrl(e.manifestUrl||e.transportUrl||e.repoUrl||e.github||e.feedUrl||e.feed||e.website||e.site||((e.url&&!e.movieTpl&&!e.movie&&!e.tvTpl&&!e.episode)?e.url:""));
      if(seedUrl) out.push({seedUrl,name:e.name||""});
    }
  }
  return out;
}
async function processFeedUrl(rawUrl, opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  const url=cleanHttpUrl(rawUrl);
  if(!url) throw new Error("Invalid feed URL");
  const data=await fetchJsonLoose(url,14000);
  if(!data) throw new Error("Feed did not return usable JSON");
  const result={crawler:"feeds",seen:0,added:0,installed:0,identified:0,candidates:0,templatesAdded:0,errors:[]};
  const templates=parseFeedData(data);
  const existing=new Set((settings.customSources||[]).map(sourceSignature));
  for(const e of templates){
    if(existing.has(sourceSignature(e))) continue;
    settings.customSources.push({id:"cs-"+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7),name:e.name,movieTpl:e.movieTpl,tvTpl:e.tvTpl,direct:e.direct,enabled:true,addedVia:"feed"});
    existing.add(sourceSignature(e)); result.templatesAdded++; result.added++;
  }
  for(const entry of parseFeedProviders(data)){
    if(entry.provider) absorbProvider(result,entry.provider);
    else if(entry.seedUrl){
      addDiscoverySeedRecord(entry.seedUrl,{name:entry.name||""});
      absorbProvider(result,providerCandidateFromSeed(entry.seedUrl));
    }
  }
  absorbProvider(result,{
    name:"Provider feed · "+(()=>{try{return new URL(url).hostname;}catch{return "feed";}})(),kind:"feed",categories:["feeds"],status:"installed",endpoint:url,
    source:opts.from||"feed crawler",description:"Feed is re-read by the continuous searcher; new servers are identified before installation.",
    identification:{version:1,kind:"feed",confidence:82,identifiedAt:Date.now(),searchable:false,supports:{movie:false,series:false,streams:false,catalog:false,meta:false,subtitles:false,addonCatalog:false,search:false,episodeLookup:false},identifierModes:["feed-entry"],idPrefixes:[],checks:["valid JSON feed","entries classified","server identification queued for new endpoints"],installable:true,playableStream:false},
    lastCheckedAt:Date.now(),lastError:""
  });
  syncInstalledAddonsFromProviders(); saveSettings();
  return result;
}
function emptyCrawlResult(name){ return {crawler:name,seen:0,added:0,installed:0,identified:0,candidates:0,errors:[]}; }
async function crawlStremioAddonsNet(){
  const result=emptyCrawlResult("stremio-addons.net");
  const cfg=discoveryCfg();
  const page=Math.max(1,Number(cfg.cursors.stremioAddonsPage)||1);
  const sortMode=cfg.cursors.stremioAddonsSort==="stars"?"stars":"createdAt";
  const url="https://stremio-addons.net/api/v0/addons?limit=100&nsfw=exclude&sort_by="+sortMode+"&order=desc&page="+page;
  const data=await fetchJsonLoose(url,15000);
  if(!data||!Array.isArray(data.addons)){ result.errors.push("catalogue unavailable"); return result; }
  const ingest=(entry)=>{
    if(!entry) return;
    const manifestUrl=cleanHttpUrl(entry.manifestUrl||"");
    const tags=(entry.categories||[]).map(c=>typeof c==="string"?c:(c.slug||c.name)).filter(Boolean);
    if(manifestUrl&&entry.manifest){
      const rec=providerFromManifest(manifestUrl,entry.manifest,{stars:entry.stars||0,from:"stremio-addons.net",tags,deferInstall:true});
      if(rec) absorbProvider(result,rec);
    }else if(manifestUrl){
      absorbProvider(result,{name:(entry.manifest&&entry.manifest.name)||entry.slug||"Addon candidate",kind:"stremio-addon",categories:[],status:"candidate",titleScopedDiscovery:true,manifestUrl,endpoint:manifestBaseFromUrl(manifestUrl),base:manifestBaseFromUrl(manifestUrl),stars:entry.stars||0,source:"stremio-addons.net",tags,identification:{version:1,kind:"unknown",confidence:20,identifiedAt:0,searchable:false,supports:{movie:false,series:false,streams:false,catalog:false,meta:false,subtitles:false,addonCatalog:false,search:false,episodeLookup:false},identifierModes:[],idPrefixes:[],checks:["manifest URL discovered; title-scoped stream match required before install"],installable:false,playableStream:false}});
    }
  };
  for(const addon of data.addons){ ingest(addon); for(const inst of (addon.instances||[])) ingest(inst); }
  const pagination=data.pagination||{};
  if(pagination.hasNextPage) cfg.cursors.stremioAddonsPage=page+1;
  else { cfg.cursors.stremioAddonsPage=1; cfg.cursors.stremioAddonsSort=sortMode==="createdAt"?"stars":"createdAt"; }
  return result;
}
function addonCatalogEndpointUrls(){
  const urls=[];
  const add=(url,label)=>{ const clean=cleanHttpUrl(url); if(clean&&!urls.some(x=>x.url===clean)) urls.push({url:clean,label:label||"addon catalogue"}); };
  add("https://v3-cinemeta.strem.io/addon_catalog/all/community.json","Cinemeta community");
  add("https://v3-cinemeta.strem.io/addon_catalog/all/official.json","Cinemeta official");
  for(const p of (settings.providers||[])){
    if(!p.base||!(p.addonCatalogs&&p.addonCatalogs.length)) continue;
    for(const def of p.addonCatalogs){
      if(!def.type||!def.id) continue;
      add(p.base+"/addon_catalog/"+encodeURIComponent(def.type)+"/"+encodeURIComponent(def.id)+".json",p.name||"addon catalogue");
    }
  }
  return urls;
}
async function crawlCatalogGraph(){
  const result=emptyCrawlResult("catalog graph");
  const cfg=discoveryCfg();
  const cinemeta=await probeManifestUrl("https://v3-cinemeta.strem.io/manifest.json",{from:"catalog graph"});
  if(cinemeta) absorbProvider(result,cinemeta);
  const endpoints=addonCatalogEndpointUrls();
  if(!endpoints.length) return result;
  const fixed=endpoints.slice(0,2);
  const rotating=endpoints.slice(2);
  const batch=fixed.slice();
  if(rotating.length){
    const start=Math.max(0,Number(cfg.cursors.catalogGraphIndex)||0)%rotating.length;
    for(let i=0;i<Math.min(4,rotating.length);i++) batch.push(rotating[(start+i)%rotating.length]);
    cfg.cursors.catalogGraphIndex=(start+Math.min(4,rotating.length))%rotating.length;
  }
  for(const ep of batch){
    const data=await fetchJsonLoose(ep.url,15000);
    if(!data||!Array.isArray(data.addons)){ result.errors.push(ep.label+" unavailable"); continue; }
    for(const entry of data.addons){
      const manifestUrl=cleanHttpUrl(entry.transportUrl||entry.manifestUrl||(entry.transport&&entry.transport.url)||"");
      if(!manifestUrl) continue;
      if(entry.manifest){
        const rec=providerFromManifest(manifestUrl,entry.manifest,{from:ep.label,deferInstall:true});
        if(rec) absorbProvider(result,rec);
      }else{
          absorbProvider(result,{name:"Addon candidate · "+(()=>{try{return new URL(manifestUrl).hostname;}catch{return "endpoint";}})(),kind:"stremio-addon",categories:[],status:"candidate",titleScopedDiscovery:true,manifestUrl,endpoint:manifestBaseFromUrl(manifestUrl),base:manifestBaseFromUrl(manifestUrl),source:ep.label,identification:{version:1,kind:"unknown",confidence:20,identifiedAt:0,searchable:false,supports:{movie:false,series:false,streams:false,catalog:false,meta:false,subtitles:false,addonCatalog:false,search:false,episodeLookup:false},identifierModes:[],idPrefixes:[],checks:["manifest URL found in addon catalogue; title-scoped stream match required before install"],installable:false,playableStream:false}});
      }
    }
    await discoveryDelay(120);
  }
  return result;
}
async function crawlGitHub(){
  const result=emptyCrawlResult("GitHub");
  const cfg=discoveryCfg();
  if(Number(cfg.githubPausedUntil||0)>Date.now()){ result.errors.push("GitHub keyless rate limit cooling down"); return result; }
  const queries=(cfg.githubQueries||[]).map(q=>String(q||"").trim()).filter(Boolean);
  if(!queries.length) return result;
  const qi=Math.max(0,Number(cfg.cursors.githubQueryIndex)||0)%queries.length;
  const query=queries[qi];
  const cursorKey="github:"+query;
  const page=Math.max(1,Number(cfg.cursors[cursorKey])||1);
  const url="https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q="+encodeURIComponent(query)+"&sort=updated&order=desc&per_page=100&page="+page;
  const data=await githubApiFetch(url);
  if(!data||!Array.isArray(data.items)){ result.errors.push("GitHub search unavailable or rate-limited"); return result; }
  for(const repo of data.items){ const rec=githubRepoToProvider(repo,"GitHub crawler · "+query); if(rec) absorbProvider(result,rec); }
  const reachable=Math.min(Number(data.total_count||0),1000);
  if(!data.items.length||page*100>=reachable){ cfg.cursors[cursorKey]=1; cfg.cursors.githubQueryIndex=(qi+1)%queries.length; }
  else cfg.cursors[cursorKey]=page+1;
  return result;
}
async function identifyProviderCandidate(provider, result){
  if(!provider||provider.status==="installed") return false;
  const wasInstalled=false;
  provider.lastCheckedAt=Date.now();
  try{
    if(provider.kind==="github-project"){
      if(discoveryCfg().crawlers.githubProbe===false) return false;
      const ok=await probeGitHubProvider(provider);
      if(provider.status==="installed"&&!wasInstalled){ result.installed++; result.identified++; }
      return ok;
    }
    if(provider.manifestUrl){
      const rec=await probeManifestUrl(provider.manifestUrl,{id:provider.id,deferInstall:!!provider.titleScopedDiscovery,from:provider.source||"candidate identification",repoUrl:provider.repoUrl||"",stars:provider.stars||0,tags:provider.tags||[]});
      if(rec){
        const before=provider.status;
        Object.assign(provider,rec,{id:provider.id,categories:uniqueStringList([].concat(provider.categories||[],rec.categories||[])),lastCheckedAt:Date.now(),lastError:""});
        if(before!=="installed"&&provider.status==="installed"){ result.installed++; result.identified++; }
        return provider.status==="installed";
      }
      provider.lastError="Manifest could not be identified yet.";
      return false;
    }
    const endpoint=provider.endpoint||provider.base||provider.home||provider.repoUrl;
    if(endpoint){
      const identified=await identifyAndRegisterEndpoint(endpoint,{existingId:provider.id,from:"candidate identification"});
      if(identified&&identified.status==="installed"){ result.installed++; result.identified++; return true; }
    }
  }catch(e){ provider.lastError=e.message||String(e); result.errors.push(provider.name+": "+provider.lastError); }
  return false;
}
async function crawlCandidateIdentification(){
  const result=emptyCrawlResult("server identification");
  const candidates=(settings.providers||[])
    .filter(p=>p.status!=="installed"&&(p.manifestUrl||p.repoUrl||p.endpoint||p.base||p.home))
    .filter(p=>!(p.titleScopedDiscovery&&p.identification&&p.identification.supports&&p.identification.supports.streams))
    .sort((a,b)=>((a.lastCheckedAt||0)-(b.lastCheckedAt||0))||((b.stars||0)-(a.stars||0)))
    .slice(0,5);
  for(const p of candidates){ result.seen++; await identifyProviderCandidate(p,result); await discoveryDelay(100); }
  return result;
}
async function crawlFeedsAndSeeds(){
  const result=emptyCrawlResult("feeds & seeds");
  const cfg=discoveryCfg();
  if(settings.feed&&settings.feed.url&&settings.feed.auto!==false){
    const due=Date.now()-Number(settings.feed.lastCheck||0)>=Math.max(1,Number(settings.feed.intervalMin)||15)*60*1000;
    if(due){
      try{ const r=await processFeedUrl(settings.feed.url,{from:"continuous feed crawler"}); result.seen+=r.seen||0; result.added+=r.added||0; result.installed+=r.installed||0; result.identified+=r.identified||0; result.candidates+=r.candidates||0; settings.feed.lastCheck=Date.now(); }
      catch(e){ result.errors.push(e.message||String(e)); settings.feed.lastCheck=Date.now(); }
    }
  }
  const dueSeeds=(cfg.seeds||[]).slice().sort((a,b)=>(a.lastCheckedAt||0)-(b.lastCheckedAt||0)).slice(0,3);
  for(const seed of dueSeeds){
    if(seed.lastCheckedAt&&Date.now()-seed.lastCheckedAt<15*60*1000&&seed.providerId) continue;
    result.seen++;
    seed.lastCheckedAt=Date.now();
    try{
      const p=await identifyAndRegisterEndpoint(seed.url,{from:"continuous seed crawler",name:seed.name||""});
      if(p){ seed.providerId=p.id; if(p.status==="installed") result.identified++; }
      seed.lastError="";
    }catch(e){ seed.lastError=e.message||String(e); result.errors.push(seed.lastError); }
  }
  return result;
}
async function crawlWebsites(){
  const result=emptyCrawlResult("website identification");
  const sites=(settings.sites||[]).slice().sort((a,b)=>{
    const pa=getProvider(a.id), pb=getProvider(b.id);
    return ((pa&&pa.lastCheckedAt)||0)-((pb&&pb.lastCheckedAt)||0);
  }).slice(0,3);
  for(const site of sites){
    result.seen++;
    try{
      const profile=await resolverCall({mode:"profile",url:site.home||site.base});
      site.base=profile.origin||site.base; site.home=profile.url||site.home; site.searchTemplate=profile.searchTemplate||site.searchTemplate||"";
      absorbProvider(result,identifyWebsiteProvider(site,profile,"continuous website crawler"));
    }catch(e){
      const p=getProvider(site.id); if(p){ p.lastCheckedAt=Date.now(); p.lastError=e.message||String(e); }
      result.errors.push((site.name||site.base)+": "+(e.message||e));
    }
  }
  return result;
}
async function crawlHealth(){
  const result=emptyCrawlResult("health");
  result.seen=await runHealthChecks(false,20);
  return result;
}
function sourceReadiness(){
  const counts=providerCounts();
  const cfg=discoveryCfg(); const st=cfg.stats||{};
  const enabled=typeof allSources==="function"?allSources():[];
  const readyCount=Array.isArray(enabled)?enabled.length:0;
  if(discoveryRuntime.cycleRunning) return {key:"searching",label:"Searching",detail:"Looking for more places to watch…",readyCount,counts};
  if(readyCount<=0) return {key:"problem",label:"Problem",detail:"No sources are turned on.",readyCount,counts};
  const foundCount=Number(discoveryRuntime.lastFoundCount)||0;
  if(foundCount>0&&discoveryRuntime.lastFoundAt&&Date.now()-discoveryRuntime.lastFoundAt<10*60*1000){
    return {key:"found",label:"Found sources",detail:foundCount+" new source"+(foundCount===1?" is":"s are")+" ready to use.",readyCount,counts};
  }
  if(discoveryRuntime.lastError&&counts.installed===0&&Number(st.lastErrors||0)>0){
    return {key:"problem",label:"Problem",detail:"The last source search hit a problem. Your ready sources still work.",readyCount,counts};
  }
  if(!discoveryRuntime.running&&!cfg.autoStart) return {key:"ready",label:"Ready",detail:readyCount+" source"+(readyCount===1?" is":"s are")+" ready. Automatic search is off.",readyCount,counts};
  return {key:"ready",label:"Ready",detail:readyCount+" source"+(readyCount===1?" is":"s are")+" ready to watch from.",readyCount,counts};
}
function discoveryStatusText(){
  const state=sourceReadiness();
  return state.label+" · "+state.detail;
}
function discoveryDiagnosticsText(){
  const cfg=discoveryCfg(); const counts=providerCounts(); const st=cfg.stats||{};
  const last=st.lastCycleAt?new Date(st.lastCycleAt).toLocaleTimeString():"not run yet";
  return "Diagnostics: "+counts.installed+" ready providers · "+counts.candidate+" being checked · "+counts.all+" saved · "+(st.cycles||0)+" searches · last "+last+(st.lastSummary?(" · "+st.lastSummary):"");
}
function refreshSourceStatePanel(){
  const panel=document.getElementById("sourceStatePanel");
  const diagnostics=document.getElementById("discoveryDiagnostics");
  if(panel){
    const state=sourceReadiness();
    panel.dataset.state=state.key;
    panel.className="panel source-state-panel is-"+state.key;
    const title=document.getElementById("sourceStateTitle"); if(title) title.textContent=state.label;
    const detail=document.getElementById("sourceStateDetail"); if(detail) detail.textContent=state.detail;
    const button=document.getElementById("btnSourceStateSearch"); if(button){ button.disabled=!!discoveryRuntime.cycleRunning; button.textContent=discoveryRuntime.cycleRunning?"Searching…":"Find more"; }
  }
  if(diagnostics) diagnostics.textContent=discoveryDiagnosticsText();
}
function refreshDiscoveryUi(){
  const status=document.getElementById("discoveryStatus");
  if(status) status.textContent=discoveryStatusText();
  refreshSourceStatePanel();
  if(routeNow()!=="sources") return;
  const active=document.activeElement;
  if(active&&/^(INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT)$/.test(active.tagName||"")) return;
  renderSources(true);
}
async function runDiscoveryCycle(reason){
  ensureProviderRegistry();
  const cfg=discoveryCfg();
  if(discoveryRuntime.cycleRunning) return discoveryRuntime.lastSummary;
  if(typeof playerState!=="undefined"&&playerState&&!playerState.trailer){ discoveryRuntime.deferredForPlayback=true; return discoveryRuntime.lastSummary; }
  discoveryRuntime.cycleRunning=true;
  const status=document.getElementById("discoveryStatus"); if(status) status.textContent="Searching · Looking for more places to watch…"; refreshSourceStatePanel();
  const started=Date.now();
  const totals={seen:0,added:0,installed:0,identified:0,candidates:0,errors:[],byCrawler:{}};
  const jobs=[
    ["catalogGraph",crawlCatalogGraph],["stremioAddons",crawlStremioAddonsNet],["github",crawlGitHub],
    ["candidateIdentification",crawlCandidateIdentification],["feeds",crawlFeedsAndSeeds],["websites",crawlWebsites],["health",crawlHealth]
  ];
  try{
    for(const [key,fn] of jobs){
      if(typeof playerState!=="undefined"&&playerState&&!playerState.trailer){ discoveryRuntime.deferredForPlayback=true; totals.errors.push("paused while video is playing"); break; }
      if(cfg.crawlers[key]===false) continue;
      try{
        const r=await fn();
        totals.byCrawler[key]=r;
        totals.seen+=r.seen||0; totals.added+=r.added||0; totals.installed+=r.installed||0;
        totals.identified+=r.identified||0; totals.candidates+=r.candidates||0;
        for(const e of (r.errors||[])) totals.errors.push(key+": "+e);
      }catch(e){ totals.errors.push(key+": "+(e.message||e)); }
      syncInstalledAddonsFromProviders(); saveSettings();
      if(document.getElementById("providerList")) refreshProviderList();
      await discoveryDelay(60);
    }
  }finally{
    discoveryRuntime.cycleRunning=false;
  }
  cfg.stats.cycles=(cfg.stats.cycles||0)+1;
  cfg.stats.lastCycleAt=Date.now();
  cfg.stats.lastAdded=totals.added;
  cfg.stats.lastInstalled=totals.installed;
  cfg.stats.lastIdentified=totals.identified;
  cfg.stats.lastErrors=totals.errors.length;
  cfg.stats.lastSummary=totals.added+" new · "+totals.installed+" newly installed · "+totals.identified+" identified sightings · "+totals.errors.length+" crawler notes · "+Math.round((Date.now()-started)/1000)+"s";
  discoveryRuntime.lastSummary=totals;
  discoveryRuntime.lastError=totals.errors[0]||"";
  if(totals.added||totals.installed){ discoveryRuntime.lastFoundAt=Date.now(); discoveryRuntime.lastFoundCount=(totals.added||0)+(totals.installed||0); }
  settings.feed.lastAddonCheck=cfg.stats.lastCycleAt;
  syncInstalledAddonsFromProviders(); saveSettings();
  if(totals.added||totals.installed) dlog("Continuous search: "+cfg.stats.lastSummary+" ("+(reason||"cycle")+")");
  refreshDiscoveryUi();
  return totals;
}
function startDiscoveryEngine(manual, immediate){
  const cfg=discoveryCfg();
  cfg.autoStart=true; discoveryRuntime.running=true;
  if(discoveryRuntime.timer) clearInterval(discoveryRuntime.timer);
  discoveryRuntime.timer=setInterval(()=>{ runDiscoveryCycle("interval"); },Math.max(20,Number(cfg.intervalSec)||90)*1000);
  saveSettings();
  if(immediate!==false&&!discoveryRuntime.cycleRunning){
    const delay=discoveryRuntime.startedOnce?0:(tvPerformanceEnabled()?8000:1800);
    discoveryRuntime.startedOnce=true;
    setTimeout(()=>runDiscoveryCycle(manual?"manual start":"start"),delay);
  }else discoveryRuntime.startedOnce=true;
  refreshDiscoveryUi();
}
function stopDiscoveryEngine(manual){
  const cfg=discoveryCfg();
  cfg.autoStart=false; discoveryRuntime.running=false;
  if(discoveryRuntime.timer) clearInterval(discoveryRuntime.timer);
  discoveryRuntime.timer=null; saveSettings(); refreshDiscoveryUi();
  if(manual) toast("Automatic source search is off");
}
async function installProviderById(id){
  ensureProviderRegistry();
  const p=getProvider(id);
  if(!p) throw new Error("Provider not found");
  if(settings.providerTombstones) delete settings.providerTombstones[id];
  const result=emptyCrawlResult("manual identification");
  let ok=false;
  if(p.status==="installed") ok=true;
  else ok=await identifyProviderCandidate(p,result);
  syncInstalledAddonsFromProviders(); saveSettings(); refreshDiscoveryUi();
  return {provider:getProvider(id)||p,installed:ok||(getProvider(id)||p).status==="installed",result};
}
function streamIdsForAddon(addon, identity, imdb){
  const type=identity.type==="tv"?"series":"movie";
  const prefixes=uniqueStringList([].concat(addon.idPrefixes||[],(addon.identification&&addon.identification.idPrefixes)||[]).map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase()));
  const out=[];
  const add=(base)=>{ if(!base) return; const id=type==="series"?(base+":"+(identity.season||1)+":"+(identity.episode||1)):base; if(!out.includes(id)) out.push(id); };
  if((!prefixes.length||prefixes.includes("tt"))&&imdb) add(imdb);
  if((prefixes.includes("tmdb")||(!imdb&&!prefixes.length))&&identity.tmdbId) add("tmdb:"+identity.tmdbId);
  return out;
}
async function searchAddonCatalog(addon, identity){
  const type=identity.type==="tv"?"series":"movie";
  const defs=(addon.searchCatalogs&&addon.searchCatalogs.length?addon.searchCatalogs:(addon.catalogDefs||[]).filter(c=>(c.extraSupported||[]).includes("search")))
    .filter(c=>!c.type||c.type===type||c.type==="all");
  if(!defs.length||!addon.base) return null;
  const queries=identityUnique([identity.title].concat(identity.titles||[])).slice(0,2);
  let checked=0;
  for(const def of defs){
    for(const q of queries){
      const url=addon.base+"/catalog/"+encodeURIComponent(type)+"/"+encodeURIComponent(def.id)+"/search="+encodeURIComponent(q)+".json";
      const data=await fetchJsonLoose(url,12000);
      const metas=data&&Array.isArray(data.metas)?data.metas:[];
      let best=null;
      for(const meta of metas){
        checked++;
        const candidate={title:meta.name||meta.title||"",name:meta.name||"",type:meta.type||type,year:String(meta.releaseInfo||meta.released||meta.year||"").slice(0,4),imdbId:meta.imdb_id||"",tmdbId:meta.moviedb_id||null,id:meta.id||"",url:""};
        const verdict=identifyTitleCandidate(candidate,identity,{threshold:85});
        if(!best||verdict.score>best.verdict.score) best={meta,verdict};
        if(verdict.accepted){
          let streamId=String(meta.id||"");
          if(identity.type==="tv"){
            let videos=Array.isArray(meta.videos)?meta.videos:[];
            if(!videos.length&&addon.supportsMeta!==false&&meta.id){
              const detail=await fetchJsonLoose(addon.base+"/meta/series/"+encodeURIComponent(meta.id)+".json",12000);
              const detailMeta=detail&&detail.meta?detail.meta:null;
              if(detailMeta){
                const detailVerdict=identifyTitleCandidate({title:detailMeta.name||detailMeta.title||"",name:detailMeta.name||"",type:detailMeta.type||"series",year:String(detailMeta.releaseInfo||detailMeta.released||detailMeta.year||"").slice(0,4),imdbId:detailMeta.imdb_id||"",tmdbId:detailMeta.moviedb_id||null,id:detailMeta.id||meta.id},identity,{threshold:85});
                if(detailVerdict.hardReject) continue;
                videos=Array.isArray(detailMeta.videos)?detailMeta.videos:[];
              }
            }
            const exact=videos.find(v=>Number(v.season)===Number(identity.season||1)&&Number(v.episode)===Number(identity.episode||1));
            if(exact&&exact.id) streamId=String(exact.id);
            else if(streamId&&streamId.split(":").length<3) streamId=streamId+":"+(identity.season||1)+":"+(identity.episode||1);
          }
          return {meta,verdict,streamId,checked,catalogId:def.id,query:q};
        }
      }
      if(best&&best.verdict.score>=98) break;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function enabledAddons(){ return (settings.addons||[]).filter(a=>a.enabled!==false); }
function parseStreamMeta(s){
  const text = [s.name||"", s.title||"", s.description||""].join("\n");
  const sizeM = text.match(/(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*(TB|GB|GiB|MB|MiB)/i);
  let bytes = null;
  if(sizeM){ const v=parseFloat(sizeM[1].replace(",",".")); const u=sizeM[2].toLowerCase(); bytes = Math.round(v * (u.startsWith("t")?1e12 : u.startsWith("g")?1e9 : 1e6)); }
  const qM = text.match(/(2160p|1080p|720p|480p|4k|uhd|hdr|dv|dolby vision)/i);
  const seedM = text.match(/👤\s*(\d+)|seeders?\D{0,6}(\d+)/i);
  return { bytes, quality: qM ? qM[1].toUpperCase().replace("UHD","4K") : "", seeders: seedM ? Number(seedM[1]||seedM[2]) : null, label:(s.name||s.title||"Stream").split("\n")[0].slice(0,90), sub:(s.title||s.description||"").split("\n").slice(0,2).join(" · ").slice(0,140) };
}
function qualityRank(q){ return {"2160P":4,"4K":4,"1080P":3,"720P":2,"480P":1}[String(q||"").toUpperCase()]||0; }
async function queryAddonStreams(addon, ctx){
  const fullAddon=(settings.addons||[]).find(a=>a.id===addon.id||a.base===addon.base)||addon;
  let identity=(ctx&&ctx.identity&&ctx.identity.version)?ctx.identity:buildTitleIdentity(ctx||{});
  let imdb=identity.imdbId||(ctx&&ctx.imdb)||"";
  if(!imdb&&identity.tmdbId) imdb=await fetchImdbId(identity.type,identity.tmdbId);
  if(imdb&&!identity.imdbId) identity=buildTitleIdentity(Object.assign({},ctx||{},{identity,imdb}));
  const type=identity.type==="tv"?"series":"movie";
  const out={direct:[],torrents:0,oversize:0,external:0,identityRejected:0,identityVerified:0,catalogChecked:0,catalogMatch:null,queriedIds:[]};
  const seenUrls=new Set();
  const processStreams=async(streamId,idVerified,evidence)=>{
    if(!streamId||out.queriedIds.includes(streamId)) return false;
    out.queriedIds.push(streamId);

async function collectAllStreams(ctx,opts){

    try{ if(!variant.addonBase) key=new URL(variant.url).hostname; }catch{}
    if(!groups.has(key)){

      groups.set(key,{

        kind:"direct", status:"verified", verified:true,
        name:variant.addonName||(addon&&addon.name)||key,
        sourceId:addon?addon.id:"", source:addon||null,

  }

    if(identity.type==="tv"&&(supports.series===false||supports.tv===false)) return {supported:false,reason:"provider does not identify as a series server"};

  return (options||[]).filter(Boolean).sort((a,b)=>rank(a)-rank(b)||((b.score||0)-(a.score||0))||healthScore(b.sourceId)-healthScore(a.sourceId)||String(a.name).localeCompare(String(b.name)));

    const base=String(record.base).replace(/\/$/,"");

      stats.matchedWebsites++;
      const direct=sortVariantsForQuality((found.direct||[]).map(url=>({url,addonName:source.name,label:found.pageTitle||found.watchTitle||source.name})),settings.stream.quality);
      if(found.playUrl&&isDirectMedia(found.playUrl)&&!direct.some(v=>v.url===found.playUrl)) direct.unshift(normalizeVariant({url:found.playUrl,addonName:source.name,label:found.pageTitle||source.name},source.name));
      addOption({
        id:"site:"+source.id,
        kind:direct.length&&isDirectMedia(found.playUrl||direct[0].url)?"direct":"site",
        status:"verified", verified:true,
        name:source.name, sourceId:source.id, source, url:found.playUrl||found.watchUrl||found.embed||"",
        variants:direct, activeVariant:direct.find(v=>v.url===found.playUrl)||direct[0]||null,
        identityScore:Number(found.identity&&found.identity.score)||0, identityVerdict:found.identity&&found.identity.verdict||"website identity verified",
        score:70+(Number(found.identity&&found.identity.score)||0)/4,
        evidence:"website returned and identity-verified this title",
      });
    });
    emit();
  })();
  /* 3) Identified addon/direct servers: only servers returning verified
        streams for this exact movie/episode become options, grouped by
        server with their real quality variants. */
  let addonSearchActive=true, quickSearchDetached=false;
  const runAddons=collectAllStreams(richCtx,{
    concurrency:opts.concurrency||100,
    signal:opts.signal,
    shouldContinue:()=>addonSearchActive&&(quickSearchDetached||!opts.shouldContinue||opts.shouldContinue()),
    onProgress:agg=>{
      stats.queriedProviders=agg.queried; stats.totalProviders=agg.totalAddons; stats.concurrency=agg.concurrency; stats.identityVerified=agg.identityVerified; stats.identityRejected=agg.identityRejected; stats.torrents=agg.torrents; stats.oversize=agg.oversize; stats.external=agg.external; stats.catalogMatches=agg.catalogMatches;
      for(const group of groupStreamsByServer(agg.direct)) byId.set(group.id,group);
      emit();
    }
  });
  /* Candidate search reads only the current registry snapshot. The separate
     continuous crawler discovers and identifies new servers on its own timer. */
  const runCandidates=runServerFinder.then(()=>collectTitleCandidateStreams(richCtx,{
    limit:100,concurrency:12,signal:opts.signal,
    shouldContinue:()=>addonSearchActive&&(quickSearchDetached||!opts.shouldContinue||opts.shouldContinue()),
    onProgress:found=>{
      stats.titleCandidatesQueried=found.queried; stats.titleCandidatesTotal=found.totalCandidates; stats.titleCandidatesAvailable=found.availableCandidates; stats.titleCandidatesMatched=found.matchedProviders; stats.titleCandidateConcurrency=found.concurrency;
      for(const group of groupStreamsByServer(found.direct)) byId.set(group.id,group);
      emit();
    }
  }));
  const runTitleCandidates=Promise.all([runAddons,runCandidates]).then(([providerAgg,candidateAgg])=>{
    providerAgg.titleCandidateAgg=candidateAgg;
    for(const stream of candidateAgg.direct||[]) if(stream&&stream.url&&!providerAgg.direct.some(existing=>existing.url===stream.url)) providerAgg.direct.push(stream);
    return providerAgg;
  });
  const runAllSearches=runTitleCandidates;
  let agg=null;
  if(opts.quick){
    /* Quick playback failover races only the direct-provider scan; slower web
       engines continue alongside it and update the open modal independently. */
    agg=await Promise.race([runTitleCandidates,new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(()=>resolve(null),Math.max(5000,Number(opts.quickTimeoutMs)||10000)))]);
    if(!agg){
      /* A quick caller can consume playable results while title-scoped
         provider checks continue and emit live updates. */
      quickSearchDetached=true;
      runAllSearches.then(async fullAgg=>{
        addonSearchActive=false;
        await Promise.allSettled([routeTask,websiteTask]);
        stats.queriedProviders=fullAgg.queried; stats.totalProviders=fullAgg.totalAddons; stats.concurrency=fullAgg.concurrency;
        stats.identityVerified=fullAgg.identityVerified; stats.identityRejected=fullAgg.identityRejected; stats.torrents=fullAgg.torrents; stats.oversize=fullAgg.oversize; stats.external=fullAgg.external; stats.catalogMatches=fullAgg.catalogMatches;
        const candidateStats=fullAgg.titleCandidateAgg||{};
        stats.titleCandidatesQueried=candidateStats.queried||0; stats.titleCandidatesTotal=candidateStats.totalCandidates||0; stats.titleCandidatesAvailable=candidateStats.availableCandidates||0; stats.titleCandidatesMatched=candidateStats.matchedProviders||0; stats.titleCandidateConcurrency=candidateStats.concurrency||0;
        for(const group of groupStreamsByServer(fullAgg.direct)) byId.set(group.id,group);
        const completed=snapshot(true); completed.agg=fullAgg;
        if(opts.onUpdate){ try{ opts.onUpdate(completed); }catch{} }
      }).catch(()=>{});
      const partial=snapshot(false); partial.agg=null;
      return partial;
    }
  }else agg=await runAllSearches;
  addonSearchActive=false;
  await Promise.allSettled([routeTask,websiteTask]);
  if(agg){
    stats.queriedProviders=agg.queried; stats.concurrency=agg.concurrency; stats.identityVerified=agg.identityVerified; stats.identityRejected=agg.identityRejected; stats.torrents=agg.torrents; stats.oversize=agg.oversize; stats.external=agg.external; stats.catalogMatches=agg.catalogMatches;
    const candidateStats=agg.titleCandidateAgg||{};
    stats.titleCandidatesQueried=candidateStats.queried||0; stats.titleCandidatesTotal=candidateStats.totalCandidates||0; stats.titleCandidatesAvailable=candidateStats.availableCandidates||0; stats.titleCandidatesMatched=candidateStats.matchedProviders||0; stats.titleCandidateConcurrency=candidateStats.concurrency||0;
    for(const group of groupStreamsByServer(agg.direct)) byId.set(group.id,group);
  }
  const result=snapshot(true);
  result.agg=agg;
  if(!opts.quick&&!(agg&&agg.aborted)){
    const latestInventory=enabledAddons().map(a=>String(a.id||"")+"@"+String(a.base||"")).sort().join("|");
    const checkedCandidateInventory=agg&&agg.titleCandidateAgg?agg.titleCandidateAgg.candidateInventory:titleCandidateInventoryFingerprint();
    const latestCacheKey=identity.fingerprint+":"+identity.type+":"+identity.season+":"+identity.episode+":"+(settings.stream.quality||"auto")+":"+latestInventory+":"+checkedCandidateInventory;
    titleServerCache.set(latestCacheKey,{t:Date.now(),data:result});
  }
  if(opts.onUpdate){ try{ opts.onUpdate(result); }catch{} }
  return result;
}
async function playTitleServerOption(option,ctx,opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  if(!option) return;
  ctx=Object.assign({},ctx||{});
  const identity=(ctx.identity&&ctx.identity.version)?ctx.identity:buildTitleIdentity(ctx);
  ctx.identity=identity;
  const item=ctx.item||snap(catalogItemFor(ctx.type||identity.type,ctx.id||identity.tmdbId),identity.type);
  const variants=sortVariantsForQuality(option.variants||[],settings.stream.quality);
  const selected=opts.variant?normalizeVariant(opts.variant):(option.kind==="direct"?(chooseVariantForQuality(variants,settings.stream.quality,"")||variants[0]||(option.url?normalizeVariant({url:option.url,addonName:option.name},option.name):null)):null);
  if(playerState&&opts.fromPlayer){
    const st=playerState;
    st.currentServerOptionId=option.id; st.tried.add(option.id); if(option.sourceId) st.tried.add(option.sourceId);
    st.identity=identity;
    if(option.kind==="direct"&&selected){
      st.source=option.sourceId||st.source; st.tempSource=option.source&&option.source.kind?null:st.tempSource;
      st.variants=variants.length?variants:[selected]; st.activeVariant=selected; st.directUrl=selected.url; st.directQueue=st.variants.filter(v=>v.url!==selected.url);
      await switchDirectVariant(selected,{keepTime:opts.keepTime!==false,reason:"server"});
      return;
    }
    const at=currentPlaybackTime();
    const prev=Object.assign({},progress[keyOf(st.item.type,st.item.id)]||{},{season:st.season,episode:st.episode,timestamp:at>30?at:0,position:at>30?at:0,percent:st.playback&&st.playback.duration?Math.round(at/st.playback.duration*100):0});
    savePlaybackProgress(true);
    st.source=option.sourceId||st.source; st.tempSource=option.source&&!getSource(option.sourceId)?option.source:null;
    st.directUrl=""; st.variants=[]; st.activeVariant=null; st.levels=[];
    await drawPlayer(prev);
    return;
  }
  if(detailState) closeDetail();
  if(option.kind==="direct"&&selected){
    playResolvedURL(selected.url,item,option.name,variants,{ctx,identity,season:identity.season,episode:identity.episode,sourceId:option.sourceId||"",source:option.source&&!getSource(option.sourceId)?option.source:null,optionId:option.id,activeVariant:selected,variants});
    if(playerState) playerState.availableServers=opts.availableServers||playerState.availableServers||[];
    return;
  }
  await openPlayer(item,{season:identity.season,episode:identity.episode,source:option.sourceId||defaultSourceId()});
  if(playerState){ playerState.currentServerOptionId=option.id; if(opts.availableServers) playerState.availableServers=opts.availableServers; }
}
async function resolveAddonURL(source, ctx){
  const addon = enabledAddons().find(a=>a.id===source.id) || source;
  const res = await queryAddonStreams(addon, ctx);
  if(!res.direct.length) throw new Error(addon.name+": no identity-verified direct streams ("+res.torrents+" torrent-only hidden"+(res.oversize?", "+res.oversize+" over "+capGb()+" GB cap":"")+(res.identityRejected?", "+res.identityRejected+" rejected by title identifier":"")+")");
  return res.direct[0].url;
}

/* ---- website lookup sources (paste a site; catalogue titles stay in ZeroPlay) ---- */
async function resolverCall(params){
  const qs=new URLSearchParams();
  for(const [k,v] of Object.entries(params||{})) if(v!==undefined&&v!==null&&v!=="") qs.set(k,String(v));
  const r=await fetch("/api/extract?"+qs.toString());
  let data=null; try{ data=await r.json(); }catch{}
  if(!r.ok||!data||data.ok===false) throw new Error((data&&data.error)||("Website lookup service unavailable (HTTP "+r.status+")"));
  return data;
}
async function registerWebsiteSource(rawUrl, manual, preferredName, opts){
  opts=opts||{};
  let u=null;
  try{ u=new URL(String(rawUrl||"").includes("://")?String(rawUrl):"https://"+String(rawUrl||"")); }catch{}
  if(!u||(u.protocol!=="https:"&&u.protocol!=="http:")) throw new Error("Paste a valid website link first");
  if(isDirectMedia(u.href)) throw new Error("That is a direct media file, not a website. Use “Play a link now” for one-off files.");
  if(/\{(tmdb|imdb|id|season|episode|type)\}/.test(u.href)) throw new Error("That is an explicit URL template — use “Add template source” instead.");
  const id="site:"+u.hostname.toLowerCase();
  const force=!!(manual||opts.force);
  if(!force&&settings.providerTombstones&&settings.providerTombstones[id]) throw new Error("This website was removed and will not be re-added by the crawler");
  const existingSite=(settings.sites||[]).find(site=>site.id===id);
  const existingProvider=getProvider(id);
  const profile=await resolverCall({mode:"profile",url:u.href});
  const name=String(preferredName||existingSite&&existingSite.name||prettyHostName(u.hostname)).trim().slice(0,40)||prettyHostName(u.hostname);
  settings.sites=(settings.sites||[]).filter(site=>site.id!==id);
  const enabled=force?true:(existingSite?existingSite.enabled!==false:(existingProvider?existingProvider.enabled!==false:true));
  const site={id,name,base:profile.origin||u.origin,home:profile.url||u.href,enabled,lookup:"dynamic",searchTemplate:profile.searchTemplate||"",addedAt:(existingSite&&existingSite.addedAt)||Date.now()};
  settings.sites.push(site);
  if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(settings,"siteCatalogues")) delete settings.siteCatalogues;
  upsertProvider(identifyWebsiteProvider(site,profile,manual?"manual website":"continuous crawler"),{force});
  saveSettings();
  dlog("Website server identified and added: "+name+" ("+u.hostname+") — lookup only, no titles or covers imported");
  if(manual) toast(name+" identified and added as a lookup server","success");
  return profile;
}
function canonicalCatalogueTitle(ctx){
  return String((ctx&&ctx.title)||"").replace(/\s*\(source test\)\s*$/i,"").trim();
}
const siteLookupCache=new Map();
async function findOnWebsite(source, ctx){
  const site=(settings.sites||[]).find(x=>x.id===source.id)||source;
  const identity=(ctx&&ctx.identity&&ctx.identity.version)?ctx.identity:buildTitleIdentity(ctx||{});
  const title=identity.title||canonicalCatalogueTitle(ctx);
  if(!title) throw new Error((source.name||"Website")+" lookup needs the catalogue title");
  const key=[source.id,identity.fingerprint,identity.type,identity.season||1,identity.episode||1].join(":");
  const cached=siteLookupCache.get(key);
  if(cached&&Date.now()-cached.t<(cached.data.matched?900000:300000)) return cached.data;
  const data=await resolverCall({
    mode:"find",
    url:site.home||site.base||source.home||source.base,
    q:title,
    alt:(identity.titles||[]).slice(1).filter(Boolean).join("|"),
    type:identity.type||ctx.type||"movie",
    year:identity.year||ctx.year||"",
    season:identity.season||ctx.season||1,
    episode:identity.episode||ctx.episode||1,
    imdb:identity.imdbId||ctx.imdb||"",
    tmdb:identity.tmdbId||ctx.id||"",
    searchTemplate:site.searchTemplate||source.searchTemplate||""
  });
  const serverIdentity=data.identity||data.match||null;
  const localVerdict=identifyTitleCandidate({
    title:(data.match&&data.match.title)||data.watchTitle||data.title||"",
    url:data.playUrl||data.watchUrl||data.matchedUrl||"",
    imdbId:(serverIdentity&&serverIdentity.candidateIds&&serverIdentity.candidateIds.imdbId)||"",
    tmdbId:(serverIdentity&&serverIdentity.candidateIds&&serverIdentity.candidateIds.tmdbId)||null
  },identity,{threshold:80});
  const serverAccepted=!!(serverIdentity&&Number(serverIdentity.score)>=80&&serverIdentity.hardReject!==true);
  data.identity=Object.assign({},localVerdict,{
    accepted:!localVerdict.hardReject&&(serverAccepted||localVerdict.accepted),
    score:Math.max(Number(localVerdict.score)||0,serverAccepted?Number(serverIdentity.score)||0:0),
    server:serverIdentity
  });
  data.matched=!!(data.matched&&data.identity.accepted);
  if(data.matched){
    const provider=getProvider(source.id);
    if(provider){ provider.lastCheckedAt=Date.now(); provider.lastError=""; provider.lastIdentityMatch={fingerprint:identity.fingerprint,score:data.identity.score,at:Date.now()}; saveSettings(); }
  }
  siteLookupCache.set(key,{t:Date.now(),data});
  return data;
}
async function checkWebsiteAvailability(source, ctx){
  try{ return await findOnWebsite(source,ctx); }
  catch(e){ return {matched:false,error:e.message||String(e)}; }
}
async function resolveSiteURL(source, ctx){
  const found=await findOnWebsite(source,ctx);
  if(!found.matched||!found.playUrl) throw new Error("“"+canonicalCatalogueTitle(ctx)+"” was not identity-verified on "+source.name);
  return found.playUrl;
}
async function addWebsiteSourceFlow(){
  const raw=($("#pasteLink").value||"").trim();
  const note=(msg,type)=>{ const n=$("#detectNote"); if(n){ n.textContent=msg; n.className="status-box "+type; } };
  if(!raw){ note("Paste a website homepage or title-page link first.","error"); return; }
  const btn=$("#btnAddWebsite");
  if(btn){ btn.disabled=true; btn.innerHTML='<span class="spinner"></span> Checking website lookup…'; }
  note("Checking how this website searches — no covers or titles will be imported.","info");
  try{
    await registerWebsiteSource(raw,true,($("#srcName").value||"").trim());
    note("Website added as a lookup source. Pick any existing catalogue title and ZeroPlay will check this site at play time.","success");
    renderSources(true);
  }catch(e){
    note(""+(e.message||e),"error");
    if(btn){ btn.disabled=false; btn.textContent="Add website lookup"; }
  }
}

/* ---- Title-specific servers modal: only matched servers/routes are listed ---- */
let streamsCtx=null;
function closeStreams(){
  if(streamsCtx&&streamsCtx._searchAbort) streamsCtx._searchAbort.abort();
  $("#streamsRoot").innerHTML=""; streamsCtx=null;
  if(!playerState&&!detailState) document.body.classList.remove("locked");
  if(document.body.classList.contains("tv-mode")) setTimeout(()=>{ const target=document.getElementById("btnPlayerServers")||document.getElementById("btnStreams"); if(target) target.focus({preventScroll:true}); },30);
}
function serverOptionHTML(option){
  const variants=sortVariantsForQuality(option.variants||[],settings.stream.quality);
  const qualityChoices=variantQualityOptions(variants);
  const best=variants[0]||option.activeVariant||null;
  const verified=!!option.verified;
  const badge=verified?'<span class="chip rd">Has this title'+(option.identityScore?(" · "+Math.round(option.identityScore)+"%"):"")+'</span> ':(option.kind==="route"?'<span class="chip violet">Exact ID route</span> ':'<span class="chip">Direct route</span> ');
  const qualitySelect=variants.length?'<select class="server-quality-select" data-server-quality="'+esc(option.id)+'" aria-label="Quality for '+esc(option.name)+'"><option value="auto">Auto quality</option>'+qualityChoices.map(q=>'<option value="'+esc(q.value)+'"'+(settings.stream.quality===q.value?" selected":"")+">"+esc(q.label)+"</option>").join("")+"</select>":"";
  const variantMeta=variants.length?'<div class="variant-chips">'+qualityChoices.slice(0,5).map(q=>'<span>'+esc(q.label)+'</span>').join("")+(best&&best.bytes?'<span>'+fmtBytes(best.bytes)+'</span>':"")+(best&&best.seeders!=null?'<span>👤 '+best.seeders+'</span>':"")+(best&&best.notWebReady?'<span>may not play in browser</span>':"")+"</div>":"";
  return '<div class="src-row server-option"><div class="grow"><span class="nm">'+esc(option.name)+'</span> '+badge+(option.sourceId==="embedwave"?'<span class="chip">LAST RESORT</span> ':"")+(option.sourceId?healthBadge(option.sourceId):"")
    +'<code>'+esc(best?(best.label+(best.sub?(" — "+best.sub):"")):(option.evidence||""))+'</code>'+variantMeta
    +(option.evidence&&best?'<div class="help-text">'+esc(option.evidence)+'</div>':"")
    +'</div><div class="src-actions">'+qualitySelect+'<button class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" data-server-option="'+esc(option.id)+'">▶ Play</button>'+(downloadsEnabled()&&option.kind==="direct"&&variants.some(v=>directMediaKind(v.url)!=="dash")?'<button class="btn btn-secondary btn-xs" type="button" data-server-download="'+esc(option.id)+'">⬇ Download</button>':"")+'</div></div>';
}
function serverFinderProgressHTML(stats){
  stats=stats||{};
  const status=String(stats.serverFinderStatus||"queued"),total=Math.max(1,Number(stats.serverFinderSourcesTotal)||3);
  const complete=Math.min(total,Number(stats.serverFinderSourcesComplete)||0),count=Number(stats.serverFinderCandidates)||0;
  const active=status==="running";
  const headline=status==="running"?"Searching discovery sources":status==="complete"?"Server discovery complete":status==="cached"?"Using recent candidate cache":status==="fallback"?"Browser-only fallback active":status==="cancelled"?"Server discovery cancelled":"Server discovery queued";
  const detail=status==="running"?"Three bounded sources · worker pool · candidate registry capped at 1,000":status==="complete"?count+" stream-capable candidates found · title verification still required":status==="cached"?count+" saved candidates available · continuing exact-title scan":status==="fallback"?"Server API unavailable · existing browser crawlers continue independently":status==="cancelled"?"The title search was cancelled":"Local sidecar or hosted API will discover public server manifests";
  const progress=active?'<progress max="'+total+'" value="'+complete+'" aria-label="'+esc(complete+" of "+total+" crawler sources finished")+'"></progress>':"";
  const sourceNames={"stremio-addons":"Stremio Addons","catalog-graph":"Catalog graph",github:"GitHub"};
  const sources=(stats.serverFinderSourceStatus||[]).map(source=>'<span class="discovery-source-status '+esc(source.status||"queued")+'">'+esc(sourceNames[source.id]||source.id)+' · '+(source.status==="failed"?"unavailable":source.status==="partial"?"partial · "+Number(source.candidates||0)+" candidates":Number(source.candidates||0)+" candidates")+'</span>').join("");
  return '<div class="server-finder-progress" role="status" aria-live="polite"><div class="server-finder-progress-head"><strong>'+esc(headline)+'</strong><span>'+esc(active?complete+"/"+total+" sources":(stats.serverFinderMode||"server finder"))+'</span></div>'+progress+'<div class="help-text">'+esc(stats.serverFinderError||detail)+'</div>'+(sources?'<div class="discovery-source-statuses">'+sources+'</div>':"")+'</div>';
}
function renderTitleServerOptions(){

  const direct=options.filter(o=>o.kind==="direct");

  const configuredSites=allSources(true).filter(source=>source.kind==="site");
  const enabledSiteCount=allSources().filter(source=>source.kind==="site").length;
  const routes=options.filter(o=>o.kind==="route");
  const searching=!c._searchDone;
  const empty=(title,body)=>searching?'<div class="server-skeleton"><span class="spinner"></span> Checking servers for this exact title…</div>':'<div class="empty"><h3>'+esc(title)+'</h3><p>'+esc(body)+'</p></div>';
  const directBox=document.getElementById("serverDirect");

  const siteBox=document.getElementById("serverWebsites");

Direct provider and exact-ID server searches run separately."):empty(configuredSites.length?"Website lookup is disabled":"No website lookup sources added",configuredSites.length?"Enable a website lookup source in More to check it. Direct provider and exact-ID server searches are separate.":"This optional section checks websites you add. Direct provider and exact-ID server searches are separate and continue independently.");
  const routeBox=document.getElementById("serverRoutes");
