```javascript
    out = out.replace(/([?&](?:ep|episode|episode_id)=)\d+/i, '$1' + ep);
    out = out.replace(/(\/(?:ep|episode)[-_/])(\d+)(\/?(?:[?#].*)?)$/i, '$1' + ep + '$3');
    out = out.replace(/(-ep(?:isode)?-)(\d+)(\/?(?:[?#].*)?)$/i, '$1' + ep + '$3');
  }
  if (se != null && ep != null) {
    out = out.replace(/(\/season[-_/])(\d+)(\/episode[-_/])(\d+)/i, '$1' + se + '$3' + ep);
    out = out.replace(/(\/)(\d{1,3})\/(\d{1,4})(\/?(?:[?#].*)?)$/i, (m, slash, oldSeason, oldEpisode, tail) => {
      return /\/(tv|series|show|anime)\//i.test(out) ? slash + se + '/' + ep + tail : m;
    });
  }
  return out;
}

function episodeCandidateUrls(url, episode) {
  if (episode == null) return [];
  try {
    const u = new URL(url);
    if (/(?:\/(?:ep|episode)[-_/]\d+|-ep(?:isode)?-\d+|[?&](?:ep|episode|episode_id)=\d+)/i.test(u.href)) return [];
    const path = u.pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '');
    if (!path || path === '/') return [];
    return [u.origin + path + '/ep-' + episode, u.origin + path + '/episode-' + episode];
  } catch { return []; }
}

function findEpisodeUrl(html, base, season, episode) {
  if (episode == null) return '';
  const stripEpisode = value => {
    try {
      const u = new URL(value);
      return u.origin + u.pathname
        .replace(/\/(?:ep|episode)[-_/]\d+(?:\/|$)/i, '/')
        .replace(/-ep(?:isode)?-\d+(?:\/|$)/i, '/')
        .replace(/\/$/, '');
    } catch { return ''; }
  };
  const baseKey = stripEpisode(base);
  let best = '', bestScore = -1;
  for (const m of String(html || '').matchAll(/<a\s[^>]*href\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"[^>]*>([\s\S]{0,500}?)<\/a>/gi)) {
    const url = abs(decodeEntities(m[1] || ''), base);
    if (!url || !guardUrl(url) || !sameSite(url, base)) continue;
    const openTag = m[0].slice(0, m[0].indexOf('>') + 1);
    const text = normalizeTitle(attr(openTag, 'title') || stripTags(m[2] || ''));
    const epMatches = [
      new RegExp('/(?:ep|episode)[-_/]' + episode + '(?:[/?#]|$)', 'i'),
      new RegExp('-ep(?:isode)?-' + episode + '(?:[/?#]|$)', 'i'),
      new RegExp('[?&](?:ep|episode|episode_id)=' + episode + '(?:[&#]|$)', 'i'),
    ].some(re => re.test(url));
    const textMatches = text === String(episode) || text === 'episode ' + episode || text === 'ep ' + episode;
    if (!epMatches && !textMatches) continue;
    let score = epMatches ? 60 : 40;
    if (baseKey && stripEpisode(url) === baseKey) score += 25;
    const seasonInUrl = explicitSeason(url);
    if (seasonInUrl != null) score += seasonInUrl === Number(season || 1) ? 20 : -50;
    if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = url; }
  }
  return bestScore >= 40 ? best : '';
}
function cleanVariants(query) {
  const values = [query.title, ...(Array.isArray(query.alternatives) ? query.alternatives : []), query.alt].flatMap(v => String(v || '').split('|'));
  const seen = new Set(), out = [];
  for (const v of values) {
    const clean = String(v || '').replace(/\s*\(source test\)\s*$/i, '').trim().slice(0, 140);
    const key = normalizeTitle(clean);
    if (clean && key && !seen.has(key)) { seen.add(key); out.push(clean); }
  }
  return out.slice(0, 12);
}

async function resolveMatchedWatch(matchUrl, query) {
  const isTv = query.type === 'tv' || query.type === 'series';
  const adjusted = isTv ? adjustEpisodeInUrl(matchUrl, query.season || 1, query.episode || 1) : matchUrl;
  const attempts = [...new Set([adjusted, matchUrl].filter(Boolean))];
  let last = null;

  for (const candidateUrl of attempts) {
    const safe = guardUrl(candidateUrl);
    if (!safe) continue;
    try {
      const doc = await fetchDocument(safe.href, false, 8000);
      let watch = parseWatch(doc.text, doc.finalUrl);
      let watchUrl = doc.finalUrl;
      let resolvedEpisode = false;
      if (isTv && !watch.embed && !watch.direct.length) {
        let episodeUrl = findEpisodeUrl(doc.text, doc.finalUrl, query.season || 1, query.episode || 1);
        if (episodeUrl) resolvedEpisode = true;
        if (episodeUrl && episodeUrl !== doc.finalUrl) {
          const epDoc = await fetchDocument(episodeUrl, false, 8000);
          watch = parseWatch(epDoc.text, epDoc.finalUrl);
          watchUrl = episodeUrl;
        } else if (!episodeUrl) {
          for (const inferredUrl of episodeCandidateUrls(doc.finalUrl, query.episode || 1)) {
            try {
              const epDoc = await fetchDocument(inferredUrl, false, 7000);
              const epPattern = new RegExp('(?:/(?:ep|episode)[-_/]' + (query.episode || 1) + '(?:[/?#]|$)|-ep(?:isode)?-' + (query.episode || 1) + '(?:[/?#]|$))', 'i');
              const looksLikeEpisode = epPattern.test(epDoc.finalUrl) || !!findEpisodeUrl(epDoc.text, epDoc.finalUrl, query.season || 1, query.episode || 1);
              if (!looksLikeEpisode) continue;
              watch = parseWatch(epDoc.text, epDoc.finalUrl);
              watchUrl = epPattern.test(epDoc.finalUrl) ? epDoc.finalUrl : inferredUrl;
              episodeUrl = watchUrl;
              resolvedEpisode = true;
              break;
            } catch {}
          }
        }
      }
      last = { watch, watchUrl };
      if (watch.direct.length || watch.embed) return last;
      if (resolvedEpisode) return last;
      if (isTv && candidateUrl === adjusted && adjusted !== matchUrl) return last;
    } catch {}
  }
  return last || { watch: { embed: '', embeds: [], direct: [], servers: [], embedHosts: [] }, watchUrl: adjusted || matchUrl };
}

async function findTitleOnSite(rawSiteUrl, rawQuery) {
  const site = guardUrl(rawSiteUrl);
  if (!site) throw new Error('Invalid or blocked site URL');
  const query = {
    title: String(rawQuery.title || rawQuery.q || '').trim(),
    alternatives: rawQuery.alternatives || [],
    alt: rawQuery.alt || '',
    type: rawQuery.type || 'movie',
    year: rawQuery.year || '',
    season: Number(rawQuery.season || 1) || 1,
    episode: Number(rawQuery.episode || 1) || 1,
    imdb: String(rawQuery.imdb || '').toLowerCase(),
    tmdb: Number(rawQuery.tmdb || rawQuery.tmdbId || 0) || null,
  };
  const variants = cleanVariants(query);
  if (!variants.length) throw new Error('A catalogue title is required');

  let homeDoc = null;
  try { homeDoc = await fetchDocument(site.href, false, 7000); } catch {}
  const templates = [];
  if (rawQuery.searchTemplate) addTemplate(templates, rawQuery.searchTemplate, site.href);
  if (homeDoc) for (const t of searchTemplatesFromHtml(homeDoc.text, homeDoc.finalUrl)) addTemplate(templates, t, site.href);
  for (const t of commonSearchTemplates(site.href)) addTemplate(templates, t, site.href);

  let best = null;
  let checked = 0;
  const consider = (candidates, strategy) => {
    for (const candidate of candidates || []) {
      if (!guardUrl(candidate.url) || !sameSite(candidate.url, site.href)) continue;
      const identity = identifyTitleCandidate(candidate, variants, query);
      const score = identity.score;
      checked++;
      const epPattern = /(?:\/(?:ep|episode)[-_/]\d+|-ep(?:isode)?-\d+|[?&](?:ep|episode|episode_id)=\d+)/i;
      const episodeTie = best && score === best.score && (query.type === 'tv' || query.type === 'series') && epPattern.test(candidate.url) && !epPattern.test(best.url);
      if (!best || score > best.score || episodeTie) best = { score, url: candidate.url, strategy, title: candidate.title || candidate.slugTitle || '', identity };
    }
  };

  if (homeDoc) {
    consider(parseResultLinks(homeDoc.text, homeDoc.finalUrl), 'site-home');
    const homeTitle = pageTitle(homeDoc.text).replace(/\s+[-|–—].*$/, '');
    consider([{ title: homeTitle, slugTitle: candidateSlugTitle(homeDoc.finalUrl), url: homeDoc.finalUrl }], 'pasted-page');
  }

  let searchFetches = 0;
  outer:
  for (let vi = 0; vi < variants.length; vi++) {
    if (best && best.score >= 95) break;
    if (vi > 0 && best && best.score >= 80) break;
    for (const template of templates.slice(0, 8)) {
      if (searchFetches >= 10) break outer;
      const searchUrl = guardUrl(buildSearchUrl(template, variants[vi]));
      if (!searchUrl || !sameSite(searchUrl.href, site.href)) continue;
      searchFetches++;
      try {
        const doc = await fetchDocument(searchUrl.href, false, 6000);
        consider(parseResultLinks(doc.text, doc.finalUrl), 'site-search');
        const finalTitle = pageTitle(doc.text).replace(/\s+[-|–—].*$/, '');
        if (!BLOCKED_PATH.test(new URL(doc.finalUrl).pathname)) {
          consider([{ title: finalTitle, slugTitle: candidateSlugTitle(doc.finalUrl), url: doc.finalUrl }], 'search-redirect');
        }
        if (best && best.score >= 98) break outer;
      } catch {}
    }
  }

  if (!best || best.score < 80) {
    return { ok: true, mode: 'find', matched: false, checked, searchFetches, bestScore: best ? best.score : 0, identity: best ? best.identity : null, bestTitle: best ? best.title : '' };
  }

  const resolved = await resolveMatchedWatch(best.url, query);
  const watch = resolved.watch;
  const playUrl = (watch.direct && watch.direct[0]) || watch.embed || resolved.watchUrl;
  return {
    ok: true,
    mode: 'find',
    matched: true,
    checked,
    searchFetches,
    match: { score: best.score, strategy: best.strategy, title: best.title || '' },
    identity: best.identity || null,
    matchedUrl: best.url,
    watchUrl: resolved.watchUrl,
    watchTitle: watch.title || '',
    playUrl,
    embed: watch.embed || '',
    embeds: watch.embeds || [],
    direct: watch.direct || [],
    servers: watch.servers || [],
    embedHosts: watch.embedHosts || [],
    pageFallback: !watch.embed && !(watch.direct && watch.direct.length),
  };
}

async function handle(mode, rawUrl, query) {
  query = query || {};
  const u = guardUrl(rawUrl);
  if (!u) return { status: 400, body: { ok: false, error: 'Invalid or blocked URL' } };
  try {
    if (mode === 'json') {
      const text = await fetchText(u.href, true, 10000);
      let data; try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { return { status: 502, body: { ok: false, error: 'Remote did not return JSON' } }; }
      return { status: 200, body: data, raw: true };
    }
    if (mode === 'profile') return { status: 200, body: await profileSite(u.href) };
    if (mode === 'find') {
      const body = await findTitleOnSite(u.href, {
        title: query.q || query.title || '',
        alt: query.alt || '',
        type: query.type || 'movie',
        year: query.year || '',
        season: query.season || 1,
        episode: query.episode || 1,
        imdb: query.imdb || '',
        tmdb: query.tmdb || '',
        searchTemplate: query.searchTemplate || '',
      });
      return { status: 200, body };
    }
    const doc = await fetchDocument(u.href, false, 10000);
    if (mode === 'text') {
      if (!isM3uText(doc.text)) return { status: 415, body: { ok: false, error: 'Remote did not return an M3U/M3U8 playlist' } };
      if (doc.truncated) return { status: 413, body: { ok: false, error: 'Remote playlist is larger than the resolver safety limit' } };
      return { status: 200, body: { ok: true, mode: 'text', url: doc.finalUrl, text: doc.text } };
    }
    if (mode === 'm3u') {
      return { status: 200, body: { ok: true, mode: 'm3u', url: doc.finalUrl, truncated: !!doc.truncated, ...extractM3u(doc.text, doc.finalUrl) } };
    }
    return { status: 200, body: { ok: true, mode: 'watch', url: doc.finalUrl, truncated: !!doc.truncated, ...parseWatch(doc.text, doc.finalUrl) } };
  } catch (e) {
    return { status: 502, body: { ok: false, error: 'Site lookup failed: ' + (e && e.message || e) } };
  }
}

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  const H = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', 'Cache-Control': 'no-store' };
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'GET') return { statusCode: 405, headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: 'Method not allowed' }) };
  const q = event.queryStringParameters || {};
  const mode = String(q.mode || 'profile');
  if (!['profile', 'find', 'watch', 'json', 'text', 'm3u'].includes(mode)) return { statusCode: 400, headers: H, body: JSON.stringify({ ok: false, error: 'Unknown mode' }) };
  const out = await handle(mode, String(q.url || ''), q);
  return { statusCode: out.status, headers: H, body: JSON.stringify(out.body) };
};
exports._parse = { parseWatch, extractM3u, isM3uText, parseResultLinks, guardUrl, serverNames, normalizeTitle, titleScore, identifyTitleCandidate, explicitEpisodeInfo, extractCandidateIds, searchTemplatesFromHtml, commonSearchTemplates, buildSearchUrl, adjustEpisodeInUrl, findEpisodeUrl, episodeCandidateUrls };
exports._find = { profileSite, findTitleOnSite, handle };
```

```javascript
'use strict';

const api = require('../../api/find');

exports.handler = async event => {
  let body = null;
  if (event.body) {
    try { body = JSON.parse(event.body); } catch { body = event.body; }
  }
  const req = {
    method: event.httpMethod,
    query: event.queryStringParameters || {},
    body,
    headers: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(event.headers || {}).map(([key, value]) => [key.toLowerCase(), value])),
    socket: { remoteAddress: event.headers && (event.headers['x-nf-client-connection-ip'] || event.headers['x-forwarded-for']) || 'unknown' },
  };
  let statusCode = 200;
  const headers = {};
  let responseBody = '';
  const res = {
    setHeader(name, value) { headers[name] = value; },
    status(code) { statusCode = code; return this; },
    json(value) { responseBody = JSON.stringify(value); return value; },
  };
  await api(req, res);
  return { statusCode, headers, body: responseBody };
};
```

## `tv/zeroplay-debrid/netlify/functions/tmdb.js`

```javascript
/* ZeroPlay RD — TMDB catalog proxy (Netlify Function)
 * Ported from ZeroPlay web/functions/tmdb.js + web/lib/catalog.cjs,
 * inlined so this folder is fully self-contained.
 * Set ONE env var in Netlify:  TMDB_API_KEY (v3 key)  or  TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN (v4 bearer).
 * Only allowlisted TMDB routes/params are forwarded — this is not an open proxy.
 */
'use strict';

function endpoint(path) {
  return typeof path === 'string' && (
    /^\/(trending\/all\/(day|week)|movie\/(popular|top_rated|now_playing|upcoming)|tv\/(popular|airing_today|on_the_air)|search\/(multi|person)|watch\/providers\/(movie|tv)|discover\/(movie|tv))$/.test(path) ||
    /^\/(movie|tv)\/[1-9]\d{0,9}(\/season\/\d{1,4})?$/.test(path) ||
    /^\/person\/[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(path) ||
    /^\/collection\/[1-9]\d{0,9}$/.test(path)
  );
}

const SORTS = new Set([
  'popularity.desc', 'vote_average.desc', 'vote_count.desc',
  'primary_release_date.desc', 'primary_release_date.asc',
  'first_air_date.desc', 'first_air_date.asc',
  'revenue.desc', 'title.asc', 'name.asc',
]);

function query(params) {
  if (!params || !endpoint(params.path)) throw Error('Unsupported catalog route');
  const allowed = new Set(['query', 'page', 'append_to_response', 'include_image_language', 'watch_region',
    'with_watch_providers', 'with_watch_monetization_types', 'sort_by', 'with_genres', 'with_original_language',
    'primary_release_date.gte', 'primary_release_date.lte', 'first_air_date.gte', 'first_air_date.lte',
    'vote_average.gte', 'vote_count.gte', 'with_runtime.lte', 'with_origin_country']);
  const out = new URLSearchParams({ include_adult: 'false' });
  for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(params)) {
    if (name === 'path') continue;
    if (!allowed.has(name) || typeof value !== 'string' || value.length > 200) throw Error('Unsupported parameter');
    if (name === 'page' && (!/^[1-9]\d{0,2}$/.test(value) || Number(value) > 500)) throw Error('Invalid page');
    if (name === 'append_to_response' && !['credits,videos,recommendations', 'credits,videos,recommendations,external_ids', 'external_ids', 'credits,videos,recommendations,images', 'videos', 'videos,images', 'images', 'combined_credits'].includes(value)) throw Error('Invalid details request');
    if (name === 'include_image_language' && !/^(?:[a-z]{2}|null)(?:,(?:[a-z]{2}|null)){0,4}$/.test(value)) throw Error('Invalid image language');
    if (name === 'watch_region' && !['PH', 'US', 'GB', 'CA', 'AU', 'IN', 'JP', 'ZA'].includes(value)) throw Error('Invalid region');
    if (name === 'with_watch_providers' && !/^[1-9]\d{0,7}$/.test(value)) throw Error('Invalid provider');
    if (name === 'with_watch_monetization_types' && value !== 'flatrate') throw Error('Invalid availability');
    if (name === 'sort_by' && !SORTS.has(value)) throw Error('Invalid sorting');
    if (name === 'with_genres' && !/^\d{1,8}$/.test(value)) throw Error('Invalid genre');
    if (name === 'with_original_language' && !/^[a-z]{2}$/.test(value)) throw Error('Invalid language');
    if (['primary_release_date.gte', 'primary_release_date.lte', 'first_air_date.gte', 'first_air_date.lte'].includes(name) && !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value)) throw Error('Invalid date filter');
    if (name === 'vote_average.gte' && (!/^\d(?:\.\d)?$/.test(value) || Number(value) > 10)) throw Error('Invalid rating');
    if (name === 'vote_count.gte' && !/^\d{1,7}$/.test(value)) throw Error('Invalid vote filter');
    if (name === 'with_runtime.lte' && (!/^\d{1,3}$/.test(value) || Number(value) > 600)) throw Error('Invalid runtime');
    if (name === 'with_origin_country' && !/^[A-Z]{2}$/.test(value)) throw Error('Invalid country');
    out.set(name, value);
  }
  return out;
}

const headers = { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff' };
const respond = (statusCode, body, extra = {}) => ({ statusCode, headers: { ...headers, ...extra }, body: JSON.stringify(body) });

exports.handler = async (event) => {
  if (event.httpMethod !== 'GET') return respond(405, { error: 'Method not allowed' }, { Allow: 'GET' });

  let params;
  try { params = query(event.queryStringParameters || {}); }
  catch { return respond(400, { error: 'Invalid catalog request' }); }

  const v3 = process.env.TMDB_API_KEY;
  const v4 = process.env.TMDB_ACCESS_TOKEN;
  if (!v3 && !v4) return respond(503, { error: 'The catalog is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.', code: 'TMDB_NOT_CONFIGURED' });

  const path = event.queryStringParameters.path;
  const url = new URL('https://api.themoviedb.org/3' + path);
  if (v3) params.set('api_key', v3);
  url.search = params.toString();

  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(15000),
      headers: { Accept: 'application/json', ...(v4 && !v3 ? { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + v4 } : {}) },
    });
    if (!response.ok) {
      return respond(response.status === 429 ? 429 : 502,
        { error: 'The catalog is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.' },
        response.status === 429 ? { 'Retry-After': '30' } : {});
    }
    const data = await response.json();
    return respond(200, data, {
      'Cache-Control': path === '/search/multi' ? 'private, max-age=60' : 'public, max-age=300, s-maxage=300',
    });
  } catch {
    return respond(502, { error: 'The catalog is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.' });
  }
};
```

## `tv/zeroplay-debrid/server.js`

```javascript
'use strict';

const http = require('node:http');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { URL } = require('node:url');
const { findCandidates, normalizeIdentity } = require('./lib/server-finder/core');
const findApi = require('./api/find');

const APP_ROOT = __dirname;
const MAX_BODY_BYTES = 16 * 1024;
const RATE_WINDOW_MS = 60 * 1000;
const RATE_LIMIT = 8;
const requestBuckets = new Map();
const API_HANDLERS = {
  '/api/extract': require('./api/extract'),
  '/api/tmdb': require('./api/tmdb'),
};

function jsonResponse(res, status, value, headers = {}) {
  res.writeHead(status, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=utf-8', 'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', ...headers });
  res.end(JSON.stringify(value));
}

function readBody(req) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    let size = 0;
    const chunks = [];
    req.on('data', chunk => {
      size += chunk.length;
      if (size > MAX_BODY_BYTES) { reject(new Error('Request body too large')); req.destroy(); return; }
      chunks.push(chunk);
    });
    req.on('end', () => {
      if (!chunks.length) return resolve(null);
      try { resolve(JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8'))); }
      catch { reject(new Error('Invalid JSON body')); }
    });
    req.on('error', reject);
  });
}

function sameOrigin(req) {
  const origin = req.headers.origin;
  if (!origin) return true;
  try { return new URL(origin).host.toLowerCase() === String(req.headers.host || '').toLowerCase(); }
  catch { return false; }
}

function allowRequest(req, now = Date.now()) {
  const key = String(req.socket && req.socket.remoteAddress || 'unknown');
  const bucket = requestBuckets.get(key);
  if (!bucket || now - bucket.start >= RATE_WINDOW_MS) {
    requestBuckets.set(key, { start: now, count: 1 });
    return true;
  }
  if (bucket.count >= RATE_LIMIT) return false;
  bucket.count++;
  return true;
}

function localApiResponse(res) {
  let statusCode = 200;
  const headers = {};
  return {
    setHeader(name, value) { headers[name] = value; },
    status(code) { statusCode = code; return this; },
    json(value) {
      if (!res.headersSent) res.writeHead(statusCode, headers);
      res.end(JSON.stringify(value));
      return value;
    },
  };
}

async function handleFind(req, res, url) {
  if (!['GET', 'POST'].includes(req.method)) {
    res.setHeader('Allow', 'GET, POST');
    return jsonResponse(res, 405, { ok: false, error: 'Method not allowed' });
  }
  if (!sameOrigin(req)) return jsonResponse(res, 403, { ok: false, error: 'Same-origin requests only' });
  if (!allowRequest(req)) return jsonResponse(res, 429, { ok: false, error: 'Server Finder is rate limited; please retry shortly.' }, { 'Retry-After': '60' });
  let body = null;
  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    try { body = await readBody(req); }
    catch (error) { return jsonResponse(res, error.message === 'Request body too large' ? 413 : 400, { ok: false, error: error.message }); }
  }
  const identityInput = req.method === 'GET' ? {
    title: url.searchParams.get('q') || url.searchParams.get('title'),
    titles: (url.searchParams.get('titles') || '').split('|'), type: url.searchParams.get('type'),
    year: url.searchParams.get('year'), season: url.searchParams.get('season'), episode: url.searchParams.get('episode'),
    imdbId: url.searchParams.get('imdbId'), tmdbId: url.searchParams.get('tmdbId'),
  } : body && (body.identity || body);
  let identity;
  try { identity = normalizeIdentity(identityInput); }
  catch (error) { return jsonResponse(res, 400, { ok: false, error: error.message || 'Invalid title identity' }); }
  const result = await findCandidates(identity, {
    limit: 24, maxPerSource: 8, timeoutMs: 4500, workerTimeoutMs: 30000,
    sourceConcurrency: 8, useWorkerThreads: true,
  });
  return jsonResponse(res, 200, result, { 'Cache-Control': 'private, max-age=20, stale-while-revalidate=30' });
}

async function handleApi(req, res, url, pathname) {
  if (pathname === '/api/health') return jsonResponse(res, 200, { ok: true, service: 'ZeroPlay Server Finder', mode: 'local-worker-threads', sources: 3, maxCandidatePool: 1000, workerThreads: true });
  if (pathname === '/api/find') return handleFind(req, res, url);
  const handler = API_HANDLERS[pathname];
  if (!handler) return jsonResponse(res, 404, { ok: false, error: 'Not found' });
  let body = null;
  if (req.method === 'POST') {
    try { body = await readBody(req); }
    catch (error) { return jsonResponse(res, 400, { ok: false, error: error.message }); }
  }
  const query = Object.fromEntries(url.searchParams.entries());
  const adaptedReq = Object.assign(req, { query, body });
  return handler(adaptedReq, localApiResponse(res));
}

function appHtml() {
  for (const file of [path.join(APP_ROOT, 'index.html'), path.join(APP_ROOT, 'dist/index.html')]) {
    try { return fs.readFileSync(file); } catch {}
  }
  return Buffer.from('ZeroPlay build is missing. Run npm run build first.');
}

function createLocalServer() {
  const html = appHtml();
  return http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
    let url;
    try { url = new URL(req.url || '/', 'http://' + (req.headers.host || 'localhost')); }
    catch { return jsonResponse(res, 400, { ok: false, error: 'Invalid request URL' }); }
    if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) {
      try { await handleApi(req, res, url, url.pathname); }
      catch { if (!res.headersSent) jsonResponse(res, 502, { ok: false, error: 'Server Finder request failed' }); else res.end(); }
      return;
    }
    if (req.method !== 'GET' && req.method !== 'HEAD') {
      res.writeHead(405, { Allow: 'GET, HEAD' });
      return res.end();
    }
    res.writeHead(200, {
      'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8', 'Content-Length': html.length,
      'X-Content-Type-Options': 'nosniff', 'Referrer-Policy': 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin',
      'Content-Security-Policy': "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' https: data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https:; frame-src https:; media-src https: blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'",
    });
    if (req.method === 'HEAD') return res.end();
    return res.end(html);
  });
}

if (require.main === module) {
  const port = Math.max(1, Math.min(65535, Number(process.env.PORT) || 8787));
  const host = process.env.HOST || '0.0.0.0';
  const server = createLocalServer();
  server.listen(port, host, () => console.log('ZeroPlay Server Finder listening on ' + host + ':' + port));
}

module.exports = { createLocalServer, handleFind, readBody, sameOrigin, allowRequest, MAX_BODY_BYTES, RATE_LIMIT };
```

## `tv/zeroplay-debrid/tests/accessibility-prefs.test.cjs`

```javascript
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");

const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, "..", "index.html"), "utf8");
const checks = [
  ["dark is the default theme", html.includes('theme:"dark"')],
  ["theme choices include OLED and warm", ["oled", "warm", "light"].every(value => html.includes(`value="${value}"`))],
  ["text scaling offers standard, large, and extra large", ["normal", "large", "xl"].every(value => html.includes(`value="${value}"`))],
  ["high contrast preference is exposed accessibly", html.includes('id="uiHighContrast" data-ui-preference="highContrast"')],
  ["theme and text scale classes are applied", ["theme-oled", "theme-warm", "font-large", "font-xl"].every(name => html.includes(`classList.toggle(\"${name}\"`))],
  ["preference changes persist and reapply the interface", html.includes('closest("[data-ui-preference]")') && html.includes("saveSettings(); applyInterfaceSettings();")],
  ["unrecognized themes and text scales fall back safely", html.includes('["dark","oled","warm","light"].includes(ui.theme)') && html.includes('["normal","large","xl"].includes(ui.textScale)')],
  ["display preference theme styles are present", ["body.theme-oled", "body.theme-warm", "body.high-contrast"].every(name => html.includes(name))],
];

for (const [name, passed] of checks) {
  assert.ok(passed, `FAIL ${name}`);
  console.log(`PASS ${name}`);
}
console.log(`\n${checks.length} accessibility/display preference checks passed`);
```

```javascript
    [html.includes('playerState.embedFocused=true') && html.includes('if(playerState.embedFocused){ playerState.embedFocused=false;'), 'embedded players get a real D-pad focus mode and Back returns to the ZeroPlay bar first'],
    [html.includes('if(e.key===\"Escape\")') && html.includes('if(handleZeroPlayTvBack()){ e.preventDefault(); return; }'), 'browser Escape mirrors native Android TV Back routing'],
    [html.includes('autoHighLevelId') && html.includes('autoHighBufferingSince'), 'FastStream auto quality starts at the highest level and steps down only on sustained buffering'],
    [html.includes('body.android-tv .settings-hub-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}') && html.includes('body.android-tv .modal{width:min(980px,94vw)') && html.includes('#btnPlayerDownload'), 'TV layout keeps settings on-screen and hides tool clutter from the player bar'],
    [html.includes('body.android-tv *{backdrop-filter:none!important;') && html.includes('animation-duration:.12s!important'), 'TV mode strips backdrop blur and caps animation cost for 2 GB boxes'],
    [html.includes('id=\"btnPlayerFastStream\"') && html.includes('id=\"btnPlayerM3u\"') && html.includes('id=\"btnHidePlayerChrome\"'), 'FastStream, M3U, and hide actions stay in the single player bar'],
    [!html.includes('player-action-shelf') && html.includes('player-overlay.chrome-hidden .player-bar') && html.includes('player-overlay.chrome-hidden .player-controls'), 'no paused duplicate overlay remains; one chrome layer hides cleanly'],
    [html.includes('function openM3uExtractorForContext') && html.includes('location.hash=\"#/downloads\"'), 'M3U button opens the real extractor workflow with current stream context'],
    [html.includes('input,select,textarea{border-radius:14px}') && html.includes('setting-control,.setting-control input,.setting-control .slider{border-radius:999px}'), 'TV inputs and solid toggles use rounded controls'],
    [((html.match(/in:name,description,readme/g)||[]).length >= 50), 'GitHub discovery registry contains at least 50 focused tool searches'],
  ];
  for (const [condition, label] of staticChecks) ok(condition, label);

  console.log(`\n${passed} Android TV/UI/artwork checks passed`);
})().catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); });
```

```javascript
const fs=require('fs'),vm=require('vm'),assert=require('assert'),path=require('path');
```

```javascript
  ok(streams.identityRejected >= 1, 'wrong stream counted as identity rejection');

  ok(lolaCatalogUrls.some(url => url.includes('search=My%20Heart%20Beats%20for%20Lola%20Volc%C3%A1n')) && lolaCatalogUrls.some(url => url.includes('search=Mi%20coraz%C3%B3n%20insiste%20en%20Lola%20Volc%C3%A1n')), 'server searches both English and Spanish exact-title variants');
```

```javascript
    await sleep(20);
  }
  assert.fail('timed out waiting for ' + label);

  return b.buffer.slice(b.byteOffset, b.byteOffset + b.byteLength);
}
class FakeHeaders {

    this.map = new Map(Object.entries(init).map(([k, v]) => [String(k).toLowerCase(), String(v)]));
  }

}

  return {

    headers: new FakeHeaders(headers),
    body: {

      getReader() {
        let i = 0;

          async read() { return i < parts.length ? { done: false, value: parts[i++] } : { done: true, value: undefined }; },
          async cancel() { cancelled = true; },
        };

    },
    get cancelled() { return cancelled; },
    async arrayBuffer() { return bufferOf(all); },
    async text() { return dec.decode(all); },
  };
}

  return Object.assign({
    id: 'job-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 9),
    title: 'Test title', ctx: { type: 'movie', id: 1, title: 'Test title' },
    url: 'https://cdn.test/file.mp4', quality: '720p', serverName: 'Test server',
    status: 'paused', createdAt: Date.now(), updatedAt: Date.now(),
    downloadedBytes: 0, totalBytes: null, speedBps: 0, error: '', note: '',
    threads: 1, partSizes: {}, completedChunks: [], fileStored: false,
    chunksStored: true, retries: 0, filename: 'Test title.mp4', mime: 'video/mp4',
  }, overrides);
}

(async () => {
  /* ---------- settings clamps and shared switches ---------- */
  const st = context.streamCfg();
  eq([st.raceTimeoutSec, st.stallTimeoutSec, st.primeThreads, st.primeChunkKb, st.primeBudgetMb, st.bufferTargetSec],
    [60, 30, 4, 64, 8, 60], 'stream/FastStream numeric settings are clamped');
  const dl = context.downloadCfg();
  eq([dl.threads, dl.chunkMb, dl.concurrent], [8, .25, 3], 'download numeric settings are clamped');
  context.settings.downloads.threads = 2;
  context.settings.downloads.chunkMb = .25;
  context.settings.downloads.concurrent = 1;

  context.setFeatureToggle('trailers', false);
  ok(context.settings.stream.trailerPreviews === false && stopCardPreviewCalls === 1,
    'trailer switch persists off and stops the active preview');
  context.setFeatureToggle('preload', false);
  eq([context.settings.stream.preload, context.settings.stream.preloadLastMode], ['off', 'aggressive'],
    'preload switch remembers aggressive mode while off');
  context.setFeatureToggle('preload', true);
  eq(context.settings.stream.preload, 'aggressive', 'preload switch restores the previous non-off mode');
  context.setFeatureToggle('dnsWarm', true);
  await sleep(10);
  ok(warmAllSourcesCalls === 1, 'DNS warm-up switch calls the real source warmer');
  context.setFeatureToggle('discovery', true);
  context.setFeatureToggle('discovery', false);
  eq([discoveryStarts, discoveryStops], [1, 1], 'continuous-adding switch starts and stops the engine');
  ok(context.getFeatureToggle('embedwaveFailover') === false, 'Embedwave automatic failover is off by default');
  context.setFeatureToggle('embedwaveFailover', true);
  ok(context.getFeatureToggle('embedwaveFailover') === true, 'Embedwave failover has its own explicit switch');
  context.setFeatureToggle('embedwaveFailover', false);

  const switchHtml = context.featureSwitchHTML('multithreadedDownloads', 'Multithreaded downloads', 'Parallel where supported', 'test');
  ok(switchHtml.includes('data-feature-toggle="multithreadedDownloads"') && switchHtml.includes('checked'),
    'shared feature-switch markup reflects persisted state');
  const toggleKeys = [...new Set([...html.matchAll(/featureSwitchHTML\("([^"]+)"/g)].map(m => m[1]))];
  const requiredKeys = ['discovery', 'trailers', 'autoFailover', 'stallSwitch', 'embedwaveFailover', 'preload',
    'fastStreamProbe', 'nextEpisodeWarm', 'dnsWarm', 'sortByHealth', 'downloads', 'multithreadedDownloads',
    'm3uExtraction', 'downloadAutoSave', 'downloadAutoResume', 'refreshExpiredDownloads',
    'keepCompletedDownloads', 'autoplayNext', 'reduceMotion', 'compactCards', 'categoryStrip'];
  ok(requiredKeys.every(k => toggleKeys.includes(k)), 'menu/settings expose separate switches for every optional feature');

  /* ---------- client M3U parsing ---------- */
  const master = `#EXTM3U
#EXT-X-STREAM-INF:BANDWIDTH=2500000,RESOLUTION=1280x720,CODECS="avc1.64001f,mp4a.40.2"
720/index.m3u8
#EXT-X-STREAM-INF:BANDWIDTH=5000000,RESOLUTION=1920x1080
1080/index.m3u8
`;
  const media720 = `#EXTM3U
#EXT-X-VERSION:6
#EXT-X-TARGETDURATION:6
#EXT-X-MEDIA-SEQUENCE:40
#EXT-X-MAP:URI="init-1.mp4"
#EXTINF:6,
seg-40.m4s
#EXT-X-DISCONTINUITY
#EXT-X-MAP:URI="init-2.mp4"
#EXTINF:5.5,
seg-41.m4s
#EXT-X-ENDLIST
`;
  const parsedMaster = context.parseM3uPlaylist(master, 'https://cdn.test/master.m3u8');
  ok(parsedMaster.isMaster && parsedMaster.variants.length === 2, 'client identifies an M3U master playlist');
  eq(context.chooseM3uVariant(parsedMaster.variants, '720p').url, 'https://cdn.test/720/index.m3u8',
    'client chooses the requested M3U quality variant');
  const parsedMedia = context.parseM3uPlaylist(media720, 'https://cdn.test/720/index.m3u8');
  eq(parsedMedia.parts.map(p => p.url.split('/').pop()), ['init-1.mp4', 'seg-40.m4s', 'init-2.mp4', 'seg-41.m4s'],
    'multiple HLS init maps stay in playback/assembly order');
  eq(parsedMedia.segments.map(s => s.sequence), [40, 41], 'HLS media sequence is retained for AES IV derivation');

  const ranged = context.parseM3uPlaylist(`#EXTM3U
#EXTINF:4,
#EXT-X-BYTERANGE:3@2
all.bin
#EXTINF:4,
#EXT-X-BYTERANGE:2
all.bin
#EXT-X-ENDLIST
`, 'https://cdn.test/ranged.m3u8');
  eq(ranged.segments.map(s => [s.byterange.start, s.byterange.end]), [[2, 4], [5, 6]],
    'implicit HLS byte ranges continue after the previous range');

  context.fetch = async url => {
    if (String(url).endsWith('/master.m3u8')) return fakeResponse({ body: master, url: String(url) });
    if (String(url).endsWith('/720/index.m3u8')) return fakeResponse({ body: media720, url: String(url) });
    throw new Error('unexpected playlist fetch ' + url);
  };
  const plan = await context.resolveHlsPlan('https://cdn.test/master.m3u8', '720p');
  eq([plan.playlistUrl, plan.parts.length, Math.round(plan.duration)], ['https://cdn.test/720/index.m3u8', 4, 12],
    'master M3U resolves to the selected media playlist plan');

  const extracted = context.extractM3uUrls('links "https:\\/\\/cdn.test\\/a.m3u8?token=1\\u0026x=2" and /relative/b.m3u8', 'https://site.test/watch/1');
  eq(extracted, ['https://cdn.test/a.m3u8?token=1&x=2', 'https://site.test/relative/b.m3u8'],
    'M3U extractor unescapes and resolves playlist links');
  eq(context.m3uResultHTML({ url: 'https://zeroplay.test/', label: 'Pasted', localOnly: true }, 0).includes('data-m3u-action'), false,
    'pasted local-only playlist does not pretend the app URL is downloadable');

  /* ---------- AES-128 HLS segment decryption ---------- */
  const keyBytes = Buffer.from('00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff', 'hex');
  const iv = Buffer.alloc(16); iv.writeUInt32BE(7, 12);
  const cipher = createCipheriv('aes-128-cbc', keyBytes, iv);
  const encrypted = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(Buffer.from('secret segment')), cipher.final()]);
  context.fetch = async url => {
    assert(String(url).endsWith('/key.bin'));
    return fakeResponse({ body: keyBytes });
  };
  const decrypted = await context.decryptHlsSegment(manualJob(), {
    sequence: 7,
    key: { method: 'AES-128', uri: 'https://cdn.test/key.bin', iv: '' },
  }, bufferOf(encrypted), new AbortController().signal);
  eq(dec.decode(new Uint8Array(decrypted)), 'secret segment', 'AES-128 HLS segment decrypts with sequence-derived IV');

  /* ---------- multithreaded byte-range resume ---------- */
  const fileBytes = bytesOf('Hello world');
  const rangeJob = manualJob({ kind: 'file', totalBytes: fileBytes.length, chunkSize: 4, chunksTotal: 3 });
  await context.saveDownloadPart(rangeJob, 0, bufferOf(fileBytes.slice(0, 4)));
  const requestedRanges = [];
  context.fetch = async (url, opts) => {
    requestedRanges.push(opts.headers.Range);
    return rangeSliceResponse(fileBytes, opts.headers.Range);
  };
  context.settings.downloads.multithreaded = true;
  context.settings.downloads.threads = 2;
  eq(context.effectiveDownloadThreads(rangeJob), 2, 'existing jobs follow the current multithreaded thread setting');
  await context.runRangeDownload(rangeJob, new AbortController().signal);
  eq(requestedRanges.slice().sort(), ['bytes=4-7', 'bytes=8-10'], 'range resume downloads only missing chunks');
  eq(await (await context.assembleDownloadBlob(rangeJob)).text(), 'Hello world', 'stored range chunks assemble in order');

  const failedRangeJob = manualJob({ kind: 'file', totalBytes: fileBytes.length, chunkSize: 4, chunksTotal: 3 });
  context.fetch = async (url, opts) => {
    if (opts.headers.Range === 'bytes=4-7') return fakeResponse({ status: 404, body: 'missing' });
    return rangeSliceResponse(fileBytes, opts.headers.Range);
  };
  await assert.rejects(() => context.runRangeDownload(failedRangeJob, new AbortController().signal), /HTTP 404/);
  ok(context.completedDownloadSet(failedRangeJob).has(0) && context.completedDownloadSet(failedRangeJob).has(2)
    && !context.completedDownloadSet(failedRangeJob).has(1),
    'parallel range workers settle and preserve successful chunks after one failure');

  /* ---------- sequential stream resume and integrity ---------- */
  const streamJob = manualJob({ kind: 'stream', chunksTotal: 0 });
  await context.saveDownloadPart(streamJob, 0, bufferOf('Hello'));
  let streamRange = '';
  context.fetch = async (url, opts) => {
    streamRange = opts.headers.Range || '';
    return fakeResponse({
      status: 206,
      headers: { 'content-range': 'bytes 5-10/11', 'content-length': '6', 'content-type': 'video/mp4' },
      chunks: [' wor', 'ld'],
    });
  };
  await context.runStreamDownload(streamJob, new AbortController().signal);
  eq(streamRange, 'bytes=5-', 'sequential download resumes from stored bytes');
  eq(await (await context.assembleDownloadBlob(streamJob)).text(), 'Hello world', 'sequential resume assembles the complete file');

  const wrongOffsetJob = manualJob({ kind: 'stream', chunksTotal: 0 });
  await context.saveDownloadPart(wrongOffsetJob, 0, bufferOf('Hello'));
  context.fetch = async () => fakeResponse({
    status: 206,
    headers: { 'content-range': 'bytes 3-10/11', 'content-length': '8' },
    body: 'lo world',
  });
  await assert.rejects(() => context.runStreamDownload(wrongOffsetJob, new AbortController().signal), /different resume offset/);
  ok(true, 'sequential resume rejects a mismatched Content-Range instead of corrupting the file');

  const gapJob = manualJob({ kind: 'stream', chunksTotal: 0 });
  await context.saveDownloadPart(gapJob, 0, bufferOf('Hell'));
  await context.saveDownloadPart(gapJob, 2, bufferOf('ld'));
  let gapRange = 'not-called';
  context.fetch = async (url, opts) => {
    gapRange = opts.headers.Range || '';
    return fakeResponse({ status: 200, headers: { 'content-length': '11', 'content-type': 'video/mp4' }, body: 'Hello world' });
  };
  await context.runStreamDownload(gapJob, new AbortController().signal);
  ok(gapRange === '' && /not contiguous/.test(gapJob.note), 'non-contiguous sequential parts restart safely');
  eq(await (await context.assembleDownloadBlob(gapJob)).text(), 'Hello world', 'restarted sequential download is not spliced from gapped parts');

  /* ---------- HLS byte-range over-response slicing ---------- */
  const hlsBytesJob = manualJob({
    kind: 'hls', mime: 'video/mp2t', filename: 'segment.ts', chunksTotal: 1,
    segments: [{ url: 'https://cdn.test/all.bin', byterange: { start: 2, end: 4, length: 3 }, duration: 4, sequence: 0, key: null }],
  });
  context.fetch = async () => fakeResponse({ status: 200, body: '0123456' });
  await context.runHlsDownload(hlsBytesJob, new AbortController().signal);
  eq(await (await context.assembleDownloadBlob(hlsBytesJob)).text(), '234',
    'HLS byte-range HTTP 200 response is sliced before storage');

  /* ---------- hard cap while storing unknown-size parts ---------- */
  const oldCap = context.settings.stream.maxFileSizeGb;
  context.settings.stream.maxFileSizeGb = 0.00000001; // 10 bytes through the real capGb()/capBytes() path
  const capJob = manualJob({ kind: 'stream', chunksTotal: 0 });
  await context.saveDownloadPart(capJob, 0, bufferOf('12345678'));
  await assert.rejects(() => context.saveDownloadPart(capJob, 1, bufferOf('123')), /exceeds the .* GB cap/);
  ok(true, 'unknown-size downloads stop at the configured cap before storing more data');
  context.settings.stream.maxFileSizeGb = oldCap;

  /* ---------- create -> pause -> duplicate click resumes -> complete ---------- */
  const identity = context.buildTitleIdentity({ type: 'movie', id: 27205, title: 'Inception', year: '2010', imdb: 'tt1375666' });
  const dlCtx = {
    type: 'movie', id: 27205, title: 'Inception', year: '2010', season: 1, episode: 1,
    imdb: 'tt1375666', identity,
    item: { id: 27205, type: 'movie', title: 'Inception', poster_path: null, backdrop_path: null, year: '2010', rating: null, poster_url: null, backdrop_url: null, imdb_id: 'tt1375666', trailer_key: null, logo_url: null, genre_ids: [], overview: '' },
  };
  let hangDownload = true;
  let downloadStarted = false;
  context.fetch = (url, opts = {}) => {
    const range = (opts.headers || {}).Range || '';
    if (range === 'bytes=0-0') return Promise.resolve(rangeSliceResponse(fileBytes, range));
    if (hangDownload) {
      downloadStarted = true;
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const signal = opts.signal;
        if (!signal) return;
        signal.addEventListener('abort', () => {
          const e = new Error('aborted'); e.name = 'AbortError'; reject(e);
        }, { once: true });
      });
    }
    return Promise.resolve(rangeSliceResponse(fileBytes, range));
  };
  const created = await context.createDownloadJob({ url: 'https://cdn.test/inception.mp4', quality: '1080p', bytes: 11 }, dlCtx, 'Direct test');
  await waitFor(() => downloadStarted && created.status === 'running', 'created download to start');
  context.pauseDownload(created, true);
  await waitFor(() => created.status === 'paused', 'download to pause');
  hangDownload = false;
  const duplicate = await context.createDownloadJob({ url: 'https://cdn.test/inception.mp4', quality: '1080p', bytes: 11 }, dlCtx, 'Direct test');
  eq(duplicate.id, created.id, 'clicking Download again finds the existing exact-title job');
  await waitFor(() => created.status === 'complete', 'existing paused download to resume and complete');
  eq(await (await context.assembleDownloadBlob(created)).text(), 'Hello world', 'pause/resume lifecycle produces the complete file');

  const statsHtml = context.downloadStatsHTML(created);
  ok(statsHtml.includes('Parallel byte ranges') && statsHtml.includes('2 threads'),
    'partial download progress refresh keeps mode and thread stats');

  const deleteJob = manualJob({ kind: 'stream', status: 'paused' });
  context.downloadJobs?.set?.(deleteJob.id, deleteJob); // no-op if the VM lexical map is not exposed
  await context.saveDownloadPart(deleteJob, 0, bufferOf('data'));
  context.persistDownloadJob(deleteJob, true);
  await sleep(20);
  await context.deleteDownload(deleteJob, { silent: true });
  context.persistDownloadJob(deleteJob, true);
  await sleep(20);
  eq(await context.dlGet('jobs', deleteJob.id), null, 'deleted download cannot be resurrected by a late persist');

  /* ---------- server resolver M3U/text modes ---------- */
  const server = require(path.join(root, 'api/extract.js'));
  const netlifyServer = require(path.join(root, 'netlify/functions/extract.js'));
  const parsedPage = server._parse.extractM3u(
    '<html><head><title>Watch</title></head><script>var src="https:\\/\\/cdn.test\\/movie.m3u8?x=1\\u0026y=2";</script><video src="/local.m3u8"></video></html>',
    'https://site.test/watch/1');
  eq(parsedPage.playlists.map(p => p.url), ['https://site.test/local.m3u8', 'https://cdn.test/movie.m3u8?x=1&y=2'],
    'server M3U extraction finds relative and escaped playlist links');
  eq(netlifyServer._parse.isM3uText('#EXTM3U\n#EXTINF:1,\na.ts'), true, 'Netlify resolver twin contains the same M3U detector');

  const originalFetch = global.fetch;
  try {
    global.fetch = async url => {
      const u = String(url);
      if (u.endsWith('/master.m3u8')) return new Response(master, { status: 200, headers: { 'content-type': 'application/vnd.apple.mpegurl' } });
      if (u.endsWith('/watch')) return new Response('<html><script>var x="https://cdn.test/from-page.m3u8";</script></html>', { status: 200 });
      if (u.endsWith('/not-playlist')) return new Response('<html>no playlist</html>', { status: 200 });
      if (u.endsWith('/huge.m3u8')) return new Response('#EXTM3U\n' + 'x'.repeat(1600000), { status: 200 });
      return new Response('not found', { status: 404 });
    };
    const textOut = await server._find.handle('text', 'https://cdn.test/master.m3u8', {});
    ok(textOut.status === 200 && textOut.body.text.includes('#EXT-X-STREAM-INF'), 'server mode=text returns a validated M3U playlist');
    const m3uOut = await server._find.handle('m3u', 'https://site.test/watch', {});
    ok(m3uOut.status === 200 && m3uOut.body.playlists.some(p => p.url === 'https://cdn.test/from-page.m3u8'),
      'server mode=m3u extracts playlist links from a watch page');
    eq((await server._find.handle('text', 'https://site.test/not-playlist', {})).status, 415,
      'server mode=text rejects a non-M3U response');
    eq((await server._find.handle('text', 'https://cdn.test/huge.m3u8', {})).status, 413,
      'server mode=text refuses a playlist beyond the streamed safety cap');
    eq((await server._find.handle('m3u', 'http://127.0.0.1/admin', {})).status, 400,
      'server M3U modes keep private/loopback URLs blocked');
  } finally {
    global.fetch = originalFetch;
  }

  /* ---------- entry-point and route wiring ---------- */
  const statics = [
    [html.includes('data-ep-play="') && html.includes('data-ep-download="') && html.includes('e.stopPropagation()'),
      'each episode has separate Play and Download buttons'],
    [html.includes('id="btnDownloadTitle"') && html.includes('downloadTitleBtn.onclick'),
      'title/detail download button is wired to the exact selected episode'],
    [html.includes('id="btnPlayerDownload"') && html.includes('openDownloadForContext(playerContext(st)'),
      'player download button is wired'],
    [html.includes('data-server-download="') && html.includes('closest("[data-server-download]")'),
      'Servers modal download button is wired for verified direct options'],
    [html.includes('id="settingsAddWebsite"') && html.includes('id="discoveryPanel"') && html.includes('id="settingsFastStream"'),
      'Settings contains Add Website, continuous adding and FastStream configuration'],
    [html.includes('id="menuQuickSwitches"') && html.includes('function renderMenuQuickSwitches()'),
      'menu box contains quick feature switches'],
    [html.includes('.setting-control input{width:46px;height:24px') && html.includes('.setting-control input:focus-visible+.slider'),
      'feature switches keep a TV-focusable hit area and visible focus ring'],
    [html.includes('route==="settings"') && html.includes('route==="downloads"'),
      'Settings and Downloads routes are wired'],
    [html.includes('String(job.id).replace(/["\\\\]/g,"\\\\$&")'),
      'download-row selector does not depend on CSS.escape on older TV browsers'],
    [html.includes('activeVariant:{url:activeDownloadObjectUrl,quality:job.quality,bytes:blob.size}'),
      'downloaded-file playback uses the local object URL as its active variant'],
  ];
  for (const [cond, label] of statics) ok(cond, label);

  const vercel = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'vercel.json'), 'utf8'));
  const rewriteSources = (vercel.rewrites || []).map(r => r.source);
  ok(rewriteSources.includes('/settings') && rewriteSources.includes('/downloads'), 'Vercel clean Settings/Downloads rewrites exist');
  const netlify = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'netlify.toml'), 'utf8');
  ok(netlify.includes('from = "/settings"') && netlify.includes('from = "/downloads"'), 'Netlify clean Settings/Downloads rewrites exist');

  console.log(`\n${passed} download/M3U/settings checks passed`);
})().catch(err => { console.error(err); process.exit(1); });
```

```javascript
'use strict';

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');

const root = path.join(__dirname, '..');
const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'index.html'), 'utf8');
const server = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'server.js'), 'utf8');
const finder = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'lib/server-finder/core.js'), 'utf8');

assert(!fs.existsSync(path.join(root, 'api/global-search.js')), 'removed global web-search API is not shipped');
assert(!fs.existsSync(path.join(root, 'lib/vendor/cdrake-se')), 'unused global-search adapters are not vendored');
assert(!server.includes('/api/global-search'), 'local server no longer exposes the removed API');
assert(!html.includes('Global web search leads') && !html.includes('serverGlobal'), 'global web-search leads panel is removed from the UI');
assert(!html.includes('globalSearchQuery') && !html.includes('requestGlobalSearchEngine'), 'the browser no longer schedules global web searches');
assert(html.includes('id="serverFinderProgress"') && finder.includes('crawlGitHub'), 'the bounded GitHub server finder remains available');
assert(html.includes('identifyTitleCandidate') && html.includes('exact-title stream matches are saved'), 'exact title and identity verification remain in place');

console.log('PASS removed global web-search feature; retained GitHub server finder and exact-title verification');
```

## `tv/zeroplay-debrid/tests/redesign-shell.test.cjs`

```javascript
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");

const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, "..", "index.html"), "utf8");
const menu = html.match(/<aside class="menu-drawer"[\s\S]*?<\/aside>/)?.[0] || "";
const rail = html.match(/<aside class="zp-sidebar"[\s\S]*?<\/aside>/)?.[0] || "";
const dock = html.match(/<nav class="mobile-bottom-nav"[\s\S]*?<\/nav>/)?.[0] || "";
const checks = [
  ["the combined redesign keeps the established route list in the More menu", ["home", "search", "movies", "series", "categories", "library", "sources", "downloads", "settings"].every(route => menu.includes(`data-menu-route="${route}"`))],
  ["desktop browse rail is present and uses working route controls", !!rail && ["home", "search", "movies", "series", "categories", "library"].every(route => rail.includes(`data-menu-route="${route}"`))],
  ["optional tools remain out of the persistent browse rail", !/data-menu-route="(?:sources|downloads|settings)"/.test(rail) && !/M3U|Diagnostics|Watch party|Profiles/.test(rail)],
  ["small-screen navigation dock contains browse routes only", !!dock && ["home", "search", "movies", "series", "library"].every(route => dock.includes(`data-menu-route="${route}"`)) && !/data-menu-route="(?:sources|downloads|settings)"/.test(dock)],
  ["menu button and rail More button open the accessible drawer", html.includes('id="btnMenu"') && html.includes('id="zpSidebarMore"') && html.includes('aria-controls="menuDrawer"') && /function openMenuDrawer\(\)/.test(html)],
  ["dropdown remains dismissible by its close button and outside scrim", html.includes('id="btnCloseMenu"') && html.includes('id="menuScrim"') && html.includes('$("#menuScrim").onclick=closeMenuDrawer')],
  ["route rendering highlights desktop and small-screen navigation accessibly", /function setNav\(name\)/.test(html) && html.includes('b.setAttribute("aria-current","page")') && /function render\(\)/.test(html)],
  ["combined preview colors keep both green/cyan TV focus cues and violet branding", html.includes('--zp-electric:#00d09c') && html.includes('--zp-focus:#00e5ff') && html.includes('linear-gradient(135deg,#7c3aed,#5b31c6)')],
  ["native Android TV layout and remote support remain", html.includes('body.android-tv .topbar-inner') && html.includes('ANDROID_TV_APP') && html.includes('function moveTvFocus')],
];

for (const [name, passed] of checks) {
  assert.ok(passed, `FAIL ${name}`);
  console.log(`PASS ${name}`);
}
console.log(`\n${checks.length} combined redesign shell checks passed`);
```

## `tv/zeroplay-debrid/tests/regressions.test.cjs`

```javascript
const fs = require('fs');
const vm = require('vm');
const assert = require('assert');
const path = require('path');
const root = path.resolve(__dirname, '..');
const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'index.html'), 'utf8');
const script = html.slice(html.indexOf('<script>') + 8, html.lastIndexOf('</script>'));
function between(start, end) {
  const a = script.indexOf(start); assert(a >= 0, 'missing ' + start);
  const b = script.indexOf(end, a + start.length); assert(b > a, 'missing ' + end);
  return script.slice(a, b);
}
const ctx = {
  console, URL, URLSearchParams, Set, Map, Date, Math, Number, String, Array, Object, RegExp,
  settings: { stream: { maxFileSizeGb: 5, quality: 'auto', dataSaver: 'off' }, health: {}, disabledSources: [] },
  navigator: {},
  saveSettings() {},
};
ctx.globalThis = ctx; vm.createContext(ctx);
vm.runInContext([
  between('const SOURCES=', '/* ---------------- FastStream preload'),
  between('const CAP_GB_HARD', 'async function probeFileSize'),
  between('function applyTemplate', 'const imdbCache'),
  between('function prettyHostName', 'function validateTemplate'),
  'function validateTemplate(t){ if(!t) return true; try{ const u=new URL(t.replace(/\\{[^}]+\\}/g,"1")); return u.protocol==="https:"||u.protocol==="http:"; }catch{ return false; } }',
  between('function cleanHttpUrl(raw)', 'function providerStableKey'),
  between('function classifySeedUrl(raw)', 'function providerCandidateFromSeed'),
  between('function parseFeedData(data)', 'function sourceSignature'),
  between('function normalizePlayerEvent(data)', 'window.addEventListener("message"'),
].join('\n'), ctx);

let n = 0;
const ok = (c, label) => { assert(c, label); n++; console.log('PASS', label); };
const eq = (a, b, label) => { assert.deepStrictEqual(a, b, label); n++; console.log('PASS', label); };

ok(ctx.sourceURL({type:'movie',id:27205},{},'vidstuck').startsWith('https://vidstuck.cc/embed/movie/27205'), 'VidStuck movie URL retained');
ok(ctx.sourceURL({type:'tv',id:1399},{season:2,episode:3},'zxcstream').startsWith('https://zxcstream.cc/player/tv/1399/2/3'), 'ZXCStream episode URL retained');
ok(ctx.sourceURL({type:'movie',id:27205},{},'embedwave').startsWith('https://embedwave.cc/embed/movie/27205'), 'Embedwave URL retained');
eq(ctx.capGb(), 5, '5 GB hard cap retained');
ok(!ctx.decideSizeCap(5_000_000_001, ctx.capBytes()).allowed, 'file above cap rejected');
ok(ctx.decideSizeCap(4_999_999_999, ctx.capBytes()).allowed, 'file below cap allowed');
eq(ctx.applyTemplate('https://x.test/{type}/{tmdb}/{season}/{episode}?imdb={imdb}', {type:'tv',id:1399,season:2,episode:3,imdb:'tt0944947'}), 'https://x.test/tv/1399/2/3?imdb=tt0944947', 'URL templates still resolve canonical IDs');
let parsed = ctx.parsePastedLink('https://example.test/watch/tt1375666/1/2');
ok(parsed && parsed.tvTpl.includes('{imdb}/{season}/{episode}'), 'pasted IMDb episode link becomes template');
parsed = ctx.parsePastedLink('https://example.test/home');
ok(parsed && parsed.site && !parsed.movieTpl, 'ordinary homepage remains lookup-only website');
eq(ctx.parseFeedData([{ name:'Template', movie:'https://x.test/movie/{tmdb}' }]).length, 1, 'legacy feed template still accepted');
eq(ctx.parseFeedData([{ url:'https://github.com/example/project' }]).length, 0, 'GitHub feed entry is not misclassified as template');
eq(ctx.parseFeedData([{ url:'https://addon.example/manifest.json' }]).length, 0, 'manifest feed entry is not misclassified as template');
ok(ctx.normalizePlayerEvent({type:'PLAYER_EVENT',data:{player_progress:10,player_duration:100,player_info:{tmdb:27205,mediaType:'movie'}}}).id === 27205, 'PLAYER_EVENT normalization retained');

const srv = require(path.join(root, 'api/extract.js'))._parse;
const results = srv.parseResultLinks('<a href="/anime/one-piece/ep-1" title="One Piece">One Piece</a><a href="/anime/naruto">Naruto</a>', 'https://site.test/search?keyword=One+Piece');
ok(results.some(r => r.url.endsWith('/ep-1') && r.title === 'One Piece'), 'dynamic result parser retains title links');
ok(srv.searchTemplatesFromHtml('<form action="/search"><input name="keyword"></form>', 'https://site.test/').length >= 1, 'website search form discovery retained');
eq(srv.buildSearchUrl('https://site.test/search/{slug}', 'One Piece'), 'https://site.test/search/one-piece', 'slug search URL retained');
ok(srv.adjustEpisodeInUrl('https://site.test/anime/one-piece/ep-1180',1,2).endsWith('/ep-2'), 'episode URL adjustment retained');
ok(srv.findEpisodeUrl('<a href="/anime/one-piece/ep-2">2</a>', 'https://site.test/anime/one-piece/ep-1', 1, 2).endsWith('/ep-2'), 'child episode discovery retained');
const watch = srv.parseWatch('<title>One Piece Episode 1</title><iframe src="https://player.test/embed/1"></iframe><source src="https://cdn.test/video.mp4">', 'https://site.test/watch');
ok(watch.embed.includes('player.test') && watch.direct.includes('https://cdn.test/video.mp4'), 'watch parser retains iframe and direct media');

const statics = [
  [html.includes('"/api/extract?mode=json&url="+encodeURIComponent(url)'), 'Cinemeta/deployment JSON relay path retained'],
  [html.includes('const LAST_RESORT=new Set(["embedwave"])'), 'Embedwave last-resort registry retained'],
  [html.includes('https://faststream.online/player/#'), 'embedded FastStream direct player retained'],
  [html.includes('settings.source==="embedwave") settings.source="vidstuck"'), 'Embedwave cannot remain saved default'],
  [html.includes('delete settings.siteCatalogues'), 'legacy imported website catalogues still purged'],
  [html.includes('no titles or covers imported'), 'lookup-only website rule visible'],
  [html.includes('identifyAndRegisterEndpoint'), 'crawler server identification present'],
  [html.includes('searchAddonCatalog'), 'searchable addon catalogues present'],
];
for (const [cond,label] of statics) ok(cond,label);
console.log(`\n${n} regression checks passed`);
```

## `tv/zeroplay-debrid/tests/search-player-chrome.test.cjs`

```javascript
const fs = require("node:fs");
const path = require("node:path");
const assert = require("node:assert/strict");

const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, "..", "index.html"), "utf8");
const checks = [
  ["search uses a 350ms debounce", /setTimeout\(\(\)=>runSearch\(\),350\)/.test(html)],
  ["search fans out concurrently to Cinemeta, TVmaze and AniList", /Promise\.all\(\[cm\("movie"\),cm\("tv"\),tvmaze,anilist\]\)/.test(html) && html.includes("api.tvmaze.com/search/shows") && html.includes("graphql.anilist.co")],
  ["search aborts stale requests and checks a sequence before rendering", html.includes("searchController.abort()") && html.includes("if(sequence!==searchSequence)return")],
  ["search merges and de-duplicates results by normalized title, year and type", html.includes('const key=title+"|"+year+"|"+type')],
  ["search offers movie and TV filters", html.includes('data-f="movie"') && html.includes('data-f="tv"') && html.includes('data-f="all"')],
  ["recent searches persist locally and can be selected", html.includes("SEARCH_RECENTS_KEY") && html.includes("data-search-recent")],
  ["catalogue-native results can open ZeroPlay title details", html.includes("searchResultItems.get(keyOf(type,Number(id)))") && html.includes("search_provider_id")],
  ["player has an explicit hide button and a restore affordance", html.includes('id="btnHidePlayerChrome"') && html.includes('id="btnRestorePlayerChrome"') && html.includes("function hidePlayerChrome()")],
  ["paused resume action shelf no longer overlays embedded controls", !html.includes("player-action-shelf") && !html.includes("btnPlayerResume")],
  ["embedded-player mode hides ZeroPlay chrome and disables center-play overlays", /if\(limited\)\{[\s\S]*?hidePlayerChrome\(\);/.test(html) && html.includes('center.hidden=embedControls||!st.playback.paused')],
  ["hidden chrome stays hidden on pointer movement and touch until explicitly restored", html.includes('overlay.addEventListener("mousemove",()=>showPlayerChrome(false));') && html.includes('overlay.addEventListener("touchstart",()=>showPlayerChrome(false),{passive:true})') && html.includes('on("btnRestorePlayerChrome","click",()=>showPlayerChrome(true,true))')],
  ["search-result details fall back to cached result metadata if the detail API fails", html.includes('const hasLocalTitle=!!(localItem&&localItem.id') && html.includes('if(hasLocalTitle&&(!remoteUsable||!remoteMatchesLocal)){ d=localItem; usedLocalFallback=true; }')],
  ["series results without season metadata do not bind a missing selector", html.includes('const seasonSelect=$("#seasonSelect");') && html.includes('if(isTV&&seasonSelect) seasonSelect.onchange=')],
];

for (const [name, passed] of checks) {
  assert.ok(passed, `FAIL ${name}`);
  console.log(`PASS ${name}`);
}
console.log(`\n${checks.length} search/player-chrome checks passed`);
```

## `tv/zeroplay-debrid/tests/server-finder.test.cjs`

```javascript
'use strict';

const assert = require('node:assert/strict');
const fs = require('node:fs');
const path = require('node:path');
const { once } = require('node:events');
const { publicHttpsUrl, normalizeIdentity, parseManifest, providerRecord, extractManifestUrls, fetchTextJson, crawlSource, findCandidates, runWorker } = require('../lib/server-finder/core');
const findApi = require('../api/find');
const { createLocalServer } = require('../server');

const manifest = {
  id: 'org.example.lola', name: 'Lola Stream Candidate', version: '1.0.0',
  description: 'Public test addon', resources: ['stream', 'catalog', 'meta'],
  types: ['movie', 'series'], idPrefixes: ['tt'],
  catalogs: [{ type: 'movie', id: 'search', extra: [{ name: 'search' }] }],
};
function response(data, status = 200, headers = {}) {
  return {
    ok: status >= 200 && status < 300, status,
    headers: { get(name) { return headers[String(name).toLowerCase()] || null; } },
    async text() { return typeof data === 'string' ? data : JSON.stringify(data); },
  };
}
function responseStub() {
  return { statusCode: 200, headers: {}, body: null, setHeader(name, value) { this.headers[name] = value; }, status(code) { this.statusCode = code; return this; }, json(value) { this.body = value; return value; } };
}

(async () => {
  assert.equal(publicHttpsUrl('https://addon.example/manifest.json'), 'https://addon.example/manifest.json', 'public HTTPS addon manifests are accepted');
  for (const url of ['http://addon.example/manifest.json', 'https://localhost/manifest.json', 'https://127.0.0.1/manifest.json', 'https://192.168.1.2/manifest.json', 'https://addon.local/manifest.json']) {
    assert.equal(publicHttpsUrl(url), '', 'private, local, and non-HTTPS targets are rejected');
  }
  const identity = normalizeIdentity({ title: 'My Heart Beats for Lola Volcán', titles: ['Mi corazón insiste en Lola Volcán'], type: 'tv', year: '2011', imdbId: 'tt1929755', tmdbId: '35281', season: 1, episode: 1 });
  assert.deepEqual(identity.titles, ['My Heart Beats for Lola Volcán', 'Mi corazón insiste en Lola Volcán'], 'identity retains English and original title variants');
  assert.equal(identity.imdbId, 'tt1929755');
  assert.throws(() => normalizeIdentity({ title: ' ' }), /title is required/i, 'empty title searches are rejected');
  assert.equal(parseManifest(manifest).resources.includes('stream'), true, 'stream-capable manifest is identified');
  assert.equal(parseManifest({ ...manifest, resources: ['catalog'] }), null, 'catalog-only manifests are not server candidates');
  assert.equal(parseManifest({ ...manifest, types: ['person'] }), null, 'non-video manifests are not server candidates');
  const record = providerRecord('https://addon.example/manifest.json', manifest, 'fixture');
  assert.equal(record.status, 'candidate', 'discovered providers remain candidates');
  assert.equal(record.titleScopedDiscovery, true, 'candidate is marked for title-scoped verification');
  assert.equal(record.identification.installable, false, 'manifest discovery alone cannot install a provider');
  assert.equal(record.identification.supports.streams, true, 'candidate stream capability is surfaced to the existing title scanner');
  assert.deepEqual(extractManifestUrls('Install at https://addons.example/manifest.json and not https://example.org/home'), ['https://addons.example/manifest.json'], 'GitHub README scraper only extracts manifest endpoints');

  let calls = 0;
  await assert.rejects(fetchTextJson('http://127.0.0.1/private', { fetchImpl: async () => { calls++; return response({}); } }), /Blocked URL/, 'unsafe requests are rejected before fetching');
  assert.equal(calls, 0, 'private URL rejection avoids network access');
  await assert.rejects(fetchTextJson('https://public.example/start', { fetchImpl: async () => response('', 302, { location: 'http://127.0.0.1/private' }) }), /Blocked redirect/, 'redirects to private targets are blocked');

  const fixtureFetch = async url => {
    const value = String(url);
    if (value.includes('stremio-addons.net/api/v0/addons')) return response({ addons: [
      { manifestUrl: 'https://addon.example/manifest.json', manifest, stars: 7 },
      { manifestUrl: 'http://unsafe.example/manifest.json', manifest },
      { manifestUrl: 'https://catalog-only.example/manifest.json', manifest: { ...manifest, resources: ['catalog'] } },
    ] });
    if (value.includes('addon_catalog/all/')) return response({ addons: [] });
    if (value.includes('api.github.com/search/repositories')) return response({ items: [] });
    throw new Error('Unexpected fixture request ' + value);
  };
  const catalog = await crawlSource('stremio-addons', identity, { fetchImpl: fixtureFetch, maxPerSource: 12, timeoutMs: 1000 });
  assert.equal(catalog.status, 'complete', 'catalog crawler completes with fixture data');
  assert.equal(catalog.candidates, 1, 'only a public HTTPS stream manifest becomes a candidate');
  assert.equal(catalog.records[0].source, 'Server Finder · stremio-addons', 'candidate provenance is retained');
  const partialGraph = await crawlSource('catalog-graph', identity, { fetchImpl: async url => String(url).includes('community.json') ? response({}, 503) : response({ addons: [] }), timeoutMs: 1000 });
  assert.equal(partialGraph.status, 'partial', 'one unavailable catalogue is reported as partial rather than silently complete');
  const failedGraph = await crawlSource('catalog-graph', identity, { fetchImpl: async () => { throw new Error('offline'); }, timeoutMs: 1000 });
  assert.equal(failedGraph.status, 'failed', 'all unavailable catalogues are reported as failed');
  const bounded = await findCandidates(identity, { sourceIds: ['stremio-addons'], fetchImpl: fixtureFetch, maxPerSource: 12, limit: 1, timeoutMs: 1000 });
  assert.equal(bounded.candidateCount, 1, 'candidate results obey caller limits');
  assert.equal(bounded.mode, 'hosted-bounded-pool', 'hosted mode uses bounded async workers');

  const threadResult = await runWorker('unknown-source', identity, { timeoutMs: 1000, workerTimeoutMs: 5000 });
  assert.equal(threadResult.status, 'failed', 'local worker_threads execute and report isolated source failures');
  assert.match(threadResult.error, /unknown crawler/i, 'worker failures are contained as source status rather than crashing the server');

  const originalFetch = global.fetch;
  global.fetch = async url => {
    const value = String(url);
    if (value.includes('stremio-addons.net/api/v0/addons')) return response({ addons: [] });
    if (value.includes('addon_catalog/all/')) return response({ addons: [] });
    if (value.includes('api.github.com/search/repositories')) return response({ items: [] });
    throw new Error('Unexpected API fixture request ' + value);
  };
  try {
    const badMethod = responseStub();
    await findApi({ method: 'DELETE', headers: {}, query: {} }, badMethod);
    assert.equal(badMethod.statusCode, 405, 'hosted endpoint is read-only apart from title search');
    const badOrigin = responseStub();
    await findApi({ method: 'GET', headers: { origin: 'https://evil.example', host: 'zeroplay.example' }, query: { q: 'Lola' } }, badOrigin);
    assert.equal(badOrigin.statusCode, 403, 'hosted endpoint rejects cross-origin requests');
    const hosted = responseStub();
    await findApi({ method: 'POST', headers: { host: 'zeroplay.example', origin: 'https://zeroplay.example', 'x-forwarded-for': '203.0.113.4' }, query: {}, body: { identity } }, hosted);
    assert.equal(hosted.statusCode, 200, 'hosted API returns candidate-discovery status');
    assert.equal(hosted.body.ok, true, 'hosted API returns a successful bounded search');
    assert.equal(hosted.body.candidateCount, 0, 'no manifests means no candidates are promoted');
  } finally { global.fetch = originalFetch; }

  const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '..', 'index.html'), 'utf8');
  assert(html.includes('fetch("/api/find"'), 'browser uses a same-origin finder URL instead of hard-coded localhost');
  assert(html.includes('serverFinderProgressHTML') && html.includes('serverFinderSourceStatus'), 'finder source progress appears separately in the title-search UI');
  assert(html.includes('result.identityVerified>0') && html.includes('status:"installed"'), 'browser retains exact-match-only candidate promotion');

  const local = createLocalServer();
  local.listen(0, '127.0.0.1');
  await once(local, 'listening');
  try {
    const address = local.address();
    const health = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:' + address.port + '/api/health');
    const status = await health.json();
    assert.equal(status.ok, true, 'local sidecar health endpoint responds');
    assert.equal(status.mode, 'local-worker-threads', 'local mode advertises its actual worker strategy');
    const home = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:' + address.port + '/');
    assert.equal(home.status, 200, 'local server serves the existing browser app from the same origin');
    assert((await home.text()).includes('ZeroPlay'), 'local app shell is served without a localhost URL in browser code');
  } finally { await new Promise(resolve => local.close(resolve)); }

  console.log('PASS bounded local/hosted Server Finder, safe candidate discovery, same-origin fallback, and exact-title promotion guard');
})().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });
```

## `tv/zeroplay-debrid/tests/server-search-concurrency.test.cjs`

```javascript
const fs = require('fs');
const vm = require('vm');
const assert = require('assert');
const path = require('path');

const html = fs.readFileSync(path.join(__dirname, '..', 'index.html'), 'utf8');
const script = html.slice(html.indexOf('<script>') + 8, html.lastIndexOf('</script>'));
const start = script.indexOf('async function collectAllStreams(ctx,opts)');
const end = script.indexOf('\nasync function measureSpeed', start);
assert(start >= 0 && end > start, 'collectAllStreams must exist');
const titleSearchStart = script.indexOf('async function findTitleServers(ctx,opts)');
const titleSearchEnd = script.indexOf('\nasync function playTitleServerOption', titleSearchStart);
assert(titleSearchStart >= 0 && titleSearchEnd > titleSearchStart, 'title server search must exist');
const titleSearchCode = script.slice(titleSearchStart, titleSearchEnd);
assert(!titleSearchCode.includes('runDiscoveryCycle(') && !titleSearchCode.includes('crawlStremioAddonsNet(') && !titleSearchCode.includes('crawlCatalogGraph('), '100-worker title lookup does not start the independent continuous discovery crawler');
assert(titleSearchCode.includes('collectAllStreams(richCtx') && titleSearchCode.includes('collectTitleCandidateStreams(richCtx'), 'title lookup scans installed providers and the current candidate snapshot');
assert(script.includes('setInterval(()=>{ runDiscoveryCycle("interval"); }'), 'continuous provider discovery keeps its independent timer');

const addons = Array.from({ length: 7 }, (_, i) => ({ id: `provider-${i}`, name: `Provider ${i}` }));
let active = 0;
let maxActive = 0;
const completed = [];
const updates = [];
const ctx = {
  settings: { stream: { quality: 'auto' }, addons },
  enabledAddons() { return ctx.settings.addons; },
  healthScore() { return 50; },
  normalizeQualityLabel(value) { return value; },
  qualityHeight(value) { return Number.parseInt(value, 10) || 0; },
  buildTitleIdentity(input) { return { version: 1, title: input.title || 'Series', type: 'tv' }; },
  async queryAddonStreams(addon) {
    active++;
    maxActive = Math.max(maxActive, active);
    const delays = { 'provider-0': 35, 'provider-1': 5, 'provider-2': 15, 'provider-3': 3, 'provider-4': 8, 'provider-5': 1, 'provider-6': 2 };
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delays[addon.id]));
    active--;
    completed.push(addon.id);
    return {
      direct: [{ url: `https://cdn.test/${addon.id}.mp4`, addonName: addon.name, addonBase: `https://${addon.id}.test`, quality: '1080p', identityScore: 99 }],
      identityVerified: 1,
    };
  },
};
ctx.globalThis = ctx;
vm.createContext(ctx);
vm.runInContext(script.slice(start, end), ctx, { filename: 'collect-all-streams.js' });

(async () => {
  const result = await ctx.collectAllStreams({ title: 'Series', type: 'tv' }, {
    concurrency: 3,
    onProgress(snapshot) { updates.push(snapshot.queried); },
  });
  assert.strictEqual(maxActive, 3, 'uses configured provider concurrency');
  assert.strictEqual(result.concurrency, 3, 'reports actual concurrency');
  assert.strictEqual(result.queried, addons.length, 'queries every enabled provider');
  assert.strictEqual(result.direct.length, addons.length, 'preserves every verified matching stream');
  assert.strictEqual(updates.length, addons.length, 'reports progress per provider, not per completed batch');
  assert.strictEqual(updates[0], 1, 'first provider completion is emitted immediately');
  assert.notStrictEqual(completed[0], 'provider-0', 'fast providers are not held behind a slow provider');
  assert.strictEqual(result.identityVerified, addons.length, 'aggregates verified stream counts');

  const allProviders = Array.from({ length: 120 }, (_, i) => ({ id: `vod-${i}`, name: `VOD ${i}` }));
  ctx.settings.addons = allProviders;
  let started = 0;
  ctx.queryAddonStreams = async addon => {
    started++;
    await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1));
    return { direct: [{ url: `https://cdn.test/${addon.id}.mp4`, addonName: addon.name, addonBase: `https://${addon.id}.test` }] };
  };
  const fullScan = await ctx.collectAllStreams({ title: 'Series', type: 'tv' }, {});
  assert.strictEqual(fullScan.concurrency, 100, 'uses the requested 100-worker default for a large VOD provider list');
  assert.strictEqual(started, 120, 'does not stop provider scheduling after finding matching servers');
  assert.strictEqual(fullScan.queried, 120, 'scans the complete enabled VOD provider list');
  assert.strictEqual(fullScan.totalAddons, 120, 'reports the full provider inventory');
  assert.strictEqual(fullScan.direct.length, 120, 'does not cap verified direct results');
  console.log('PASS bounded concurrent workers and immediate per-provider progress');
  console.log('PASS uncapped VOD provider scan returns all matching servers');
})().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exit(1); });
```
